notes.title: Dysterra Full Release – Play for Free!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience.
Dysterra has finally completed its long period of refinement and is now transitioning to its official release.
Here are the key changes of the full release of Dysterra.

[b][u]Update schedule[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Europe[/b]: Apr 17th, 2025, 2:00 AM to 7:00 AM (CET)
[*] [b]America[/b]: Apr 16th, 2025, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM (PST)
[*] [b]Asia[/b]: Apr 17th, 2025, 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM (KST)
[/list]

[h1]Dysterra Goes Free-to-Play! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2c6cd35e5ddca724f474128b79c368207ebcbaae.jpg[/img]
Dysterra is going free-to-play very soon! We understand that you may have many questions about this change, so we’d like to take this opportunity to explain the details.
With the transition to free-to-play, we are also introducing the [b]Founder’s Pack DLC.[/b]
 All players who have previously purchased Dysterra will receive this DLC for free.
The [b]Founder’s Pack DLC[/b] includes the following benefits:
[list]
[*][b]3,000TP for Terra Shop[/b] (only for new purchaser)
[*]Access to [b]official servers[/b]
[*]Ability to claim [b]daily/weekly rewards[/b]
[*]Listed on the [b]global rankings[/b]
[*]Content unlocks in specific areas of single-player mode
[/list]
Players who are using the free version will need to purchase the [b]Founder’s Pack DLC[/b] to access these features.

If you're new to the game, we recommend getting familiar with the mechanics through [b]single-player mode[/b] or [b]custom servers[/b]. Once you're ready to earn [b]TP (Terrasite Points)[/b], you can join the official servers.
Existing players can either play on [b]custom servers[/b] to enjoy the game with free players or join the [b]official servers[/b] to compete and earn TP.
We deeply appreciate those who supported Dysterra early on by purchasing and playing the game.🚀

[h1]Time-Limited Skins Introduced [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/27fa5cee6b3a1acbe5b4446646f2acd63831208c.png[/img]
All currently available skins, as well as future skins, will now be time-limited.
However, any skins you have already purchased will remain permanent and will not be affected by this change.
To celebrate the official launch, we are introducing the "Orbis Container - Skull Silver Skins"! 🎉


[h1]Ranking System Change[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b9c84a56b1efa18ce066140b403242cffeade205.png[/img]
[b]PvP and PvE rankings will now be separated[/b].
Weekly rewards will also be divided into two categories, ensuring that players can compete more fairly based on their preferred playstyle.
All previous rankings before this update will be reset.

[h1]Environmental Changes [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/08d8421e3e342cb7154df09bcbac92e17dc39505.png[/img]
[b]Longer Nights[/b] 🌙
 The nights on Ararat Island will now last longer.

[b]Rain Returns[/b] ☔
 After a long dry spell, rain will finally make a comeback.

[b]More Dynamic Temperature Changes[/b] 🌡️
 Each region’s temperature will now fluctuate more noticeably depending on the time of day.
[list]
[*][b]At night, it will get colder.[/b]
[*][b]Rain will make temperatures drop even further.[/b]
[*][b]In open areas like the Gamma Zone, where there are no trees to block sunlight, daytime will feel hotter.[/b]
[/list]
[b]Survival Adjustments[/b]
 Players can [b]counter harsh weather conditions[/b] by equipping [b]armor[/b], using [b]pills[/b], or [b]injections[/b].

Armor’s [b]environmental resistance[/b] has been significantly increased, making it a more effective way to withstand extreme temperatures.

[h1]Weapon & Armor Changes [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/047ffeee08cbb22197cf4f74065ff3254e3e1756.png[/img]
The crafting bench has always been a reliable companion, producing equipment with consistent performance. However, this will now change.
From now on, weapons, melee weapons, and armor crafted at the bench will have varying stats each time they are made.
[list]
[*][b]Weapon Grades Introduced[/b]
        Survivors can check a weapon's performance based on its grade.
[*][b]Weapon Stat Changes in the Journal [/b]
        You can track how weapons evolve by checking your Journal.
[/list]
Additionally, the durability enhancement system has been revamped to strengthen overall stats, not just durability.
[list]
[*][b]Higher-Grade Gear = Better Enhancements[/b]
         Strengthening high-quality equipment will provide greater stat boosts compared to upgrading 
         standard gear. So, if possible, focus on enhancing higher-grade equipment for the best results! 
        🔧💥
[/list]

[h1]Gun Recoil Adjustments [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/51b5a3091803efb9efeda36fb8e36ee1b4f08d8a.png[/img]
Assault rifles and submachine guns have been the dominant weapon choices in the game. To encourage more diverse weapon usage, we have [b]completely redesigned gun recoil mechanics.[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Sniper rifles & designated marksman rifles (DMRs)[/b]📈
        [b]Significantly reduced recoil[/b], making them easier to handle and more viable in combat.
[*][b]Submachine guns (SMGs)[/b]📉
        [b]Increased recoil[/b], making it harder to hit distant targets.
[/list]
These changes aim to create a [b]more balanced and varied[/b] gunplay experience! 🎯

[h1]New Lighting Feature Added [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1f795c5b3388679ae44d746fe00527fc2268b210.png[/img]
With longer and darker nights, we’ve added a new [b]Searchlight[/b] to help players illuminate their surroundings more effectively.
[list]
[*]You can [b]manually aim[/b] the light where you want it to shine.
[*]By [b]holding the interaction key[/b], you can [b]adjust the direction[/b] of the beam, allowing for near full-range coverage in any direction.
[/list]
Perfect for base defense, night raids, or simply lighting up the dark wilderness! 💡🌌


[h1]Terrafire Cycle Adjustments [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/683de753bc1af14aa1d502d50d3af44849af6e75.png[/img]
With the enhancement of weapons and armor, the Terrafire cycle will now be extended.
[list]
[*]PvE Server Changes 🌍
   [b]Initial Duration[/b]: 4 months (120 days)
   [b]Minimum Duration[/b]: 3 months (90 days)
   [b]Maximum Duration[/b]: 6 months (180 days)
[*]PvP Servers 🔥
   [b]No changes[/b] – the existing cycle will remain the same.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.28
notes.content:
As the weather warms up, we hope you have a pleasant spring ahead.

Some of you may have noticed strange behavior from monsters, including bears, in recent times. Thanks to the relentless efforts of Orbis scientists, the cause has finally been identified. The Orbis Security Bureau has deployed a bio-form vaccine across Ararat Island while simultaneously upgrading the software of robotic units. As a result, the unusual anomalies you’ve encountered have been significantly improved.

We’ll have more exciting news about Dysterra to share with you soon.
If you have ideas to improve the game or have discovered any bugs, please report them on our Discord server!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.19
notes.content:
It's been a while since we've greeted you all, and the development team would like to share some updates on the current development direction of Dysterra, along with a small balance patch.

We are planning to reintroduce some of the survival elements that were intentionally reduced in gameplay. We believe that certain systems, which were removed due to causing inconvenience in areas like difficulty, PvP, and NPC battles, should be revived. Specifically, we are reorganizing the temperature system. We are testing several systems, including bringing back the weather system from the previous open beta test and introducing temperature variations.
Regarding this week's balance patch, we have made several stat improvements to the gliding skill, which has been rarely used, to make it more enjoyable and useful. Additionally, we felt that some adjustments were necessary for the grenades, which were enhanced in the last patch. Therefore, we have made some downward adjustments to a few values, ensuring we do not undermine the original intent of the design.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.content:
[h1]Fire in the hole![/h1]

Hello Survivors,
Have you ever felt frustrated when multiple hostile NPCs appeared at once while playing Dysterra? To address this, our development team has completely revamped the grenades. We’ve added new gimmicks to grenades and smoke bombs. Additionally, all NPCs, except a few, will now take 3 times more damage from grenades. If you have ideas to improve the game further, please let us know on our Discord server!

[h1]New Feature: Smoke Grenade Vision Obstruction[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/324da18ffba401e02cd73eb00057505158845ab1.png[/img]
👀 Smoke grenades will now obstruct the vision of not only players but also NPCs (excluding bosses)! However, be careful; getting too close will still make you noticeable and subject to attacks.


[h1]New Throwable: Impact Grenade Added[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a828144282e0015c72d6934ee000e308749662ea.jpg[/img]
💥 Unlike grenades that detonate after a set time, a new grenade has been added that explodes immediately upon contact with something.
- Damage: 80
- Range: 3 ~ 6m
- Stacks up to 40 grenades per inventory cell.
- Even if it doesn't make contact with anything, it will explode after a certain time.
- It can be crafted at Workbench Level 2 or higher.
- Materials required:
[list]
[*] 2 Advanced Metals
[*] 2 Explosives
[/list]

[h1]New Throwable: Radioactive Smoke Grenade Added[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a2bf8ac09d66a040a1af4115c4ca0085f01e3981.png[/img]
☠️ A new smoke grenade that emits deadly radioactive smoke has been added.
- Radiation Level: 40
- In PvP, use radiation-resistant armor to protect yourself!
- Stacks up to 40 grenades per inventory cell.
- It is lethal to Hyena soldiers and wildlife.
- It deals a small amount of damage upon contact with the smoke and continuously decreases the NPC's health for 200 seconds.
- It can be crafted at Workbench Level 2 or higher.
- Materials required:
[list]
[*] 2 Advanced Metals
[*] 5 Anti-Radiation Capsules
[*] 2 Explosives
[/list]

[h1]Balance Change: Grenade Damage to NPCs Increased by 3 Times[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dcbe63bb6107d142d216a53376fc0ce21d087cdd.png[/img]
💥 Throwing grenades at enemies can be a more advantageous choice than shooting.


[h1]Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h1]
🐛 Fixed a bug where hacking Dynamos was impossible.
🐛 Fixed an error where metal was not included in the grenade crafting recipe.
🦋 Improved camera shaking to be more intense when grenades explode at close range.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.8
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Survivors![/h3]

Brace yourself for intensified Home Invasions that pose a threat to your base, featuring dynamic difficulty levels based on your skill and shelter complexity. Plus, bid farewell to the festive season as we say goodbye to Christmas decorations. Now, let's dive into the details!



[h1]Protect Your PvE Base, too![/h1]
Recently, we included the ‘Home Invasion’ event to all of our servers where Hyena or Orbis troops will appear near your base and launch an attack.

Be sure to safeguard your hard-earned progress and valuable items by fortifying your base with internal and external defenses. That may be traps, turrets, or something else. The choice is yours.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c0217b2ba3885ba001c8e4795852c43e38a3524d.png[/img]


[h1]Changes to Home Invasion Conditions[/h1]
Home Invasions come in five varieties, each with an escalating difficulty level. We’re introducing shelter complexity to the algorithm to ensure a more dynamic invasion level selection based on your skill as well as the size of your base. Shelter complexity is a measure of several factors including: the number of items installed in your base (including walls and foundations), and the level of said items. You can easily check your 'Shelter Complexity' in your building core's menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e26d2445c3b98f519a3c0c2a0fda7bb0c8404e3d.png[/img]


[h1]Farewell, Christmas Decorations![/h1]
As we bid adieu to the holiday season, all in-game holiday-themed items and skins will be officially removed. Your placed holiday items will retain their festive skins until picked up or uninstalled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7045ecc4028a81b624ed188fd97bc9ec221ea77a.png[/img]


[h1]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h1]
🦋 Optimized memory use for custom servers.
🐛 Fixed a bug where mobs were unable to cause damage to player bases.
🐛 Fixed an issue where lights would remain in place even after their corresponding wall was destroyed.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.6
notes.content:
🎄Get ready to unwrap the magic of our festive Christmas update! Spruce up your base with delightful holiday decorations and enjoy special seasonal snacks. Hurry, though – these festive additions will only be available until mid-January. It's the season of giving, and we're thrilled to present these holiday delights to our amazing community.



[h1]Holiday Gathering Boost 🎁[/h1]
To celebrate the season, all of our official PvE servers will have 2X resource gathering for the duration of our holiday celebration! 

[h2]2x gathering boost:[/h2]
Excluding special items like keys, all gathering will be doubled over the weekend. This includes terrasite, stone, and metal, as well as all containers and NPCs around Ararat Island.



[h1]New Holiday Items🎁[/h1]
Bring the spirit of the season to your base with Christmas trees, a fireplace, and Christmas-themed chests of all sizes! Be sure to press F on the Christmas tree to hear special holiday music.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7045ecc4028a81b624ed188fd97bc9ec221ea77a.png[/img]



[h1]Make Your Own Holiday Snacks🍪[/h1]
We’ve also got some holiday themed snacks for your characters to enjoy!

[h2]This year’s holiday menu is:[/h2]
[b]Holiday Cookies
Christmas Turkey[/b]

You can craft them at your consumables bench with Holiday Fiber Meal Kits and Holiday Protein Meal Kits that you’ll now be able to find around the map. I don’t want to spoil the fun, so I’ll let you all have fun finding where they are.

The Christmas Turkey has a high saturation(90!), and the cookies give you 60% radiation resistance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1c1762c7b63d83d53d7e19964a018c69fc3fbc02.png[/img]



[h1]Home Invasion now comes in 5 flavors!💥[/h1]
The Orbis Robots have been watching the Hyena forces attack your base, and now that you’re clearly too formidable for the Hyenas, the Orbis forces are going to try getting rid of you before you become too large of a threat!

We’ve added 2 Orbis Home Invasion attacks to the current 3 Hyena versions. Once you reach level 21, you’ll have to defend yourself against orbis robots. You’ll unlock the most difficult Home Invasion when you hit level 26.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/85557fea0972a666e03d09e2657aa7975bb1f58d.png[/img]



[h1]Rev Your Engines!🏎️[/h1]
Hitting other players or mobs while driving will now give varying amounts of damage depending on your speed. The faster you go, the more damage you’ll inflict!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/37c99f4027234f22101706e5a26f427e0f2d69f9.png[/img]



[h1]Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/h1]
🦋 Building fragments will now fade-out as they disappear.
🐛 Fixed an issue where the layout of the character creation window appeared distorted on some resolutions.
🦋 Fixed an issue where, during base attacks by NPCs, if the player was far from the base, there was no prompt on the left side of the HUD.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.5
notes.content:
We’re always listening to player feedback, and this week is no different. This week we’ve got improvements to base-building, an upgrade to our anti-cheat measures, and improvements to base efficiency and rocket launcher recoil.



[h1]Stack Pillars[/h1]
You asked for it, and now it’s here! You can now stack pillars on top of one another without any floors between them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e3b52f75139ac936d6a69edd6f672feeab3274f7.png[/img]


[h1]Better Anti-Cheat[/h1]
Providing a fair gaming experience to players is one of our top priorities. To achieve this, we are switching our anti-cheat tool to "Easy Anti-Cheat." Easy Anti-Cheat is currently used by several renowned games and is recognized as an excellent anti-cheat solution. To learn more, please refer to their website.



[h1]Better Miner Efficiency[/h1]
We’ve reduced the energy usage of mining machines to give players more leeway when it comes to endgame energy expenditures.

[b]Before[/b]: 400 energy/min.
[b]After[/b]: 250 energy/min.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9f794ab3956b76f1821258fd245626282efc0017.png[/img]


[h1]Reduced Rocket Recoil[/h1]
We want it to be easier for survivors to adjust their aim after firing a rocket.



[h1]Bugs & Optimizations[/h1]
🐛 Fixed a bug where the corpse of Hyena Axemen and Shotgunners were not detected by vision scan.
🐛 Resolved an issue in the character customization window where players using a gamepad weren’t able to select a hair color.
🐛 Fixed an abnormal behavior of explosive weapons' area damage.
🐛 When destroying existing housing parts, survivors used to receive nothing back if only 1 of a material was used in its crafting. Players will now receive 1 of said material back when destroying that housing part. (e.g. 1/4 Foundation Lv.4).
🐛 Fixed a bug where garage doors were able to overlap.
🐛 Adjusted the crafting bench price for vehicle battery cells, so that crafting with or without a crafting bench will use the same recipe. (Only 2 lithium is required no matter where you craft)

notes.content:
How is everybody doing? In this week’s update, we’ve added a video message from the Director of Orbis himself, while also making it easier to build your base.



[h1]Director Armond Reveals the Truth[/h1]
Orbis’ goal was neither Earth nor Terrasite. The new future that Orbis is aiming to create is beyond your imagination. Finally, Director Armond reveals Orbis’ intentions.

Director Armond will only reveal this secret to survivors who have successfully returned to Orbis. Stay alive and escape on the rocket to learn the truth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/82fcb006c0276056da9b3b6739a4133fa4a9cead.png[/img]



[h1]Building Just Got Easier![/h1]
Place your next base part with ease. We’ve made installing new base parts less finicky and much faster!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8f2199bd281f35eb0c732e28a6fab4df9358c4d4.png[/img]



[h1]Bugs & Optimizations[/h1]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.6.1
notes.content:
Brrrrrr!! It’s getting cold outside! We’ve optimized several systems this week as well as making repeaters much easier to install where you want them.



[h1]Repeater Area Color Change[/h1]
We changed the color of the repeater’s available area to help it be more easily distinguished from the building core’s area sphere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/78faa2f97a36966c49c45344dddf14c7d9102097.png[/img]


[h1]Siege Jammer Change[/h1]
When a siege jammer is activating, it is now possible to install mines (excluding bounding mines).



[h1]Base Part Changes[/h1]
We’ve made some improvements to how the a couple of base parts operate:

[h2][u][b]Recycler[/b][/u][/h2]
👊 If the recycler runs out of power mid-operation, it will resume operation once power is restored.

[h2][u][b]Barrel Grill[/b][/u][/h2]
👊 You cannot begin cooking an item while the barrel grill’s inventory is full.

[h2][u][b]Bounding Mines, Holograms, Electric Floors[/b][/u][/h2]
👊 They now require an active, powered building core to be turned on.



[h1]Cyclops Attack Improvement[/h1]
When a cyclops performs a teleportation attack, it will now check whether the destination location is valid before it performs the attack.



[h1]Bugs & Optimizations[/h1]
🐛 Added exception handling for the activation conditions of the Hyena Home Invasion; It now only triggers for the actual owner of the energy core.
🦋 When the hologram triangular floor/ceiling switch is turned on, it will now display as a normal floor/ceiling to players not registered to that base’s core.
🐛 Fixed an issue where incorrect notifications were shown when constructing slopes with a third party's core area nearby.
🐛 Fixed an issue in the custom server player customization window when applying perk cards.

notes.title: Season 5 is here!!
notes.content:
Season 5 is getting closer! We’re working hard to make sure everything is polished and ready for you all by the beginning of November. We’re adding all sorts of new raiding mechanics including mobs raiding online PvE players’ bases and some big changes to how PvP players go about raiding each others’ bases.



[h1]Get Off Our Island!![/h1]
(PvE servers only… for now) The Hyena forces are tired of survivors stealing their resources! They’ve decided to strike back by sending out dropships to land near player bases and attack. You’ll get a notification that they’re on their way, giving you plenty of time to get back to your base. If you’re offline, they won’t initiate an attack on your base. 

[i](However, if an attack has already started or is about to start, logging out will not stop the attack, so be cautious.)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/85557fea0972a666e03d09e2657aa7975bb1f58d.png[/img]



[h1]Customize the look of your base![/h1]
Make yourself even more at home with the new colors we’ve added to base parts. You can now paint your base yellow, red, or blue! I’m sure you all will find some unique ways to express yourself with these new options. Our team is looking forward to seeing how you use the new palette in your bases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3281e95e1bffed05837aca1f3765307847394c12.png[/img]



[h1]Changes to PvP Raid Mechanics[/h1]
Are you tired of logging in to find that your base was raided while you were away? We’ve changed the tempo of raids in Season 5 to allow for more strategy between players. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3f627abd5bc52ab8bb65db6529263db9484a1900.png[/img]
[h3]Things to know:[/h3]
Raid Protection for your base will automatically activate.
You need a special item or the EMP to deactivate your target’s base protection.

[h3][u][b]How to raid in Season 5[/b][/u][/h3]
In order to raid someone’s base, you’ll need to first deactivate their raid protection. You can do this by either using an EMP whenever you’d like, or by using a new item called a ‘siege jammer’ that will jam the raid protection system’s signals for a short time, allowing you to start your attack.

*Depending on how effective your attack was, your siege jammer will have a longer or shorter cooldown time.

You can now attack bases using any of the game’s siege hammers, or by using one of the 2 guns that uses ‘explosive ammo’: the DMR SW-1, or the AR TFT-K7. In order to do damage to a base, the weapon also needs to be the same tier as the base-part it’s being used on. Weaker weapons won’t be able to inflict damage on higher tier base-parts.



[h1]Faster PvP Gameplay!![/h1]
We’ve cut the length of PvP servers in half. No more will you get on a server only to realize everyone has full gear except you. With a shorter PvP server length, you can have more fun with your friends by hopping onto a fresh server with them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/683de753bc1af14aa1d502d50d3af44849af6e75.png[/img]
[u][b]New PvP Server Lengths[/b][/u]
Minimum length: 7 days
Starting length: 10 days
Maximum length: 15 days



[h1]Dynamic Difficulty![/h1]
Facilities have been a rough challenge for our solo survivors. We recently added dynamic difficulty to the Meteochamber, and with this update we’re adding it to the Satellite Station. Solo survivors will now have an easier time while teams or groups of players tackling the facility together will have to take on significantly more mobs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bb082d07fa6e6d58225a6052379f8bb19a5fb793.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.11
notes.content:
How’s everyone doing today?? What better way to enjoy the crisp Autumn air than to snuggle close to your computer while playing Dysterra. We have some more updates this week to make your life easier, starting with an improvement to grenade throwing. We look forward to seeing you all on the servers!



[h1]Better Grenade Accuracy![/h1]
Throw grenades exactly where you want them to land. Grenades now lose most of their velocity when hitting a wall or landing on the ground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9065df04ace5978016d40eaf7014850a8e4fce55.png[/img]



[h1]Get In the Action Faster[/h1]
For all of you busy players out there, we’ve upgraded the equipment you start with on the Global Uncapped PvP & Global PvP Hardcore servers.

[u][b]New players will start with the following equipment:[/b][/u]
[b]Fine Reinf. Fiber Armor Set[/b]
= Helmet, upper suit, & lower suit (non-repairable)
[b]SMG MMP-500X ECLAIR[/b] (non-repairable)
[b]Light Ammo[/b]: x2000
[b]Dash Protocol[/b]
[b]Healing Protocol[/b]
[b]Canned Meat Stew[/b]



[h1]Level Up[/h1]
Getting your first skill level just got faster! We’ve reduced the xp points required to get to level one for new players to start strategizing their play that much sooner.

[u][b]Pts required to reach level 1[/b][/u]
Before: 1000
Now: 100

[i](Note: The amount of points from level 1 to level 2 remains the same.)[/i]



[h1]Six More New Perks[/h1]
We’ve added 6 new perks to the game:
🎲 Weaponsmith - Blades
🎲 Weaponsmith - Blunts
🎲 Weaponsmith - Short Range Guns
🎲 Weaponsmith - Mid Range Guns
🎲 Weaponsmith - Long Range Guns
🎲 Weaponsmith - Rocket Launchers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7093670bc184b73df7246fcaba528f5ecb92825e.png[/img]

Each of these will add an additional possible level for their corresponding skill, allowing up to 30% or 40% higher max durability when crafting the related weapon type. You’ll now be even more prepared to take on new areas and new enemies knowing you’ll be stronger than ever before with your handy perk!

To encourage their distribution, we’ll be doubling the drop rates of these 6 perks for the next 2 weeks until Wednesday, November 1st.



[h1]Base Repair Improvement[/h1]
If you have a level 2 building core or higher, you’re able to remotely repair parts of your base. We’ve added a notification that will pop up when you’re unable to repair something. It’ll tell you why you can’t: insufficient resources, base part is in cooldown, etc. No more wondering why something isn’t letting you repair it!



[h1]Mob AI[/h1]
Mobs will now continue to chase you even after you hide around corners or somewhere out of sight.



[h1]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h1]
🦋 Frame drop issue when entering build mode with a large number of build parts in the world.
🦋 Optimization for low-end devices experiencing low frames in the lobby. 
🐛 Pistol firing delay wasn’t correctly being applied when while running. 
🐛 Issue where the firing animation is displayed when switching to automatic mode after a single shot in single-shot mode.
🐛 Issue where the timer on the incubator is displayed even when it drops below 0 seconds.
🐛 Incubator issue where the remaining time resets to the moment of reactivation every time the fuel slot is refreshed after stopping and then restarting the operating incubator.
🐛 Level 2 incubator localization issue.
🐛 Issue with item quantity getting cut off by commas when using the UI's Tooltip for Item Split. 
🐛 Durability not functioning correctly when using the Item Split feature with stacks.
🐛 Fixed the issue of XeSS not being applied after restarting the game when activated from the graphics options.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.6
notes.content:
We have another patch for you all! This one includes some more small improvements to polish gameplay as well as a small set of bug fixes. We hope you enjoy the changes!

[h1]Added Nitrado Link in-game[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f3ce4fa7a8c334f1c9c183f07e7496ad3f7ba576.png[/img]
We’ve added two buttons to the lobby’s menus. One is a link to Nitrado.com for less technical players who would like to add a custom server without the hassles that come with hosting your own custom server.

We’ve also added a link to our guide on making a custom server for players to easily access the list of server commands and other necessary information.



[h1]Turrets vs. NPCs = No loot drop[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7f592e17154ad1a122a670f685397933dbd79f16.png[/img]
When a mob dies and more than 50% of damage was caused by a turret, loot will not drop.



[h1]Beware the Axemen[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/be1d694438b70044d37ce4cdcc76c08d9fb6a178.png[/img]
Hyena Axemen can now throw their axes at you.



[h1]Clans: See what you missed[/h1]
You’ll now be able to scroll to see what your clan was talking about while you were away.



[h1]Who Will Lead Us?[/h1]
You can now rest easy knowing that the clan masters may now bequeath their admin rights to a member that they deem worthy.



[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
◀ Fixed bug where Stryder EX only displayed 5 of its 20 inventory slots.
◀ Fixed an issue where the building grid displayed as red if the player died while installing something.
◀ Fixed an issue where turrets would aim at something where there was nothing to aim at.
◀ Fixed issue where other player’s build parts would display in the Integrated Utility Controller.
◀ Fixed issue where manipulating one’s building core through the integrated utility controller resulted in the UI displaying incorrectly.
◀ Removing a 1st story wall will retain the walls above if the surrounding stability factor is stable enough.
◀ Corrected issue where a wall was see-through during animations.
◀ Added an Epic-tier terrasite capsule where one was missing in the Chemochamber.
◀ Changing the world settings to increase resource drops should now take effect immediately.
◀ Single Player: The controllers for the Geolab and Chemochamber should now work properly.
◀ Custom Server: Fixed crash that would occur when setting ‘ConfigurableValues MaxTeamSize’ to ‘0’
◀ Custom Server: Setting the building core invite value to 0 now disables the permanent sharing of core-rights.
◀ Mobs will no longer be able to detect players who are both in their car or behind a wall.
◀ Mobs will no longer jitter when they can’t find a path to the player.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.5
notes.content:
We’re adding more quality of life improvements in this week’s patch.
This week’s patch is focused on player UI. We’re trying to fix a number of common friction points, as well as adding information where it wasn’t being displayed. If you have any ideas for further UI optimization or improvements, please add your ideas to the Season 4 feedback channel on our Discord server!

[h1]Vehicle QOL Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/37c99f4027234f22101706e5a26f427e0f2d69f9.png[/img]
🚗 Headlights and backlights will now turn on or off as soon as you press the forward / backward key, not when your vehicle changes direction.
🚗 Passengers will now also see headlights and backlights turning on or off just as the driver sees them.
🚗 Pressing the brake key will now deactivate the vehicle’s acceleration, effectively putting it in neutral.


[h1]Craft Bandages at Consumable Bench[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/df30fbc3da49f3ed963914388352f71345343fb9.png[/img]
Lv.1 Bandages can now be produced at the Consumable’s Bench at a cost of 2 fiber.


[h1]Repair Bench UI Change[/h1]
Changed the Repair Bench’s UI to reflect durability skill buffs.
Player durability buffs weren’t displayed in the repair bench, but now you can be sure of exactly how strong your guns are, and how long they’ll last when you’re repairing them.


[h1]Perk Name Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2a007f360e8b5ac386cb7b3bb9904475c5f8a712.png[/img]
We renamed the reload speed perks for players to more intuitively understand what it does, and which guns are affected.

[u][b]Previous Names[/b][/u]
Speed Loader - Pistols
Tactical Reload - Assault Rifles
Tactical reload - Sniper Rifles 
Tactical Reload - Rocket Launchers

[u][b]Current Names[/b][/u]
Speed Loader - Short Range Guns
Speed Loader - Mid Range Guns
Speed Loader - Long Range Guns 
Speed Loader - Rocket Launchers


[h1]General Stability Optimization[/h1]
We optimized the code around how base parts communicate stability data to each other.

[h1]Fixes & Optimizations[/h1]
🔹 We changed the name of the “Reactor Engine Box” to the “Maintenance Bay Reactor” to better reflect its location.
🔹 We also added information the the maintenance bay reactor’s description that will give new players a hint about how to get the reactor.

notes.content:
This week’s update is bringing you more inventory slots for crafting, more control over your clan after you’ve created it, and a couple of food-related balancing changes. As always, let us know what you think over on our Discord Channel!


[h1]Crafting Inventory Slots[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c0931ee9be2d380739b09564c739be1922976925.png[/img]
Added inventory slots to higher level workbenches, consumable benches, and forges.

[u]Storage Slots for Completed Items[/u]
Level 1: 5 slots
Level 2: 8 slots
Level 3: 12 slots

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2f0713ff1a1f7f173cc635ec5d48e9e358dddb84.png[/img]



[h1]Edit Clan Info[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/818238e6b1c7a11a71d13fc461d57bde9087c771.png[/img]
You can now edit your clan name, clan tags, and your clan mark in addition to clan’s description and label. Each edit will cost you a small amount of TP, and there will be a 24 hr cooldown time between edits.

Editing your clan’s description or label will cost 0 TP while other edits will require TP.


[h1]Change Clan Member Ranks[/h1]
You can change the ranks of clan members.

There are currently 3 ranks in a clan:
[list]
[*] Clan Master
[*] Administrator
[*] Clan Member
[/list]

The privileges for each rank are:

[u][b]Clan Master:[/b][/u]
🔸 Accept or reject new clan members
🔸 Edit all clan information
🔸 Change rank of any clan member
🔸 Disband clan

[u][b]Administrator:[/b][/u]
🔸 Accept or reject new clan members
🔸 Edit clan description and label only.





[h1]More Canned Ham[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d9a9e7a3058caf4d76e39a43dd33582186ebb7a8.png[/img]
We’ve added Canned Ham to the list of items that can drop from Hyena Dropship soldiers.



[h1]Check the Expiration Date![/h1]
Chocolate Bars and Protein Bars are now considered expired food! They will fill you up and increase your hunger stats, but at the cost of a slight loss of HP.



[h1]Fixes[/h1]
📌 Edited map inaccuracies.
📌 Fixed issue where headshots weren’t being counted on Orbis Heavy Hammerbots.
📌 Removed Armond’s Supply Drop line.
📌 Fixed a bug where players riding the escape rocket were affected by temperature and hunger. It shouldn’t happen anymore.

[h3]Now that Season 4 is well underway, I think it’s time to let you all in on a little secret: We’re already working on Season 5! Our team is excited to hear your thoughts on the different features, and we’re willing to adjust some features if players provide better ideas, so please give your feedback on [url=https://discord.com/channels/790479653294440478/798106584331845641]our Discord server[/url]![/h3]

[h1]🧪 MORE CLAN OPTIMIZATION[/h1]
Soon you’ll be able to edit your clan’s information as well as set specific permissions for clan members.


[h1]🧪 DYNAMIC FACILITY DIFFICULTY[/h1]
Facility difficulty will be dynamic based on player count.

We've noticed a wide disparity in difficulty levels when playing solo or in teams. Therefore, the difficulty and rewards in facilities and other specific areas will now adjust according to the number of players engaging with them.


[h1]🧪 UNIQUE FEATURES FOR PVE[/h1]
Bases in PvE will now have a purpose. We’ll be adding a feature where passing mobs will attempt to attack player bases, giving players a reason to build up their base and even help out their fellow server mates.


[h1]🧪 NEW SKILLS & NEW PERKS[/h1]
We’ll be adding a whole new set of skills and perks in the near future.


[h1]🧪 NEW & UNIQUE WEAPONS[/h1]
Expect new weapons with unique functionality.


[h1]🧪 MORE BASE CUSTOMIZATION[/h1]
Are you tired of your base looking too much like your neighbor’s base? We’re preparing a way for you to add skins to your base’s walls.



[h3]These are all in the earlier phases of development, so please hop over to [url=https://discord.com/channels/790479653294440478/798106584331845641]our Discord server[/url] and let us know what you think. Our team is always listening.[/h3]

notes.title: Everything New in Season 4: Brothers-In-Arms
notes.content:
[h1]Here’s what’s new in[/h1]
[h1][b]‘Season 4: Brothers-In-Arms’[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/af060f296341e8edb3d75835237db23bf778c5a9.png[/img]

Season 4 brings with it a plethora of changes! Namely a complete overhaul of the map, as well as the introduction of a clan system. The season title, “Brothers-in-Arms”, represents the ability for players to work together to achieve their goals as a larger group. 

The content of this season update can be split into 2 categories: Map Changes & New Functionality. That’s why I’ll be splitting this into 2 parts. You can keep reading to learn all about the changes to the map, or scroll down to part two where I introduce all of the new functionality we’re including.




[h1][b]Part 1 of 2: World Map Overhaul[/b][/h1]
[i](Scroll down for ‘Part 2 of 2: Clans, New Skills, and More!’)[/i]


Over the course of early access, we’ve changed and added so many things to the game that we needed to move things around the map and redesign enemy bases to better fit our vision for the game. We really wanted to give players a more intuitive feel for level progression.

That’s why we took the dozens of Hyena and Orbis bases, as well as all of the other landmarks (juggernaut, launch pad, etc.), and condensed them into larger bases while also redesigning them to make them more distinct and unique in their experiences. This means that you’ll be more likely to run into other players while you’re out hunting for materials.



[h2][b]Hyena Bases[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/880b971c6482d4afa3566e098773aec215ddec87.png[/img]
 The Hyena forces are more fortified than ever! Jump from platform to platform as you search for items and try to dodge the bullets being shot at you from other players looking to steal your items.

Each base is a bit different, but many will also be housing the entrance to the Hyena Den.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fbdb5b2af850b76b3ec3c8da21f2d43027843a3d.png[/img]



[h2][b]Infested Bases[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d0fb15e4b57bf714df40c5f4f7f1fb6362235911.png[/img]
The mutants have made their way to the surface and have made their home in a number of Hyena bases. We removed the roadside entrances to the Bunker and placed them inside of infested bases, and also outside of the Chemochamber.


You’ll occasionally run across a Hyena dropship trying to take back their lost territory, so be sure to avoid the crossfire!



[h2][b]Orbis Bases[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bcee4c3a328a3b6ad7080c1644c086525fa451d6.png[/img]
Once you’re geared up and start venturing to the inner parts of the island, you’ll be able to enter the Orbis bases.

The Orbis troops are wary of the mutants getting into their bases, so they’ve settled high above ground to make sure their bases don’t get infested as well. Each circular base is connected by a long structure that houses a number of smaller Orbis facilities.



[h2][b]Launch Pad[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1e01ca54ba8df583b360e1efd5e8bb4cc3e80f16.png[/img]
The interior of the launch pads are now protected by Stompers. You'll have to make your way through them if you want to access the unique items stored inside the base of the launch pads.



[h2][b]Drill Silos[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f124b20265468240277c0391695dde980e837304.png[/img]
We locked the Juggernaut into what we're calling a 'Drill Silo.' It made more sense for it to be guarding some kind of important facility.



[h2][b]Delta Catalyst Vault[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3758f73a606d2c9c15f5fc596577eb5f2fdd1195.png[/img]
Lastly, we’ve replaced the Delta Launch Pad with a new and unique Orbis point of interest. This one’ll be a challenge for quite a few of you, so be sure to prep before you take on the new mobs that are waiting for you.




[h1][u][b]Part 2 of 2: Clans, New Skills, and More![/b][/u][/h1]

Part 1 was all about how much the landscape will be changing in next week’s update. In part 2, I’d like to share all of the new features we’re adding.  Most of them help to round out the game’s content and give players more direction about how to move through their journey on Ararat Island.



[h2][b]Clan System[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/818238e6b1c7a11a71d13fc461d57bde9087c771.png[/img]
You can now manage your in-game friends with our all-new clan system! Clans will be shown in the rankings as well so you can show how strong you and your friends are by rising to the top of the rankings together!



[h2][b]New Base Protection Server-Type[/b][/h2]
Some of you may remember the ‘no-raid’ servers we used to have. We’re bringing them back while also adding a few new improvements, so we felt the name needed a change to suit those changes.

🔹 Slower energy usage in all base cores.
🔹 Higher gathering rates for resources.



[h2][b]A Surplus of Skills[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e626102737b82554b9f2ca8dee91444fa2194b67.png[/img]
We’ve added 25 new skills to the skills menu that range from giving you resistance to different status effects to increasing the max durability of your weapons, armor and protocols when crafted. The crafting skills will definitely help clans work together by allowing different members to build up their mastery in different weapons or armor categories.



[h2][b]Refined Progression System[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6561ea4af0570f60ee052d2fcd00aa15910b762a.png[/img]
We realized that players needed a bit more structure when progressing through the game, so we’re adding a tech-tree system. It’s based primarily around your building core’s level, so you’ll need to have a better building core to be able to craft better items.

This will be useful for newer players to the game by giving them a more distinct pathway to follow when learning the game’s systems. But if you’re more experienced, and are worried that this will ‘cramp your style’, don’t worry! We’ve been careful to make sure the progression feels natural and doesn’t add unnecessary hurdles to the game.


[h2][b]Forge Production Time Reduced[/b][/h2]
We've listened to your feedback and reduced the production time of the Forge. Enjoy faster processing without the wait!
We have enhanced the crafting system and improved the resource balance to achieve this. Now you can experience a more enjoyable crafting process!


[h2][b]New Mob Types![/b][/h2]
With all of the gun-type mobs on Ararat Island, we wanted to add some melee types to round out the experience more. They might seem harmless because they can’t hit you from far away, but some of them can jump pretty far, so be careful!

[h3][b]Axeman[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/be1d694438b70044d37ce4cdcc76c08d9fb6a178.png[/img]

[h3][b]Minerbot & Wardenbot[/b][/h3]
There are also some new super cute new floating robots that’ll zap you if you get too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/42585b8d9defd88fb83c51f1196f2b663a6b8a2b.png[/img]



[h2][b]Buff/Debuff Pills[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3f081b09dd4d1e3850f5baf852bf55123a4d5e0e.png[/img]
In the past, pills were used as a way to instantly restore negative conditions. We’ve modified them to instead give the player certain buffs. The Heat Preventive Pill, for example, will give you resistance to heat status changes for a few minute seconds, but beware! It also makes you more susceptible to cold damage at the same time!

[h3][b]We’ve also added shots back into the game for you to use to remove status effects.[/b][/h3]



[h2][b]New Endings/Scenarios[/b][/h2]
Lastly, we’ve added new content to the tutorial.. ahem.. mission guide, extending the game well past the Hyena Transport Ship portion of the “storyline.” The new story content adds a lot of needed depth to the characters of the game, so be sure to give it a run-through on your next playthrough! It’ll apply to both single-player as well as official servers.



[h2][b]Other Changes:[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Optimizations & Improvements[/b][/h3]
🔹 We’ve improved fps overall for the game.
🔹 Reduced memory usage
🔹 Improved Mailbox functionality: You can now “receive all”.
🔹 Players can breathe longer underwater.
🔹 Rebalanced siege weapons.
🔹 Improved gun recoil.


[h3][b]PvP Ranking Score Balancing[/b][/h3]
🔹 Adjusted ranking score algorithm to alleviate issues with meeting basic conditions for ranking tier rewards.

[h3][b]Animation Enhancements[/b][/h3]
🔹 Improved mantling animations
🔹 New animations to express recoil when firing
🔹 Procedural sway animations based on player movement





[h2][b]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1527890?snr=2_9_100000_][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8ff1423d2785bfd85cdebc89dc911369f5fc0b71.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.com/invite/dysterra][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a500763ea3b8e315ba8c496d9b3d29f74e7e76b5.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.twitch.tv/dysterra_official][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/356e407770e431b8a02fb24c8cf41e686d397ee7.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJaBOjIVuD3zSVdlwDpFifw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6354e8d61cfb84b2c53e2bee9b24fd98f83e7d09.png[/img][/url][url=https://twitter.com/dysterra_ofcl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4623aaf5942e4176bb3b2683da6234890ccfc34e.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.facebook.com/people/Dysterra/100076734611086/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/81808ca2f62529eb2238ccd1ebbe781a199016bd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.5.1
notes.content:
We’ve been elated to see so many positive reactions to the new content in Season 4. We’ve spent the last few days fixing bugs and examining what needs to be rebalanced. This week’s update should take care of most friction points for players. Please hop on over to our Discord to let us know what you think about the changes!

[h1][b]Adjusted transmitter points for terrasite[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/13cd92d8cb9ab0dec9e0e0c7059960ee7177b154.png[/img]
We’ve increased the transmitter’s point reward for Superior Terrasite by 5x.
Terrasite: 5 pts
Fine Terrasite: 50 pts
Superior Terrasite: 2500 pts

[h1][b]No More Enhancing Siege Weapons[/b][/h1]
The following weapons will no longer be able to be enhanced. They are still able to be repaired.
DEMOLITION HAMMER IGX-1
DEMOLITION HAMMER IGXX-100
ENERGY ROCKET LAUNCHER EF83T
ROCKET LAUNCHER UWR-102 
ROCKET LAUNCHER FFM-202

[h1][b]More Broccoli![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2589c731b028a1d1fca9620ddc1e75b8dd69003f.png[/img]
You should now always find one (1) mutant broccoli inside Hyena Base fridges.

[h1][b]Changes to the Earthquake Facility Skill[/b][/h1]
To better balance the Earthquake’s power with its wide radius, we’ve halved its damage stats.

[h1][b]Clan Descriptions Can Be Edited[/b][/h1]
Added a feature allowing the clan leader and administrators to edit the clan description and labels.

[h1][b]Single-Player Save Safety[/b][/h1]
When saving a file in single-player mode, the existing file will be now backed up as an extra layer of protection for players’ progress.

[h1][b]Catalyst Vault Changes[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6bef8a3b24d66bd9b0ee9fb84c30973c2068cd81.png[/img]
When attempting to use the entrance console for the Catalyst Vault, a notification may pop up alerting the user that they are not currently able to enter.
Also, we have removed the expiration time for the Robotic Laser Lens quest item. You may leave and return at a different time if the portal is not currently active.

[h1][b]Fewer pistol drops[/b][/h1]
Pistols found inside of moldy crates will now spawn less frequently.

[h1][b]Reduced CS-01[/b][/h1]
The drop rate of the Compensator CS-01 from Hyena riflemen and shield soldiers has been changed from 15% to 5%.

[h1][b]Picking Up Your Pick-up Truck[/b][/h1]
We changed the materials you’ll receive when “gathering” your broken down Stryder or Stryder EX.
Stryder: 2x Lithium, 2x Cylinder, 16x Metal
Stryder EX:  2x Fine Lithium, 2x Superior Cylinder, 2x Superior Metal

[h1][b]BUGS & FIXES[/b][/h1]
🐛 Fixed issue where some users weren't able to connect to custom servers.
🐛 Bounding Mines and base-parts that give electrical damage will no longer apply to clan members.
🐛 Some old items were still purchasable in the transmitter. We removed them.
🐛 Fixed an issue with daily missions displaying mobs that are no longer in the game. We’ve removed the missions as well as the journal entries for said mobs.
🐛 Fixed an issue where killing shield mobs wasn’t counting toward the daily quest.
🐛 Fixed an issue where 'receive all' function in the mailbox was not accessible due to the absence of a scrollbar when distributing resources.
🐛 Fixed an issue where the triangular electric floor did not attach to the triangular foundation and ceiling.
🐛 Fixed an issue where Level 2 Miners weren’t producing items.
🐛Fixed an issue where only core administrators could use the Vehicle Manufacturing Factory.
🐛Fixed an issue where Hyena mobs that spawned inside apartment housing did not patrol.
🐛 When upgrading the Hacking skill, the proper values were not being applied to hacking attempts. This issue has been fixed.
🐛Fixed an issue where the transmitter could only load item lists in units of 10.

notes.title: Server Maintenance (Hot Fix) 📢
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/95959e101bd29e97f8a981c9ef719cdddb76905c.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements/Changes:[/h2]
[list]

[*] Fixed a bug where consuming food while already full would display the animation.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/af060f296341e8edb3d75835237db23bf778c5a9.png[/img]

[h1][b]Season 4 Starts Now!![/b][/h1]
The long-awaited Season 4 has finally begun, and we're thrilled to unveil the latest update! With so many changes to the world and all of its systems, we'll be taking a bit longer than usual for maintenance to ensure a smooth and enjoyable gaming experience. Our team is working hard to make sure everything is functioning as intended, and we appreciate your understanding during this process.

Keep an eye out for the new notice detailing all the exciting features and enhancements that come with Season 4! We can't wait to share them with you.
    
[h3][u]Expected Maintenance Time[/u][/h3]
PST: July 26, 19:00 - July 27, 03:00
CET: July 27, 04:00 - 12:00
KST: July 27, 11:00 - 19:00
[h3][b]Downtime: 8 hours[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]TerraFire Eruption Countdown Starts[/b][/h3]
PST: July 25, 19:00~
CET: July 26, 04:00~
KST: July 26, 11:00~


[h1][b]Log in Daily to Reap Rewards![/b][/h1]
To celebrate the new season, we’ll be doubling daily login rewards!! Don’t miss out on this chance to get extra Terrapoints to unlock that item you’ve been eyeing! The double-points event will last for 14 days following the release of Season 4 (Until August 3rd).
Note: Daily rewards are calculated based on the 24-hour period starting at midnight, Greenwich Mean Time (GMT).



[h1][b]Weekend Events Are On Hold[/b][/h1]
We left almost nothing untouched when rebalancing the game for this new season. So we will not have any weekend events for the first two weekends following the start of season 4. Please understand that this is to ensure fairness and keep people from climbing up the rankings too quickly at the start of the season.


[h1][b]Resource Return for Single/Custom Servers![/b][/h1]
Due to the world changes in Season 4, not only the Official Servers but also the Single/Custom Servers will undergo a reset. 
However, starting completely from scratch in the Single/Custom Servers is unnecessary, so most of your existing resources will be returned via mailbox. 
This also applies to buildings, as they will be converted into resources and returned to the mailbox.


(Note: This does not apply to Official Servers for fair competition.) 


[h1][b]What’s New in Season 4?[/b][/h1]
[i]Here are the most important things to know when jumping into the game:[/i]

🏔️ The map has been completely renovated, with full redesigns of all types of bases. This is to make sure that inexperienced players don’t needlessly access higher-level areas.

🏰 We now have a clan system in the game. Create your own clan and grow your influence with your fellow clan members!

💊 Pills are now solely for damage prevention, shots are for removing status effects. Furthermore, we've added animations for consuming food items, which means the auto-eating function is no longer available. We understand this might be a bit inconvenient, but we want to assure you that we have plans to introduce additional features for food items in the future. This is just the initial step taken to enhance the gameplay experience with food mechanics.


🛠️ Some higher-level recipes now need a more powerful crafting bench to be unlocked. You’ll need to level up your building core first before you can upgrade your crafting bench. [b]Above all, the production time of the Forge has been reduced![/b]

🏕️ There is now a separate crafting bench for consumables, so don’t forget to build your starter base in a place that allows for easy expansion.

🎯 More skills = more customization. You’ll have more options when leveling up your character’s skills, so have a plan in mind when you start unlocking skills.

⚠️ With the focus on rebalancing the factions, some mobs may be more deadly than they used to be. Be careful not to get killed out there, and be sure to place a sleeping bag so you can quickly respawn nearby.

notes.title: Season 4: Brothers-In-Arms
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/af060f296341e8edb3d75835237db23bf778c5a9.png[/img]
[h3][u][b]Part 2 of 2: Clans, New Skills, and More![/b][/u][/h3]

Our last game note was all about how much the landscape will be changing in next week’s update. This time I’d like to share all of the new features we’re adding.  Most of them help to round out the game’s content and give players more direction about how to move through their journey on Ararat Island.

We’d love to hear what you think about everything we’re adding, especially with such big changes to the game. That’s why we’re also opening some new temporary Season 4 channels on our Discord server to better discuss each of the changes we’ve made. Our whole team is curious to hear your feedback, so [url=https://discord.gg/dysterra]hop on over to our Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!

[h2][i][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/i][/h2]
[i][b]All official servers will be wiped for this new season.[/b][/i] This includes 'uncapped' servers. The Terrafire countdown will begin 24 hours before we begin maintenance.

[i]That means the countdown will be starting at roughly the following times:[/i]
PST: Late Tuesday night (July 25th)
CET: Early Wednesday morning (July 26th)
KST: Early Wednesday afternoon (July 26th)



[h1][b]Clan System[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/818238e6b1c7a11a71d13fc461d57bde9087c771.png[/img]
You can now manage your in-game friends with our all-new clan system! Clans will be shown in the rankings as well so you can show how strong you and your friends are by rising to the top of the rankings together!



[h1][b]New Base Protection Server-Type[/b][/h1]
Some of you may remember the ‘no-raid’ servers we used to have. We’re bringing them back while also adding a few new improvements, so we felt the name needed a change to suit those changes.

🔹 Slower energy usage in all base cores.
🔹 Higher gathering rates for resources.



[h1][b]A Surplus of Skills[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e626102737b82554b9f2ca8dee91444fa2194b67.png[/img]
We’ve added 25 new skills to the skills menu that range from giving you resistance to different status effects to increasing the max durability of your weapons, armor and protocols when crafted. The crafting skills will definitely help clans work together by allowing different members to build up their mastery in different weapons or armor categories.



[h1][b]Refined Progression System[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6561ea4af0570f60ee052d2fcd00aa15910b762a.png[/img]
We realized that players needed a bit more structure when progressing through the game, so we’re adding a tech-tree system. It’s based primarily around your building core’s level, so you’ll need to have a better building core to be able to craft better items.

This will be useful for newer players to the game by giving them a more distinct pathway to follow when learning the game’s systems. But if you’re more experienced, and are worried that this will ‘cramp your style’, don’t worry! We’ve been careful to make sure the progression feels natural and doesn’t add unnecessary hurdles to the game.


[h1][b]Forge Production Time Reduced[/b][/h1]
We've listened to your feedback and reduced the production time of the Forge. Enjoy faster processing without the wait!
We have enhanced the crafting system and improved the resource balance to achieve this. Now you can experience a more enjoyable crafting process!


[h1][b]New Mob Types![/b][/h1]
With all of the gun-type mobs on Ararat Island, we wanted to add some melee types to round out the experience more. They might seem harmless because they can’t hit you from far away, but some of them can jump pretty far, so be careful!

[h2][b]Axeman[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/be1d694438b70044d37ce4cdcc76c08d9fb6a178.png[/img]

[h2][b]Minerbot & Wardenbot[/b][/h2]
There are also some new super cute new floating robots that’ll zap you if you get too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/42585b8d9defd88fb83c51f1196f2b663a6b8a2b.png[/img]



[h1][b]Buff/Debuff Pills[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3f081b09dd4d1e3850f5baf852bf55123a4d5e0e.png[/img]
In the past, pills were used as a way to instantly restore negative conditions. We’ve modified them to instead give the player certain buffs. The Heat Preventive Pill, for example, will give you resistance to heat status changes for a few minute seconds, but beware! It also makes you more susceptible to cold damage at the same time!

[h3][b]We’ve also added shots back into the game for you to use to remove status effects.[/b][/h3]



[h1][b]New Endings/Scenarios[/b][/h1]
Lastly, we’ve added new content to the tutorial.. ahem.. mission guide, extending the game well past the Hyena Transport Ship portion of the “storyline.” The new story content adds a lot of needed depth to the characters of the game, so be sure to give it a run-through on your next playthrough! It’ll apply to both single-player as well as official servers.



[h1][b]Other Changes:[/b][/h1]
[h2]Optimizations & Improvements[/h2]
🔹 We’ve improved fps overall for the game.
🔹 Reduced memory usage
🔹 Improved Mailbox functionality: You can now “receive all”.
🔹 Players can breathe longer underwater.
🔹 Rebalanced siege weapons.
🔹 Improved gun recoil.


[h2]PvP Ranking Score Balancing[/h2]
🔹 Adjusted ranking score algorithm to alleviate issues with meeting basic conditions for ranking tier rewards.

[h2]Animation Enhancements[/h2]
🔹 Improved mantling animations
🔹 New animations to express recoil when firing
🔹 Procedural sway animations based on player movement

notes.title: Season 4 Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h2][b]Part 1: World Map Overhaul[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/892d3c423baa7656d00b2b6e2e56cc77ba6d1638.png[/img]
We’ve changed and added so many things to the game over the course of early access that we needed to move things around the map to better fit our vision for the game. We really wanted to give players a more intuitive feel for level progression.

That’s why we took the dozens of Hyena and Orbis bases, as well as all of the other landmarks (juggernaut, launch pad, etc.), and condensed them into larger bases while also redesigning them to make them more distinct and unique in their experiences. This means that you’ll be more likely to run into other players while you’re out hunting for materials.



[h1][b]Hyena Bases[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/880b971c6482d4afa3566e098773aec215ddec87.png[/img]
 The Hyena forces are more fortified than ever! Jump from platform to platform as you search for items and try to dodge the bullets being shot at you from other players looking to steal your items.

Each base is a bit different, but many will also be housing the entrance to the Hyena Den.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fbdb5b2af850b76b3ec3c8da21f2d43027843a3d.png[/img]



[h1][b]Infested Bases[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d0fb15e4b57bf714df40c5f4f7f1fb6362235911.png[/img]
The mutants have made their way to the surface and have made their home in a number of Hyena bases. We removed the roadside entrances to the Bunker and placed them inside of infested bases, and also outside of the Chemochamber.


You’ll occasionally run across a Hyena dropship trying to take back their lost territory, so be sure to avoid the crossfire!



[h1][b]Orbis Bases[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bcee4c3a328a3b6ad7080c1644c086525fa451d6.png[/img]
Once you’re geared up and start venturing to the inner parts of the island, you’ll be able to enter the Orbis bases.

The Orbis troops are wary of the mutants getting into their bases, so they’ve settled high above ground to make sure their bases don’t get infested as well. Each circular base is connected by a long structure that houses a number of smaller Orbis facilities.



[h1][b]Launch Pad[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1e01ca54ba8df583b360e1efd5e8bb4cc3e80f16.png[/img]
The interior of the launch pads are now protected by Stompers. You'll have to make your way through them if you want to access the unique items stored inside the base of the launch pads.



[h1][b]Drill Silos[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f124b20265468240277c0391695dde980e837304.png[/img]
We locked the Juggernaut into what we're calling a 'Drill Silo.' It made more sense for it to be guarding some kind of important facility.



[h1][b]Delta Catalyst Vault[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3758f73a606d2c9c15f5fc596577eb5f2fdd1195.png[/img]
Lastly, we’ve replaced the Delta Launch Pad with a new and unique Orbis point of interest. This one’ll be a challenge for quite a few of you, so be sure to prep before you take on the new mobs that are waiting for you.





[h2][b]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1527890?snr=2_9_100000_][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8ff1423d2785bfd85cdebc89dc911369f5fc0b71.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.com/invite/dysterra][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a500763ea3b8e315ba8c496d9b3d29f74e7e76b5.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.twitch.tv/dysterra_official][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/356e407770e431b8a02fb24c8cf41e686d397ee7.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJaBOjIVuD3zSVdlwDpFifw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6354e8d61cfb84b2c53e2bee9b24fd98f83e7d09.png[/img][/url][url=https://twitter.com/dysterra_ofcl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4623aaf5942e4176bb3b2683da6234890ccfc34e.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.facebook.com/people/Dysterra/100076734611086/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/81808ca2f62529eb2238ccd1ebbe781a199016bd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.9
notes.content:
We’re getting really close to revealing what we’ve been working on for our next big update. I’ll be sharing a little about what we’re preparing later this week in a separate game note. For this week’s patch, we have a couple balance changes and bug fixes. If dummy decoys or bounding mines are in your armory, keep on reading. 



[h1][b]Improved Mob Battle AI[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b28543d0759b0f7b72e94b049ce6654280252c84.png[/img]
Some Orbis and Hyena mobs only shot their guns while standing still. We’ve put them through training, and they’re now able to shoot while running, especially while dodging the player’s aim.



[h1][b]Dummy Decoy Duration Changes[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8e913e1e2007ea710565838387649fff6c9abc7.png[/img]
Small adjustments were made with the goal of ensuring better balance across a variety of situations. The active duration of Dummy Decoys has been slightly reduced to help them be more tactical, and to reduce clutter when several are used.


[h3][u][b]New Dummy Decoy Active Duration[/b][/u][/h3]
🚀 Lv.1: 2 minutes (120 sec)
🚀 Lv.2: 5 minutes (300 sec)



[h1][b]Bounding Mines Not Affected By EMP[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6da1951c87e1f8d283bfc7ebccf4d91371ccb736.png[/img]
Defending your base and your possessions is priority #1 on Ararat island. The last thing anyone wants is to log in and find that someone has touched their stuff. You can rest a little more easily knowing that bounding mines will no longer be affected by EMPs. They’ll stay powered at all times, ensuring that any intruder to your base will have to think twice before approaching your front door.



[h1][b]Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.8
notes.content:
It’s patch time again! We’ve got some new, top-tier weapon attachments, some quality of life fixes to mob looting, the transmitter store, and fixed a couple of bugs. We’ll be making a major announcement in the next week or two, so keep your eyes peeled!



[h1][b]4 New Attachments![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bb01607a48a9b3a94e75cae7e9933023dd6088ba.png[/img]
We’ve added 4 new, yellow-tier attachments: a silencer, a compensator, a vertical grip, and an extended magazine. These will be found in facilities where you used to find the purple tier attachments. Except for the extended magazine, they are not craftable. You’ll have to find them at facilities.

[h2]Stats:[/h2]
[h3]Silencer SI-05[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bullet Speed: -4%
[*] Recoil Control: +4%
[/list]
[h3]Compensator CS-05[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bullet Speed: -4%
[*] Recoil Control: +14%
[/list]
[h3]Vertical Grip VTG-05[/h3]
[list]
[*] Aiming Speed: -4%
[*] Recoil Control: +14%
[/list]
[h3]Extended Magazine HM-02[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extra Ammo: + 50%
[*] Reloading Speed -6%
[/list]



[h1][b]ADS Fix[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/50c43f91d6cc1dc4cbfef9529f24a9ddb2de4fbc.png[/img]
We fixed some sight issues when zooming in with gun sights (aim down sights) on the following guns:
[olist]
[*]SMG MMP-500X ECLAIR
[*]Energy DMR
[*]ENERGY ASSAULT RIFLE EC MK-III 
[/olist]



[h1][b]Transmitter Duplicates Be Gone![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/27b443cb90c5c8875927aaa069d76a5263fbe3c2.png[/img]
Each day, the transmitter displays the items of the day, but it would show 2 or 3 of the same item on rare occasions.

We rewrote the transmitter’s code to make sure that each item in the daily item list is different.



[h1][b]Loot Stealing in PVE Mode? Never again![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f4af14f752c922f3da56c3134784ea8f6c572682.png[/img]
To prevent loot stealing, especially with facility bosses, we’ve added a new feature to PvE servers where only the player that inflicted the most damage on an enemy can take that enemy’s loot.

This does not apply to people on your team, so anyone on the team of the person who inflicted the most damage will also have the right to loot the mob in question.




[h1][b]Added casting time for pills[/b][/h1]
Until now, there has been no casting time when using a number of medical items, specifically pills.

When using pills during combat, the absence of a casting time did not align with our intended balance for the game. Therefore, we have added a short casting time and animations when using medications, similar to with bandages and syringes.



[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
🔹 Fixed a bug where specific resources in hacking boxes were being duplicated during the Terra Fire countdown as well as during 2x resource events.

🔹 Fixed issue where mobs would not disappear when the Hyena dropship disappeared.

🔹 Fixed issue where explosion damage was not applied to the 1st and 2nd floor cores in the Chemical Outpost.

🔹 Fixed issue where Ground Stabilization applied excessive repair amount to building parts.

🔹 Fixed issue where crafting stations couldn't recognize crafting materials during the crafting process.

🔹 Fixed issue where a player’s inventory slot count was not increased after acquiring the Big Bag skill.

🔹 Fixed issue where the crafting station UI showed insufficient energy after destroying one’s core and installing a new one.

🔹 Fixed issue where general items in the transmitter were not displayed correctly.

notes.content:
It’s another small patch as our office is hard at work preparing for our next major update. We hope you all are enjoying your Summers (or Winters if you’re in the Southern Hemisphere). 
This patch contains a modification to the lobby’s server menu, as well as some other small bug fixes.

Please remember to take a short break every once in a while to stand up, stretch, and maybe look out of your window at something far away for 30 seconds.



[h1][b]Server Menu Change[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ed50ce87757326947964be61a150cf94e02eea14.png[/img]
Showing the number of players on a server could be abused to determine if bases on a server are empty. That’s why we’ve decided to remove the exact number of people online at a specific time, and replace it with the “Population” state. This way it’s best for pvp players so they can always have the expectation that someone is in the base they’re about to loot.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.5
notes.content:
We are thrilled to bring you the latest update for DYSTERRA, packed with exciting new features, improvements, and bug fixes. This update introduces an enhanced Perk System, empowering players to level up their perks for additional effects and faster progression. The Hologram Decoy receives an update, allowing turrets and mobs to recognize it as a threat. We've also expanded the Titanium acquisition path, making it easier to obtain both fine and regular Titanium. Additionally, we've made various improvements and addressed several bugs to enhance your gameplay experience. Read on for more details!

Here's a breakdown of what to expect:

[h1][b]Enhanced Perk System:[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b494565037c4356649b661b3c674a21f55a21fc8.png[/img]
Introducing the new Perk Upgrade feature.
Players can now level up their perks by using three cards of the same level and TP to ascend their gameplay to the next level.
Leveling up grants random [u]additional [/u]effects, aiding your progression in the game.



[h1][b]Hologram Decoy Update:[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8e913e1e2007ea710565838387649fff6c9abc7.png[/img]
Turrets and NPCs now recognize decoys as hostile entities and will attempt to attack them. Since attacking a ‘hologram’ shouldn’t be possible, we’re changing its name to ‘Dummy Decoy’. Use dummy decoys strategically in housing areas or in areas with high mob density to divert their attention and gain a tactical advantage.



[h1][b]Expanded Titanium Acquisition Path:[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d159259f4d0afd680af39152d40c62fc1c8a5464.png[/img]
Obtaining fine and regular titanium has become more accessible. Defeat Juggernauts to obtain fine titanium, and acquire regular titanium through advanced supply pods.



[h1][b]Weapons Balancing[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5ac817cf5b85aa2fee86088c4023c4beed93b51a.png[/img]
After carefully evaluating player feedback and analyzing gameplay data, we have identified an opportunity to further enhance the balance of our game. As part of our ongoing efforts to ensure an optimal gaming experience, we have made adjustments to the siege hammers and their impact on housing walls. These changes aim to fine-tune the gameplay mechanics and provide a more balanced and enjoyable experience for all players.


[h2]Please take note of the following changes:[/h2]
[h3]Siege Hammer IGX-1:[/h3]
Attack Power: 90 pts
Housing Multiplier: 100% ➡️ 78%
Housing Attack Power: 90 pts ➡️ 70 pts

[h3]Siege Hammer IGXX-100:[/h3]
Attack Power: 110 pts
Housing Multiplier: 200% ➡️ 132%
Housing Attack Power: 220 pts ➡️ 145 pts



[h1][b]Additional Improvements:[/b][/h1]

🔹 In Single Player mode, pressing the system menu (ESC) now pauses the world.

🔹 In the lobby, clicking ‘continue’ in the single player menu will open the world settings options.

🔹 Increased the maximum HP of the Integrated Utility Controller from 1,000 to 5,000. (The increase in max HP does not mean a reduction in the existing HP.) Any Integrated Utility Controllers that are currently installed can be reinforced through repairs to match the increased maximum HP.

🔹Notification added when attempting to gather items while inventory is full.

🔹 Reduced Satellite Station cooldown time, as well as the expiration time of the Satellite Station Chip from 5 hours to 2 hours.

🔹 Enhanced mantling mechanics, expanding the allowable range and increasing speed.

🔹 Improved animation responsiveness when acquiring resources while holding a firearm.

🔹 Adjusted firearm sound effects to match magazine consumption. (i.e. 5 bullets = 5 shots heard)



[h1][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]

🔹 Fixed an issue where vehicles could pass through the surfaces when at high speeds.

🔹 Resolved an issue where ¼ foundations could be built on top of base foundations.

🔹 Fixed instances where turrets connected to certain building cores would mistakenly target friendly entities (= players registered to the building core).

🔹 Addressed an issue where post-teleportation invincibility time was canceled upon entering the escape rocket immediately after teleportation.

🔹 Resolved an issue where trees would regenerate on top of foundations.

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We hope you enjoy this update and wish you the best of luck in your survival journey!

notes.title: Notice to Players
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]Notice to Players[/u][/b][/h1]
[b]Underwater Base Placement Restrictions[/b]

Dear Survivors,

We would like to address an issue regarding the placement of bases underwater. Please note that placing cores, turrets, chests, or any other functional equipment(forges, recyclers, etc.) underwater is not allowed.

1. Placing foundations, walls, etc. underwater [b]IS [/b]allowed.
2. Due to the unfair advantage against looting, cores, turrets, chests, and other [i][u]non-decorative items[/u][/i] must all be [b]above the water line[/b] at all times.

If your base violates the above guidelines, we kindly request that you relocate your base by this Wednesday evening at 12:00 midnight (PST) (= Thursday, 9:00 AM in Europe, Thursday, 4:00 PM in Korea).

Failure to comply will result in the destruction of all base parts, including cores, turrets, and storage containers, located underwater.

Furthermore, please be aware that any player found installing cores underwater after this notice will be considered as exploiting bugs and will be dealt with accordingly.

Thank you for your attention and cooperation in maintaining a fair gaming environment.

Best regards, The DYSTERRA Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.4
notes.content:
Our development team in Korea is hard working on optimizing the game for future updates, so this week’s patch is a bit small. We’re patching the map to eliminate unfair bases, as well as making some small changes to the mob loot drop table.

[h1][b]Unfair Base Locations Gone![/b][/h1]
Players were building their bases in unfair locations, often using bugs to build in locations where it was completely impossible to attack their base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/676c616433f67deb9c84cc2c24c5dbccc3d00cbe.png[/img]

We’ve blocked off areas that we deemed overly unfair to make sure that everyone has a chance at being looted. We may have missed some spots, though, so let us know if you find a base that is 100% impossible to attack, and we’ll patch that spot up.

We still want the map to have easily defendable locations, and hidden locations. The goal of this update is simply to eliminate spots around the map that were impossible to loot.


[h1][b]Changes to Mob Drops[/b][/h1]
Please note that some mob drops have changed. Low-level Hyena troops can now drop both Silicon Fiber and Microparts. Stompers will now drop Fine Silicon Fiber.

[h1][b]Fixes and Improvements[/b][/h1]
🔹 Fixed issue where turrets weren’t attacking NPCs.

We’ve been working on a new mob! I can’t quite reveal when this cute guy’ll be in the game, but I’m excited to see a new non-humanoid mob in the game!
