notes.title: Important Notice Regarding Building Placement and Core Removal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/39c08efa68e644358e45ace052cd03887a69db48.jpg[/img]
[h3][i][u][b]Important Notice Regarding Building Placement and Core Removal[/b][/u][/i][/h3]

Dear Survivors,

We would like to address an issue that has come to our attention regarding unfair practices in building placement within the game. It has come to our attention that some players have constructed their homes (i.e., installed building cores) in areas that were intended to be inaccessible.

[h2][b]tl;dr:[/b][/h2] [i]Some players are building bases in areas that are [u]impossible to raid[/u]. We plan on blocking access to these locations. If your base is in such a location, and you don’t move your base by Monday, June 5th, you’ll be out of luck, and have to start over from scratch. If you’re unsure about your base location, message Dev_Armond your X,Y coordinates, and he’ll let you know.[/i]


In order to rectify this situation and maintain a fair and balanced gameplay experience for all, we have decided to implement the following measures:

[h1][b]Relocation Grace Period:[/b] 🕑[/h1]
Players who have built their homes in these restricted areas will be given a grace period to relocate their dwellings lasting until June 5th, 0:00 AM (PST) . During this time, you will have the opportunity to move your homes to a permissible location.

[h1][b]Core Removal:[/b] 💥[/h1]
Following the grace period, our development team will directly remove the building cores in the restricted areas. Please be aware that in the next update, access to these areas will be restricted, and building in said locations will no longer be possible.


We understand that this decision may inconvenience some players. However, it is necessary to maintain fairness and ensure an enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. We urge affected players to take advantage of the relocation grace period and move their homes accordingly.

If you encounter similar instances of impossible-to-raid locations in other areas, we kindly request that you report them via DM to our Discord channel "Dev_Armond." Our QA team and I will promptly review and address these reports.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation in creating a fair and balanced gaming environment. We appreciate your support.

[h2]Kindly,[/h2]
The DYSTERRA Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/60ea079ac8f601b3c5cad4ffe2b26de3e35a05c6.png[/img]

The LOOT-a-LOT is over. 😢
It was so exciting to see everyone working together for a common purpose, and we had a hoot watching you try to shoot and loot our base. 

A good portion of our team is taking a much-needed break after playing Dysterra with you all over the weekend, so this week’s patch is mostly just event rewards and basic bug fixes, with a notable change to turrets.

[h1][b]LOOT-a-LOT Event Rewards![/b][/h1]

Thanks to everyone who joined the LOOT-a-LOT event!! We had a great time fighting against you all, and were happy to see so many players that were CLEARLY very skilled at raiding bases.

In this week’s patch, you’ll be receiving your rewards for the event. Please remember that you had to be logged in to the event server at the moment the Devs’ building core was destroyed in order to receive ‘1’ loot point (for a maximum of 3 points). Players with 3 points or more will receive the sum of all listed rewards. If there is a problem with your rewards, please email us your steam ID number and a description of your issue at community_dysterra@realitymagiq.com.

As promised, the rewards are as follows:
Scroll down to learn more about the new armor recipe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dabb4eb43f8a353954b74daa3fe574dbb23cd8b2.png[/img]




[h1][b]New Armor[/b][/h1]
This isn’t your grandma’s Fine Metal Suit! The ‘Fine Metal Suit [Golden]’ is not a skin, it’s a better version of the Fine Metal Suit, with its own better stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c0acaf7bc206f9633fcc3b1a4f2426878637ebfb.png[/img]
[b]We’re giving the recipe out to players who succeeded at least twice in last weekend’s Loot-a-lot event.[/b]

[b]Energy[/b]:   86%
[b]Bleeding[/b]: 19%
[b]Fracture[/b]:	25%
[b]Radiation[/b]: 0%



[h1][b]Rewards change if you ride the rocket[/b][/h1]

[h3]This one is just a reminder:[/h3]
As I stated when we introduced Perks, you’ll get different levels of Perk Pack depending on your ranking when your server expires. If you get on the rocket at the end, your level of Perk Pack goes up 1 tier. The Perk feature has a maximum level of Lv. 3, and the higher-tier Perk Packs vary by changing the probability of obtaining higher-level perks.

Jump on over to [url=https://dysterra.fandom.com/wiki/Perks]our still-under-construction wiki[/url] to read all about perks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/51004157104f3061aa2a3f71fbe32cc9e82e593d.png[/img]

We’ve also made changes to the ‘scoreboard’ at the end of a server’s lifespan to show you which reward you’re getting.

We wanted holograms to be more useful. The hologram base’s hit box was too small, so we changed where you can now shoot the decoy image to destroy it. We hope you all make good use of this new feature.

[i]Note: Since shooting a hologram isn’t possible, we’re also changing the name to Dummy Decoy. [/i]

🔹 Fixed an issue with dragging and dropping gun components.

🔹 Fixed an issue with placing ¼ and triangle foundations.
🔹 Set a max FPS for the game lobby.

notes.title: LOOT-a-LOT Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/df82dcc685992b36b8c7a452877d1bbb23028116.png[/img]
[h1][b]We’re getting ready to have our second-ever event weekend![/b][/h1]


The ‘LOOT-a-LOT Event’ is a series of 2-hour special servers where players battle to invade a base built by, and defended by, our dev team! If you succeed in destroying our building core, everyone on the server will receive a reward! [i][b]Read on to learn more.[/b][/i]

For 3 nights this weekend (Fri, Sat, & Sun), we’ll be holding a series of 2-hour special event servers separately on US and Europe servers. The event will happen a total of 6 times, once each evening at 6-8pm CET time on a Europe-based server, and once each evening at 6-8pm PST on a North America-based server.

[h2]This is your chance to earn some precious TP for new recipes and perks![/h2]

You’ll be ready to raid bases sooner than you’d expect! We’ve adjusted the following settings to make looting and gathering faster, and also to make base building more straight-forward during the event.

[h2][b]Gathering Rate: 5x
Housing Damage: 5x

[h3]*Note: Participation in this event will have zero effect on your global ranking.[/h3]



[h1][u][b]When is it? 🕒[/b][/u][/h1]
May 26 - May 28 (3 days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday)

[u][b]America Server[/b][/u]
7 pm - 9 pm Pacific Time
(10 pm - 12 pm Eastern Time)

[u][b]Europe Server[/b][/u]
7 pm - 9 pm CET



You’ll be starting each evening with the following items:

[list]
[*] Crafting Bench
[*] Building Core
[*] bandages x 50
[*] light ammo x 500
[*] AR TAR-1A
[*] Stone x 300
[*] Bolts x 300
[/list]


[h1][u][b]Rewards 🏆[/b][/u][/h1]
[h3]It’s ‘Everyone vs. The Devs.’[/h3]

Whoever is logged into the server when (or if!) our building core is destroyed, will receive 1 Loot point. Players not logged in at the moment our building core is destroyed will not receive a point for that session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dabb4eb43f8a353954b74daa3fe574dbb23cd8b2.png[/img]

If you get 3 or more Loot Points, you’ll receive 1500 TP, and the recipe to a new ‘golden’ type of Fine Metal Suit that is stronger than any other current Blue-Tier armors. (Please note that the reward will be the same for anyone with 3 or more points.)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3304168dfda00e9f5ee7e1e5a140a7bcc6402df7.png[/img]

Did you install several turrets only for them to be rendered useless with an EMP? Are you tired of them needing to be manually turned back on after an EMP? Well worry no more! This update is here to help. We’ve made several changes to help offline raids be less of a headache to those of you that have invested precious hours of your time into designing and creating your bases.


[strike][h3][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Thursday, May 25th[/b]
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00
(KST) 16:00-18:00[/strike]

Due to an issue with Thursday's Maintenance, the patch has been delayed by 1 day.

[h3][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Thursday, May 25th[/b]
(PST) 10:00-00:00
[b]Friday, May 26th[/b]
(CET) 07:00-09:00
(KST) 14:00-16:00


[h1][b]Base Parts Turn Back On[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/75f3069c3e322f0ca3841207fdcff829452635d6.png[/img]
Before, equipment in your base would stay off after an EMP shockwave. We’ve changed it so that everything that was on, turns back on after an EMP.



[h1][b]Lvl 1 Turret Recipes Changed [/b][/h1]
We made the cost of level 1 turrets (light ammo, energy, shotgun) all the same. Technically, we lowered the cost of the more expensive lvl 1 turrets to match the cost of the light ammo turrets.



[h1][b]Satellite Cooldown Time Increase[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0049f2f4fce40c8654c697e56c21a0833dbf50ec.png[/img]
We changed the cooldown time for the Satellite Station from 1 hour to 5 hours. This should slightly reduce the overall supply of EMP controllers.



[h1][b]Nerfed Siege Hammers[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5ac817cf5b85aa2fee86088c4023c4beed93b51a.png[/img]
Looting offline players with siege hammers was a bit too quick and cheap, so we rebalanced siege hammers to make looting take just a little bit longer, and require a couple more siege hammers.

[h2][i][b]IGX-300[/b][/i][/h2]
[u][b]Recipe changes[/b][/u]
Fine Metal          20 -> 25
Fine Microparts  2 -> 5
Fine Titanium     0 -> 2

[u][b]Repair Recipe[/b][/u]
Fine Metal          1 -> 1
Fine Microparts  1 -> 1
Fine Titanium     0 -> 1


[h2][i][b]IGXX-300[/b][/i][/h2]
[u][b]Recipe changes[/b][/u]
Superior Metal          3 -> 7
Superior Microparts  1 -> 3
Superior Titanium     2 -> 5

[u][b]Repair Recipe[/b][/u]
(no change)


[h1][b]Get More Fiber![/b][/h1]
We increased the spawning rate of fiber materials, so you can expect to find more on your next trip around the map.


[h1][b]Other changes and optimizations:[/b][/h1]
🔹 Increased the amounts of goodies in satellite station containers
🔹 Rebalanced drop rates of Orbis Station AssaultGuards/Gunshield Guards.
🔹 Rebalanced drop rates for Hyena Scouts/Gunshielders
🔹 Slightly increased the overall area around the map that can be used to build on.
🔹 Increased the max downward aiming angle of the player character from the original 60 degrees to 80 degrees.

[h1][b]Bugs[/b][/h1]
🔹 Fixed issue where TFT-K7 was not inflicting the correct amount of damage to other players.
🔹 Fixed issue with Recycler where it could be installed where it shouldn’t be.
🔹 Lvl 1 floors/ceilings will no longer take extra bolts when being constructed.
🔹 Machine Arm skins should now show appropriately again.
🔹 Fixed an issue where loading with the "Continue Single Player" option would not load the existing character and instead reopen the customization window.

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c2a911ea791d90dabb198c01e5fcae7bcb39da9b.png[/img]

We hope you’re all enjoying the plethora of new content we added to the game last week. This week has even more in store, including more in the store! We’ve added 3 new sets of armor, the ability to reset your character, and fixed a number of bugs.

[h3][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Thursday, May 18th[/b]
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00
(KST) 16:00-18:00


[h1][b]Reset Your Character![/b][/h1]
Are you unhappy with your character’s skills? Do you wish you could equip new or different perks? Well now you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/147b62a6848f58e004bbfbf20b790a051c85558c.png[/img]
We’ve added a new feature that allows survivors to redesign your character, reset any equipped perk cards, and even reset your characters skill points for you to redistribute them. Don’t worry, the first reset is free for each server, but subsequent resets will consume more and more TP(terrapoints/lobby currency) each time you reset your character on a given server. The cost will reset to zero after each Terrafire, so feel free to experiment and try different perks and skill stragtegies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/789d2bdbdc0d06546011abac74bf74816c44534c.png[/img]



[h1][b]New Legendary Armor: Titanica[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d6e7501a2b32316ad18d0a60d000efc80bfab94e.png[/img]
We’ve introduced 3 new sets of armor. These sets have strong energy resistance and excellent durability but are susceptible to explosion damage. One set will be craftable by default, another set’s recipe will need to be unlocked through the lobby store, and the third can only be acquired by purchasing it at a terrasite transmitter.

[i]We’re experimenting with implementing new ways to acquire armor types and skins, so let us know what you think on our Discord server![/i]



[h1][b]Terra Shop Update[/b][/h1]
We simplified the lobby’s Terra Shop interface by combining similar items into respective recipe boxes! We’ve also removed the Orbis Containers, and replaced them with recipe boxes that are sorted by skin-style, but include a variety of other skin recipes. If you like argyle patterns, you can buy an argyle skin recipe, and if you like skull patterns, you can try purchasing a skull skin box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9941ddfd4fd25840c86851b461988abb45c39209.png[/img]
This will help people purchase what they want without being overwhelmed by a super-long list of items. That’s why we’ve also organized all of the housing decor into a single random box for users to purchase.



[h1][b]Improvements and Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]

🔹 TerraShop: Removal of random boxes and addition of new random boxes.
🔹 Orbis Boxes: Removal of Orbis Boxes and addition of skin-themed boxes.
🔹 Discontinuation of individual sale of facility recipes and addition of facility boxes.
🔹 Fixed animation glitches occurring with certain NPCs.
🔹 Adjusted the amount of required materials for crafting 5-Tier equipment helmets and shoes.
🔹 Changed amount of fine titanium required for crafting fine alloy armor helmet from 20 to 10.
🔹 Fixed frame drop issue that occurred near EMP towers.
🔹 Changed description for Steam achievement related to using Terrasite Transmitters in order to reflect their new functionality.
🔹 Fixed issue where vehicle explosions ignore player armor stats. Players should now receive less damage depending on the explosion stat of their equipped armor.

notes.title: Season 3: Cybernetics Augmented
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/274a3568dec7db0729fedb2d80302a6a19041c0c.png[/img]

[h2]Get ready for Season 3: Cybernetics Augmented![/h2]

If you’ve been following our patch notes for a while, you’d know that we’ve been working on a major update for the game. With new content comes new responsibilities, so we’ve also decided that now is the best time to reset the rankings and start a new season on May 12th!

There’s a lot in this update, but my personal favorite is perks! Dysterra now has a way for players to level up their characters outside of their servers!  We’re also introducing uncapped servers, so if the majority of players on a server don’t want to wipe, they can work together to extend the life of the server indefinitely. Keep reading to learn more about what’s new!


[h1][b]Perk up your character[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2a007f360e8b5ac386cb7b3bb9904475c5f8a712.png[/img]
Are you ready to take your gameplay to the next level? Our game's latest feature, "Perks," is here to give you the boost you need! Perks are powerful items that can help you unlock your character's full potential and stand out among other survivors.

[h3]Note: Perks are currently only available on official servers. Single-player and Custom Servers will be supported in the near future.[/h3]

Each perk has two features, one to give you a head start when starting a new server, and another to give you an advantage in the later stages of gameplay. With perks, you can start a new server with a skill point already slotted for a particular skill(eg. Healing Speed) , and you can increase your character's maximum skill level for a specific skill(eg. Rocket launcher reload speed) so you’ll be able to upgrade it 4 times instead of the usual 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3a40acba82e92798d2f10ea1c6a74deabcccde37.png[/img]

And the best part is: Perks will be available for purchase in the game lobby’s Terra Shop. So be sure to head over to the lobby after we update on Friday, and get ready to dominate the servers like never before! If you want even better perks, you can get them after your server’s terrafire event. Higher server rankings will result in better perks as a reward, and successfully boarding the escape rocket will result in an extra boost to the quality of the perk you receive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dfaacd69d35b507028f1b3a45a378cdd143688d7.png[/img]

[h3]Learn more about [url=https://dysterra.fandom.com/wiki/Perks]how perks work[/url] on our Fandom Wiki.[/h3]


[h3][u][b]Skill Changes[/b][/u][/h3]
Due to the implementation of perks, we’re also making some balancing changes to skills.

[b]Max Skill Level: [/b]   Lvl. 86 -> Lvl. 70
[b]XP Required for 1st Skill Level: [/b]   850 -> 1000
[b]Total XP required to reach Max Level:[/b]    484,040 -> 475,810



[h1][b]Faster Farming during Terrafire Countdown[/b][/h1]
We’ve increased the amount of items you’ll receive during the final countdown. Everything will be gathered at 200% except select items including weapons, armor, quest items, or protocols.
This may cause some issues with inventory management, so anything over your maximum stack size will be discarded.


[h1][b]New Server Type With No Upper Limit[/b][/h1]
A large number of players have expressed a desire for servers with lifespans that can be extended indefinitely. We’ve been listening and are happy to be releasing “uncapped” servers. They’ll still have a minimum lifespan of 14 days to prevent abuse of facility skills, but the maximum lifespan cap has been removed. With the addition of new servers, we’ve decided to remove South America PvP to keep server populations in the Americas from thinning out across too many servers. 

We’ll be including both PvE and PvP versions, so you’ll have plenty of time to build the base of your dreams, no cap. 



[h1][b]New Season![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/274a3568dec7db0729fedb2d80302a6a19041c0c.png[/img]
We’re starting a new season with this update. That means all servers will be wiped regardless of the time remaining on the countdown timer. 
Rankings will also be set back to zero during our maintenance.

Anyone that logs in after the update will also get one(1) free perk to get them started!



[h1][b]New Area to the Bunker![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c469ba071ad7206fe20403df7562a4944fd61d61.png[/img]
We’ve added a third area to the bunker! Inside the new portal, you’ll find unique rare items to help you manage your base, but be sure to give it a visit after you’ve defeated everything else in the bunker’s 2nd section (including the variant), or you just might needlessly die.



[h1][b]New Type of Hacking Box![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/91d17dcc3b2f56ad1bf97e3dddf04bb88638fb6a.png[/img]
The new hacking box is called a ‘Pioneer Cryptex’. And inside it is sealed a very useful endgame item that our more experienced survivors will certainly appreciate: a terrasite crystal that powers your Building Core by 300,000 units. (Fine Terrasite = 5,000 units)



[h1][b]New Enemy : The Marauder![/b][/h1] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f3e1a728ead569d533e989e5a7906c4cfec6a85a.png[/img]
Be sure to bring a friend when you enter the new deep, dark area of the bunker. The Marauder is the Variant’s bigger, scarier older brother. He’ll tear you apart if you don’t come ready for a fight.

Once you finally manage to defeat a marauder, you’ll get a special item that can be used at the Terrasite Transmitter for a very generous amount of points.



[h1][b]Transmitter Changes 🏃‍♂️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/27b443cb90c5c8875927aaa069d76a5263fbe3c2.png[/img]
If you’re lonely, look to the skies! Using one of the terrasite transmitters with a pole on top of it will result in a flash of light that will alert other players to your presence. It flashes every time you make a transaction, so be careful and watch your back!

We’re changing transmitters so that you can send regular items to supply the Orbis satellite. The upper-class citizens of Orbis are more than happy to pay extra units for vintage and rare items like the rings you can find on the new Marauder mob.

We’re also changing the transmitter’s item selection to where it will refresh every 24 hours (real-world time).

There are also now some transmitter-use-only items in the game, so be sure to check an item’s description when you find something new.



[h1][b]New Base-parts 🏠[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fa38e97a5c4e821e2dda8385ddfbc872446022b8.png[/img]
We’ve added ramp walls to the game. You’ll now be able to add slanted roofs to your builds to provide extra coverage from attacks from above, or you can layer them in between two regular walls to create a new type of honeycombing defense. Be creative and let us know what new uses you find for our new wall-types!

Also, you no longer need bolts to repair your base!



[h1][b]Frag Grenades are the new Siege Weapon 💥🏠[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7015662a5e6f2daf474f01f2f145f114fb3eb46f.png[/img]
Several players have expressed frustration about the inability to eliminate turrets when looting. In our search for balance, we’ve decided that frag grenades are the best option for turret attacks. So don’t forget to bring a stack or two for your next looting run!



[h1][b]Safer PvE! ✌️[/b][/h1]
Facility skills that cause damage to other players are being removed completely from PvE servers. You should now be able to build your base in peace, and enjoy meeting your neighbors as you level up through the game. (Please note that all skills remain unchanged on PvP servers.)

[h3][u][b]Affected Skills[/b][/u][/h3]
[h3]Chemochamber - Dust Storm[/h3]
🔹Will only affect mobs.

[h3]Geolab: Seismic Waves[/h3]
🔹Will not damage player bases.
🔹Mobs will still quake while affected.

[h3]Meteocenter: Thermal Cooling[/h3]
🔹Thermal changes only affect mobs.

[h3]Satellite Station: EMP Shockwave[/h3]
🔹Will only affect mobs.
🔹Player bases will not be affected.
🔹Ability to use energy weapons will not be affected.



[h1][b]Balance & Bugs[/b][/h1]
We’re also patching a few bugs and rebalancing a few things with this update:
🔹Fixed an error with the key guide HUD regarding housing management.
🔹Fixed doors so they render in a way that doesn’t let you see inside of people’s bases.
🔹Terrasite miners will take a bit longer to mine.
🔹Miners overall will consume more energy.
🔹Terrafire changes to reduce facility skill abuse.
🔹Fixed an exploit that allowed players to peek through roofs.
🔹Optimization changes to the Hyena Dropship event.

notes.title: Season 3 Patch Schedule
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5046c080a7aba51321849b551a868f81901436ec.png[/img]

We're updating the game this Friday!

[h1][u][b]Update Schedule[/b][/u][/h1]
PST: May 11, 22:00 - May 12, 03:00
CET: May 12, 07:00 - 12:00
KST: May 12, 14:00 - 19:00

Here are a couple of the many things you can expect with our Season 3 update:

[h2][b]1. Rankings Reset[/b][/h2]
We’re closing the season, and starting fresh.

[h2][b]2. We’re opening a new server type: “Uncapped”[/b][/h2]
It’s a server with no upper limit on the server lifespan. There will be PvE and PvP options available, so settle down wherever you like!

[h2][b]3. Upgraded Skill System : Perks![/b][/h2]
We’re adding new functionality to the way that skills work. Successfully escaping your server’s terrafire event will give you a random perk. Each perk is a way of leveling up your character’s skills before logging into a server for the first time. 


[h3]Stay tuned for our full game note explaining everything new in the upcoming Season 3(v.0.4.0) update, where I'll be going into more detail about the features mentioned above and more![/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.3.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a879253091fc2e35e81f892e93773353e1257838.png[/img]

Greetings from Orbis!
We’ll be releasing a big update next week with some new features that I’m sure you’ll all love, so this week is mostly some small balance changes and bug fixes to keep everything running smoothly on Ararat Island. Keep reading to learn what’s new this week in our 0.3.4 patch.

And I have a small surprise at the end for those of you that read the entire game note!

[h3][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Wednesday, May 3rd[/b]
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00
(KST) 16:00-18:00



[h1][b]TFT-K7 Recipe Change 🔫[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/42f48734355c3ad2d3bc150814afdbaf80f6cbe5.jpg[/img]
We changed the recipe for the TFT-K7 Legendary gun to put its cost more in line with the other legendary weapons.

[u][b]Before[/b][/u]
2 fine reactors
[u][b]After[/b][/u]
6 fine reactors



[h1][b]Transmitter Store Changes 🏷️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f31eed581ac213114d84780277be7fcec0d5b65a.png[/img]
Like I said in last week’s patch note, we’ve started changing out the contents of the transmitter store every week. We’ll be testing different changes over the coming weeks to balance the use of the transmitter store and to stop people from abusing it

This week we’ll be slightly reducing the number of high level weapons and armor that are available.



[h1][b]Recycler Recipe Changes 🔧[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/05d2b2d199f897c8a1c08c17b7dc49c1c0c6190c.png[/img]
Now that more high level equipment is purchasable in the transmitter store, we need to balance their recycling recipes to keep players from abusing the store to farm high level items.

1. Epic gear will no longer break down into superior terrasite.
2. Legendary gear (gold) will no longer break down into an energy core or a fine reactor.



[h1][b]Cyclops Melee Animation 👊[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c9dd7e109abe00e4141ee850dff0392deb449c8f.png[/img]
The cyclops used to slash downward when attacking with its melee weapon. Now it will jab forward instead.



[h1][b]Level 1 Foundations and Walls 🏡[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/340383ef57b2a0262e66b99e62984257f35e6a79.png[/img]
We reduced the bolt cost for level 1 base building. All level 1 parts will now only require 1 bolt apiece.



[h1][b]Added Uninstall code for Uncheater 🔧[/b][/h1]
We realized that Uncheater wasn’t being uninstalled along with the game. We added code to our uninstall script to make sure that uncheater is being uninstalled.



[h1][b]Terrafire: Controller Bug 🐛[/b][/h1]
There was a recent bug where players were able to use controllers to reduce the remaining lifespan of a server AFTER the terrafire countdown started. We’ve fixed the bug.



[h1][b]What’s in the pipeline?[/b][/h1]
And to finish off this week’s game note, here are two picture previews of what you can expect in our upcoming update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dbc687d4ede3d922220fae06e097bff2687fafa1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/38d5bbb380e9b282d497e7f583860f4c0ae08b2b.png[/img]




[h2][b]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1527890?snr=2_9_100000_][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8ff1423d2785bfd85cdebc89dc911369f5fc0b71.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.com/invite/dysterra][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a500763ea3b8e315ba8c496d9b3d29f74e7e76b5.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.twitch.tv/dysterra_official][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/356e407770e431b8a02fb24c8cf41e686d397ee7.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJaBOjIVuD3zSVdlwDpFifw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6354e8d61cfb84b2c53e2bee9b24fd98f83e7d09.png[/img][/url][url=https://twitter.com/dysterra_ofcl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4623aaf5942e4176bb3b2683da6234890ccfc34e.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.facebook.com/people/Dysterra/100076734611086/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/81808ca2f62529eb2238ccd1ebbe781a199016bd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.3.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/41bbd94ca62ff8827699c0688ea5d35510a749b5.png[/img]

Greetings from Orbis, survivors!

This week’s patch is a bit smaller than usual. Our team has been hard at work making content for season 3 of Dysterra, so I hope you’ll understand that there are quite a few new things in the pipeline.

This update adds more variety to the items available in the Terrasite Transmitter. We’ve also made a tweak to the server selection UI, and added new functionality to the vehicle workshops F-hold menu.

[h3][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Wednesday, April 26th[/b]
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00
(KST) 16:00-18:00

[h1][b]Changes to the Transmitter Store 🏷️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4f22752b74bda7a9491fcfddc38ea6d4734aa27a.png[/img]

Terrasite Transmitters are super useful. If you aren’t taking advantage of them, you’ve been missing out on easy access to quick jumps in game progression.

We’ve recently taken steps towards making them more accessible, and now we’re updating how the store itself works. From this week’s patch, the items in the store will be put on a weekly rotating schedule. Basic goods like sleeping bags, weapon scopes, and ammo will always be available, but an extra assortment of mid-high tier weapons and armor will switch out each week.

Note: Limited Ware will still change daily; Each day’s items will be picked randomly from a total set of 6 Legendary-tier items that will also be switched out every week during maintenance.

[u]Other changes:[/u]
- Up to 100 of each pill may now be purchased (used to be 20)
- Up to 10 Microparts may now be purchased each week (was 2)



[h1][b]Pick up your Vehicle Workshop 🚗[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8aa8d77572d0ff11a3befc579684f9f803a248cc.png[/img]

You can now easily pick up your vehicle workshop by holding F while looking at it. Moving your workshop to a different location is now a piece of cake.



[h1][b]Game Version Revision 🚀[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1c057f4ce4ee46265b1a0c341450727c0b34aafe.png[/img]

For a lot of users, the game version looked like a bunch of random numbers that went up a little every week. We’ve added the official version numbers to the front so it’s more meaningful to non-technical survivors. If you’re curious, the 6 numbers on the end are called a “build number.” Every time one of our coders changes anything in the game and saves it, the number will go up by 1 (usually).

[u][b]Before[/b][/u]:
123456 
[u][b]After[/b][/u]:
0.3.2.123456



[h1][b]What’s in the works?[/b][/h1]
Thanks for reading this far! As a reward, here are some teaser images for what’s in the works for our upcoming May(jor) update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6a70c5e4fbd898b449835c9620cd0685980eb81f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b41ec6841ca97c18abd03390ff518fb785b29f36.png[/img]


[h2][b][u]Minor Changes & Optimizations 🚀[/u][/b][/h2]

🔧 Changed names of corpses so they match.

🔧 Fixed a missing text string in the tutorial.

🔧 Fixed a bug in single-player where one’s vehicle would sometimes disappear.

🕑 Optimized CPU load on local computer in Single Player.



[h2][b]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1527890?snr=2_9_100000_][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8ff1423d2785bfd85cdebc89dc911369f5fc0b71.png[/img][/url][url=https://discord.com/invite/dysterra][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a500763ea3b8e315ba8c496d9b3d29f74e7e76b5.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.twitch.tv/dysterra_official][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/356e407770e431b8a02fb24c8cf41e686d397ee7.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJaBOjIVuD3zSVdlwDpFifw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6354e8d61cfb84b2c53e2bee9b24fd98f83e7d09.png[/img][/url][url=https://twitter.com/dysterra_ofcl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4623aaf5942e4176bb3b2683da6234890ccfc34e.png[/img][/url][url=https://www.facebook.com/people/Dysterra/100076734611086/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/81808ca2f62529eb2238ccd1ebbe781a199016bd.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.3.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/26766f4f1e266bed49b23fa5666d159ce5730eac.png[/img]

How did all of you enjoy our Blitz Mode event last weekend? Our team came together to play with you all, and we had a blast running into so many players and seeing you all enjoying the new content.

In this week's update, we're bringing more terrasite transmitters to the game to encourage their usage. We've also increased the drop rate of bolts and stone to make building easier and more efficient. In addition, the cost of bolts to repair all level 1 base parts has been removed. Keep reading for further details.

[h2][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h2]
[b]Thursday, April 20th[/b]
(PST) 00:00-02:00
(CET) 09:00-11:00
(KST) 16:00-18:00



[h1][b]More Terrasite Transmitters 📡[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/13cd92d8cb9ab0dec9e0e0c7059960ee7177b154.png[/img]

In order to encourage the use of Terrasite Transmitters, we will replace the existing solar street lights with terrasite transmitters. You won’t have to fight with Hyena soldiers every time you want to buy something now.



[h1][b]Terrasite Transmitter Store🛍️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4f22752b74bda7a9491fcfddc38ea6d4734aa27a.png[/img]

We have added new items to the Terrasite Transmitter store. You can now purchase bolts for 15 pts each, motors for 25 pts, wires for 25 pts, sensors for 25 pts, and Lv.1 battery packs for 100 pts.



[h1][b]Mouse Wheel Weapon Change 🔫[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7f41919fdff0fc011c32b1171d52ff702c2a08aa.png[/img]
Players should now be able to switch to an empty hand when changing weapons while using the mouse wheel.



[h1][b]Increased Drop-rate for Bolts 🔩[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0b4fd8210f5bceadac5e32b3b84b36d9a5b7861e.png[/img]

Due to the addition of new roof building parts that will require more bolts, we will be increasing the drop rate of bolts by 10-15% for the following containers:


🔹 Fine Scrap Bin
🔹 Fine Toolbox
🔹 Fine Trash Compactor
🔹 Rusty Boat
🔹 Radiator
🔹 Trash Bags
🔹 Metal Separator
🔹 Junction Box
🔹 Transport Box
🔹 Trash Compactor



[h1][b]Increased Stone Collection Rate ⛰️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/cf13dd32564a6d24e07ed3cfbae0a4a38a47a293.png[/img]

We’ll be adding a new, angled roof to the game soon. In order to accommodate the addition of new roof building parts, we will be increasing the drop rate of stone by 30% for a number of items that includes stone and metal nodes, building debris, and terrapods.

No More Screw Removal Costs for Level 1 Building Parts 🔩
We have removed the cost of bolts to repair all level 1 base parts.



[h1][u][b]Other Changes[/b][/u][/h1]
🔹 We’ve polished the animation for the Buggy Android when it spots a player.

🔹 We’ve fixed some issues with a couple of doors around the map.

🔹 When running a custom server, new log entries will now be added for connection failures, connection successes, anonymous logins, GSLT logins, save file loading, and dedicated server readiness.



[h1][b]Bug Fixes 🐛[/b][/h1]
This update contains several bug fixes for the game. Listed below are the details of the fixes included in this patch.

[h3][b][u]Gamepad 🎮[/u][/b][/h3]
🔹 Fixed tooltip key guide error when opening inventory for the first time with a gamepad.

[h3][b][u]Building 🏗️[/u][/b][/h3]
🔹 Fixed some issues where people were building where they shouldn’t be able to.

[h3][b][u]Explosive Ammo 💥[/u][/b][/h3]
🔹 Modified damage logic so that TFT-K7 is able to deal damage to shields as well.
🔹 Modified explosive damage to allow damage to be distributed to each part of the Orbis Heavy Gunner.

[h3][b][u]Facilities 🏭[/u][/b][/h3]
🔹 Fixed an issue during the final countdown where facility controllers were consumed but facility skills were not activated.
🔹 Fixed an issue where the facility skills were not affecting mobs.
🔹 Fixed issue with Grima getting stuck in a doorway.

[h3][b][u]Sound 🔊[/u][/b][/h3]
🔹 Fixed an issue where ambient sound  volume changed in single-player mode depending on the player’s height on the map.
🔹 Fixed an issue with vehicle sounds where sounds were not audible to both the driver and the passenger.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f433c768ed5fb61aa4b8367e386721beeac52e3f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Greetings from Orbis![/h3]

We’re back this week with our 0.3.1 patch! A lot of this patch is trying to fix the bugs you all found over the weekend. 🙏 We’re also adding bits of code to prepare for this weekend’s special server event! Blitz Mode is going to be an exciting time for everyone involved, so be sure to follow the link in the Blitz Mode section below to learn all about it.

[h3][u]Update Maintenance Time:[/u][/h3]
PDT: Apr 12th, 00:00-02:00
CEST: Apr 12th, 09:00-11:00
KST: Apr 12th, 16:00-18:00


[h1][b]Blitz Mode Event ⚡️🏃‍♂️💨[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/51815c7eb514dcfe61b9dba9e7b8df7930571a4c.png[/img]

We’re opening a one-off event server!

This will be a fast-paced, 2-hour race to see who can rank the highest! We’ll be placing proto-juggernauts around the map, and hiding special chests with legendary loot. We’re also changing the game rules to make looting much faster so people aren’t caught hoarding items. Don’t miss this chance to enjoy Dysterra in a new and exciting way.

For 3 nights this weekend (Fri, Sat, & Sun), we’ll be holding a one-off 2-hour event separately on the US and Europe servers. The event will happen a total of 6 times, once each evening at 6-8pm CET time on a Europe-based server, and once each evening at 6-8pm PST on a North America-based server.

[h2]Learn more [b][url=https://discord.com/events/790479653294440478/1095240915284676698]here[/url]![/b][/h2]
https://discord.com/events/790479653294440478/1095240915284676698



[h1][b]Blitz Mode: Hidden Loot 🔍🔒[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8fe7f3e82f664162aa947085f12ae050f0f07e8e.jpg[/img]

For those of you participating in the Blitz Mode event, there will be 10 Camo Storage Bags hidden around the map with legendary loot inside..

Each bag will have the following inside:
[list]
[*] ⚡️ 1 legendary gun
[*] ⚡️ 2 legendary pieces of armor
[*] ⚡️ 1 legendary protocol
[/list]


[h1][b]Mining Changes ⛏️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2b24aeaae170734837fb1a2186b765f8738e62f1.jpg[/img]

The goal of miners was to reduce your time mining, but it seems we set their initial energy consumption rates too high to make them worth the effort. We halved the rates from 500 to 250, so hopefully they’ll be a much more valuable asset for players.


[h1][b]Added New Mailbox Mail Types 📧[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] 📢 Added Events-type mail to the game code.
[*] 📢 Added Patch Rewards-type mail to the game code
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
🐞 Issue fixed where players were falling through the roof when escaping from the underground bunker via the portal.

🐞 Increased the drop rate of bolts from the toolbox and red toolbox.
[list]
[*] 🔹 Regular toolbox: guaranteed 4 or 8 bolts
[*] 🔹 Big red toolbox: guaranteed 8 or 14 bolts
[/list]
🐞 Fixed intermittent issue where NPCs were not taking damage.

🐞 Issue fixed where the Hyena spot event was not triggering properly.

🐞 Fixed issue where the Hyena Dropship door was not synchronized and appeared closed.

🐞 Fixed bug where players were able to acquire more than three building core permissions.

🐞 Several issues with vaulting were fixed:
[list]
[*] 🔹 Fixed camera distortion while vaulting.
[*] 🔹 Fixed animation issues with the character holding a gun while vaulting.
[*] 🔹 Fixed issue where player was unable to exit glide mode if player vaulted while gliding.
[/list]
🐞 Fixed bug where metal pieces remained in the air when mobs died from an explosion.

🐞 Adjusted Hyena Dropship event:
[list]
[*] 🔹 Fixed issue where mobs remained alive after the event ended.
[/list]
🐞 Improved resource spawning to decrease lag.

notes.title: (Major Update) Forgotten Heritage (Patch 0.3.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/18313fdcd3f409ab97d93519f3b1c17425f4e4c0.jpg[/img]
[h3]Greetings from Orbis![/h3]

The Orbis update is finally almost here! We’ve been sweating at the brow to make some great new content for you all.

[h3][u][b]Update Maintenance Time:[/b][/u][/h3]
PST: Apr 6th, 21:00-01:00(Apr 7th)
CET: Apr 6th, 06:00-10:00
KST: Apr 6th, 14:00-18:00 

Our February update was all about the Hyenas, and this one is all about Orbis. You’ll get a new boss, new NPCs, new base parts, and of course some new guns. We’ve also improved radiation recovery speeds to make the game more accessible to new players.

Down below, I’ll talk about what’s going in, and what’s different, but I’m sure you’ll have some questions. Our team is active on Discord, and we’ll be happy to answer any questions you all have about the new content!

So to start:
[h1][b]Not a New Season 📈[/b][/h1]
I want to make sure everyone is on the same page:

This is not a new season. Rankings will not be reset.
This is not a new season. Rankings will not be reset.
This is not a new season. Rankings will not be reset.


[h1][b]The Heritage 🛸[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/618ca6b0c5c0d2a8400765e0bc5492718b81e2c2.jpg[/img]
It should be obvious to anyone on the servers that there’s a new presence on Ararat Island. This ship is the Heritage. It’s the mothership of a fleet of Orbis supply ships that ferry materials between islands. You can fight your way to the portal that leads inside, and get some nifty new items and materials for upgrading your base, armor, or weapons.

Finding the entrance/portal is up to you. Good luck!


[h1][b]New Orbis Enemies 🤖[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dba033deb61294c739f1c56a1a2e8d203d6feb1e.jpg[/img]
The Orbis Heavy Gunner is the key to unlocking a whole new set of recipes! Aim for his weak spots and steal his “core” to craft one the new legendary weapons featured below. He’s waiting for you!

You’ll also find a new type of Orbis robot as well as some Advanced Hacking Crates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/eba9c3e4bd3d7f01dd05ace63525d9135757d887.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]Secure Area: Maintenance Bays 🔒[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7b76c2a58d4d34321099354f6dad3c25082cc8c2.jpg[/img]
We’re adding some new secure areas to the game. You can think of them like a toned-down loot room where you can find exclusive items for recipes. There are a few of these secure areas, each with slightly different loot inside, so keep an eye out for maintenance bay keys!


[h1][b]2 New Weapons! 🔫[/b][/h1]

We’ve got two new great guns in this update: our non-legendary tier rocket launcher (Blue Tier), and a legendary assault rifle that uses a new type of ammo to give blast damage that should render most shields useless.

[h2][b]FFM-202[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0f0ace63d6b1ea8fc78c76a71eb7a7ae27bd0ded.jpg[/img]
This is our first non-legendary (blue-tier) rocket launcher. The FFM-202, also referred to as the Flashfire, is an entry launcher for survivors that are looking to loot with style, but don’t want the expense and hassle that comes with maintaining a legendary-tier weapon.

The FFM-202 uses Rocket Ammo instead of Rocket Cartridges. This means you won’t have to craft high level ammo for a lower level weapon.

Damage Type: Explosion (= full damage to Hyena & Orbis)
Damage: 80 dmg
Building Dmg: 125%
Piercing: 4%
Full dmg up to: 65 meters

Rocket Ammo Recipe (2 rockets):
💥 Fine Metal x 1
💥 Fine Blasting Agent x 1


[h2][b]TFT-K7[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/42f48734355c3ad2d3bc150814afdbaf80f6cbe5.jpg[/img]
A legendary (yellow-tier) assault rifle. The TFT-K7(referred to in-house as the Painstaker) is our first gun to use explosive ammo. While it may shoot a bit slower than other rifles, it gives blast damage, allowing it to damage enemies through shields. With the new 

Exploding Ammo is what makes the TFT-K7 so unique and powerful.

Damage Type: Explosion (= full damage to Hyena & Orbis)
Damage: 31 dmg
Building Dmg: 10%
Full dmg up to: 55 meters

[h3]Explosive Ammo Recipe (20 cartridges)[/h3]
💥 Fine Metal x 2
💥 Fine Blasting Agent x 2


[h1][b]Automatic Mining! ⛰️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2b24aeaae170734837fb1a2186b765f8738e62f1.jpg[/img]

Are you tired of spending your time gathering basic materials when you could be out there fighting baddies and farming high level parts for your next raid? Well now you can get your terrasite, stone, and minerals mined automatically for you. You’ll need to explore the new secure areas (Maintenance Bays) in order to find their parts, but it’s definitely worth the trouble for anyone who’s looking to save time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d583ed7c4c8226a0f13703b93949c2fffd17fb31.jpg[/img]

There are 3 types of miner, and each is upgradable to level 2. Level 1 miners will give you only the basic element at a slow rate, but level 2 miners will give you the element at a faster rate, with the occasional high level material included in the output.


[h1][b]Automatic Cultivators 🌱[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9b80043ee4ed3e703b43d16ff8997736ec858fd3.jpg[/img]
While you're automatically farming your terrasite, stone, and minerals, you can also be growing your own food inside your base. We’ve got three separate cultivators with multiple upgradable tiers that you can use to grow most of your basic dietary necessities: protein, vegetables, and fungi.

You’ll get spores from mushrooms, serum from animals, and seeds from plants. You can place these in the cultivators to grow them into the full versions. There’s a chance to get more spores, serums, and seeds, so you’ll often end up with a little more than you expect.

You’ll still need to go hunting for food and mushrooms, but these cultivators will help you to get more food in less time. The level 2 versions have better rates, so upgrading will save you more time, but not completely eliminate the need to go foraging.


[h1][b]Trophies 🏆[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/249b0d5fbfe1c5d419b94442f0bf6d6e6f3c956c.jpg[/img]
Show your friends, or unwelcome looters, just how tough you are! Cyclops and Juggernauts are the scariest non-bosses in the game. Starting in this update, you’ll often find a “Cyclops Shape Data” item or a “Juggernaut Shape Data” Item when you kill the respective mob. You can combine 10 of these to form a silver figurine, and then combine 5 silver figurines to craft a golden figurine.

[h1][b]New Building Layouts 🏠🏢🏣🏡🏘️[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dc0e2b6b0321847702fa118ed47491c93e048006.jpg[/img]
For all of you farmers out there, we’ve updated the layouts of several building types on the outskirts of the island, and we’ve replaced a large number of buildings with brand new buildings to add variety to your time out in the field gathering supplies.


[h1][b]Level 3 Orbis Container 💎[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c20005714b95d8e9f82af5006e34bac7f9389952.jpg[/img]
We’re also releasing a level 3 Orbis Container. This container’s different because it’s our first “grab-bag” style container. You’ll have a chance to get new higher level skins, but there will always be a chance of getting a skin that’s also in one of the lower level containers. Don’t worry, though. If you already have a skin, you’ll receive a portion of the TP you spent on the container.


[h1][b]Stronger Bunker Mobs 🕸️[/b][/h1]
We’ve added some high-value loot to the bunker, so we decided to increase the HP and attack power of bunker mobs across the board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/558b12c7649e77c0c101d79e2b3ceb58da5bfbfe.jpg[/img]

[h3][u][b]Variant[/b][/u][/h3]
HP:                      580 ➡️ 1000
Regular Attack:     30 ➡️ 50
Downward Attack: 45 ➡️ 56
Dash Attack:         50 ➡️ 60

[h3][u][b]Retcher[/b][/u][/h3]
HP:                 175 ➡️ 300
Regular Attack: 15 ➡️ 20


[h1][b]Other Changes 📒[/b][/h1]
🔹 Increased amount of terrasite received from Fine Terrasite Nodes from (20-22) to (25-27)

🔹 Added new items to the journal

🔹 Eating raw broccoli reduces your HP by 3 pts. (was 10 pts)

🔹 New base-parts give players skill XP.

🔹 New base-parts contribute to rankings.

🔹 Faster Recovery from Radiation: 3 points/sec. (was 1 point/sec)

notes.title: Game Note: New Quarter Foundations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f433c768ed5fb61aa4b8367e386721beeac52e3f.jpg[/img]
Greetings from Orbis!

How’s your week been? This week, we’ve got some good news for your friends, and we’ve added some extra new base-building parts for you to play around with and exercise your creativity. Let’s start with the big news first:

[h1][b]🎉 Price Reduction![/b][/h1]
Good news, survivors! We’re thrilled to announce that we’re making the Dysterra Dyscount permanent! Starting March 24th, the game will be available at a new lower price of $14.99. We hope this will encourage more players to join our servers and make our community even more vibrant. If you see any new people on the Discord server, please extend a warm welcome and offer them any help you can.


[h1][b]📢 Founder’s Pack[/b][/h1]
To show our appreciation to our loyal Dysterra players, we're excited to offer a special "Founder's Pack" to anyone who purchases the game before the end of the Steam Spring Sale (ending on March 23rd, 10am PST). Beginning at 8pm on March 23rd, you should get a notice that you’ve received the pack when you log-in.

[h2]The pack includes:[/h2]
[h3]🎁 6 furniture recipes
🗿 12 sculptures
💰 3000 terrapoints (yes, we love you 3000!)[/h3]

The 3000 terrapoints can be used to purchase new items in the game lobby’s Terra Shop. We’re thankful that you’ve taken a chance on our game, and especially grateful for everyone who’s taken the time to give feedback on Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8eeccffa393eee3c7c635d89ae866bf4c9fbe6f7.jpg[/img]

While most of the furniture is decorational, the bed has a respawn cooldown of 30 seconds, making it perfect if someone’s raiding your base and you need to get right back into the action.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/53ec9ef29b6964ac08667b34836dd7ca4340e90d.jpg[/img]

Also, be sure to save some of those terrapoints because we'll be introducing a new Orbis Container soon.


[h1][b]🏡 1/4 Foundations![/b][/h1]
Building in Dysterra has been a bit like building a house in early versions of Minecraft. But, we're excited to announce a new set of base parts that will make base-building easier and more customizable. We're adding a quarter (1/4) foundation option, which means that you can create hallways that actually look like hallways!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/aa5ab413551d6912e9bb0525068ed652ec11c215.jpg[/img]

Now a hallway can be more like a hallway, and base defense is more customizable. You can create a maze to lure enemies into a death trap, or more easily hide a shotgun turret around a corner. If you’ve been using honeycombing as a base defense tactic, you can consider double-layering your base instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1948de6a3a029680f488089de939645929008f49.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]🔧 Things we fixed:[/b][/h1]
🔹 An issue with intermittent freezes.
🔹 A UI error with canceling bullets on the Stalker gun.
🔹 The progress bar while gathering would sometimes display backwards.


[h1][b]🔧 Other news![/b][/h1]
Keep your eyes peeled for a big announcement later this week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8577798b64613a54294bbac01c4f411ef738cc23.jpg[/img]


[i]-Director K[/i]

notes.title: Dev Note: Dysterra Dyscount!
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

We're excited to announce a [i]Dysterra Dyscount[/i]! As part of the Steam Spring Sale, we're offering a [b]50% discount[/b] on Dysterra, bringing the price down to [b][u]just $14.99[/u][/b]. It's a great opportunity for you or a friend to pick up a copy!

If you've been thinking about trying out Dysterra, now’s the perfect time to grab it at a reduced price. We’re regularly adding new content to the game and fixing things as quick as we can. So spread the word to your friends and family. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you in-game!


Moving on to our regularly scheduled Dev Note, we’ve been hard at work this week designing new content for you.

☠️ New animations for our upcoming boss[h1][b]
[/b][/h1]Our art team has made some animations for our new boss that I think are pretty good. They’re all pretty good, but I picked two that I thought were interesting. The first one is its idle animation, and the second one is when (or if!) you kill him.

notes.title: Patch Preview: Enter? Or Walk away?
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

In this week's patch, Ararat Island's game mechanics are being refined to create a more engaging and challenging experience. We're redesigning doors, we’re making a change to the Meteochamber elevator, and mobs will now be able to walk away from a fight.

[h1][b]🚶🏿‍♂️ Should I stay or should I go?[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/608d391ae84e6a6a80b2880543245d95c96b6eca.jpg[/img]

With so many types of areas on Ararat Island, some are bound to be easier while others are going to be harder. We’ve decided to redesign doors so they show the expected difficulty of the area.
Difficulties range from Very Easy to Very Hard, so if you’re a beginner, you’ll know to stay in places that have the word “easy” in their description. 


[h1][b]🚪 Change to Meteochamber Elevator[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/99217e2dec13e049d9b9aabe6fec0838030345da.jpg[/img]

The elevator in the Meteochamber now requires a special key to operate, which is obtained from the Stomper in the final area.

Users must retrieve the key after calling the elevator in order to ride it to the upper level. However, the key will expire one hour after it is obtained, rendering it unusable. This change is being implemented to prevent unintended methods of clearing the Meteochamber.


[h1][b]🚶🏿‍♂️ Just walk away.[/b][/h1]
There were instances where mobs weren’t able to attack players for whatever reason.  That’s why we're teaching mobs how to walk away from a fight. This way, if you’re on your roof and some cyclops come walking by, they will run away once they realize they can’t get to you.


[h1][b]🐞 Bugs[/b][/h1]
🔹Some resources were hidden under dirt. We dug them up and dusted them off.
🔹Upon dying, players would sometimes only see the final piece of damage they received. We killed that error.
🔹We fixed facility skills so they don’t affect a sphere, but instead affect a cylinder that includes above and below ground. (This means you could be affected while in the Bunker or the Hyena Den.)
🔹Custom Server log improvements. We fixed some errors with locations and UIDs concerning resource boxes.
🔹Fixed an issue with the delta plant’s facility skill.


As always, we hope you'll like what we’ve done. We’re always striving to make Dysterra an enjoyable game for everyone!

[i]-Director K[/i]

notes.title: (Patch Note) Longer Server Lifespans
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

In this week's patch, we'll be introducing various balance changes. One shotgun's recipe will be updated, while the other will receive a significant boost in power to better reflect its effectiveness. Radiation protection for hazmat suits and rad suits will be readjusted to provide more reasonable levels of defense. We'll also be extending world lifespans and introducing buffs to turrets, addressing concerns regarding their effectiveness in defending against off-line raiding.


[h3][b]📒 Shotgun Changes[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/48e6997b4500368ab426cbdcee7ebfda1af031e8.jpg[/img]

In the next update, we're making some changes to two shotguns in the game.

[b]RF-9 Shotgun[/b]
To better reflect the RF-9's power, we're upgrading its tier from Tier-3 to Tier-4. We're also adjusting the recipe for crafting the RF-9 to better match its new tier.

[b]P-38 Shotgun [/b](pictured above)
We're increasing the number of pellets in the P-38 shotgun cartridge from 8 to 12, and making some adjustments to its damage to better balance it. 

[b]Before[/b]: 8 pellets of 16 dmg(each) = 128
[b]Now[/b]: 12 pellets of 14 dmg(each) = 168


[h3][b]📒 Radiation Suit Re-leveling[/b][/h3]
I admit it. We nerfed radiation protection too much when introducing the new Rad suits. The new tier-2 rad suits will now add up to 65% protection while the original tier-3 hazmat suits will total 90%.

We’re also increasing max radiation resistance from 100 to 200.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/87ff12db3ba005d550a85492bcd91dbdffc93129.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]📒 New Items in the Terra Shop[/b][/h3]
We’re also adding two new items to the Lobby’s Terra Shop.

One is the 3-stack shelf. For everyone that’s tired of using columns and foundations to build makeshift shelves, these are what you’ve been waiting for! They are exactly 1/4 the size of a foundation square, and can stack up to 3 layers. I hope you like them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7896e9ef4b52e5ebb70270e606db40f075ed7456.jpg[/img]


The other item is a mushroom head lamp. You can install it on a foundation or on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/33454ae10f2551e2fe81c36a0ecaa015cf1f22ca.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]📒 Improved Turret Functionality[/b][/h3]
We are constantly seeking ways to improve Dysterra's balance, and one area that requires attention is the effectiveness of turrets. Although turrets are the main defense against off-line raiding, their limited range has made them vulnerable to long-distance attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0bd356621ae8e0d6b3a6df13ba00f4f056aa61a5.jpg[/img]

To address this issue, we are introducing an update that will change the raiding dynamics for turrets. Only high-level melee weapons (IGX-1 & IGXX-100), rockets, and blast mines will be capable of damaging turrets. While this approach may require further balancing in the future, it is a significant step towards realizing our initial vision of turrets as an anti-raiding weapon.

Additionally, we are increasing the interceptor turret's health from 700 HP to 5000 HP to enhance its defensive capabilities.


[h3][b]📒Changes to World Lifespans[/b][/h3]
We’ve consistently heard complaints that the minimum lifespans for servers were too short, so we’ve increased the beginning lifespan for servers from 14 to 28 days.

[b]Changes:[/b]
Prior Lifespan: 2 weeks IRL -> 4 weeks IRL (672 days in-game)
Shortest Lifespan: 10 days IRL -> 14 days IRL (336 days in-game)
Longest Lifespan: 28 days IRL -> 30 days IRL (720 days in-game)

That’s all for this week. Have fun out there!
-Director K

notes.title: (Dev Note) New Orbis Area
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

I’ve got another interesting dev not for you all! We’re working on a new Orbis area with a new boss to challenge your skills. We're also designing mining machines to make gathering resources a breeze, and even some high-tech incubators for growing your own food. And don't forget to check out the sneak-peek of the new gun we have in store for you! 

Remember that everything here is subject to change or removal.

[h3][b]📒 New Orbis Area[/b][/h3]
I briefly mentioned a new Orbis area last week. We’ve mostly finalized the exterior design and now it’s on to designing the interior. Like everything else in this dev note, you’ll have to wait to know more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/46c93505ffe1a188d5538994a9ca358a860d5b3a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 New Orbis Area Boss[/b][/h3]
We’ve finished rigging the new Orbis boss for 3D movement. It takes a long while to define each part and how they will move together. The next step is to work on movement animations and coding in how it will interact with the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8c6944573b8c9122adc07ec2668cc37e646fc7bd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ec18848169b6b7dc315cd673027ee4e170f00c1e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Incubators?[/b][/h3]
Our art team is working on some plant, protein and mushroom synthesizers. While we’re still working on what to call them, you can spend some time learning about how fungi don't actually belong to the plant or animal kingdom, and instead have their own scientific classification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/23be3982bb0434c8b62e59c4b621ac6c3972816f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Mining Machines[/b][/h3]
While minors aren’t allowed to play Dysterra, miners are absolutely allowed. We’re working on some instruments to automatically extract materials for you. You can see the three different concepts for stone, terrasite, and metal respectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/28b41d7166aa2dcb427585d5cc73c6e8d04e4814.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/636fb3e579423d9d70dac2d9c5c7e42f25765fd4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 A New Gun on the Horizon?[/b][/h3]
Here’s a sneak peek at our next weapon addition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e201b5bf850f514be09ac03fa73bf045067d1ec8.gif[/img]

There you go! Ask the devs on Discord any questions that you might have.

-Director K

notes.title: (Patch Note) Base Decor and More - Update Preview (03.02.2023)
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

We’ve got a jam-packed patch for all of you soon-to-be interior designers. 

If you’ve been wanting more ways to personalize your base, we’ve got what you’ve been waiting for. 

But if you’re not ready to tackle interior decorating, we’ve got 3 new sets of armor, 9 new gun attachments, turret improvements, and raiding buffs to a couple melee weapons.

[h3][b]📒 Decorate your base![/b][/h3]
Starting from this patch, you’ll be able to turn that cold, dark base of yours into a warm, inviting home. 

With item recipes that you can acquire in the game lobby’s “Terra Shop”, you’ll be able to decorate and organize your base in new and fun ways.

Aside from the bed and the shelves, all of the decor in this patch is non-functional. We plan to wall shelves soon that will also serve as a place to store items.

These item recipes are unavailable by default. You’ll have to use your terrapoints to unlock their crafting recipes.

Reminder: Terrapoints can be earned daily by logging in, and they’ll also be paid out weekly to players according to their ranking tier. They are different from the points you receive when transmitting terrasite.

Here’s one way you might decorate your base:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3ecdcc15dc88eaedca368ebb2ff07d11b3fc68eb.jpg[/img]

And here’s another:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c26fc9f57038814824d1e3b1779031904538779a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Color-code your chests[/b][/h3]
You’ll also find three new colors of chests that you can unlock.

So for those of you that enjoy visually organizing your chests, this should open up quite a few new ways to keep track of which items are in which chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7896e9ef4b52e5ebb70270e606db40f075ed7456.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Rad new armor![/b][/h3]
Hazmat suits give you 50% radiation protection, making them a solid Tier 3 choice for survivors that often visit the Orbis bases. The only issue is that they’re a bit difficult to craft.

For players that are just getting started, we have 3 new suits for you to try out: the Cryo Suit, the Pyro Suit, and the Rad Suit. These Tier 2 suits will only give you 30% protection against their respective elements, but it should be enough for those of you venturing into dangerous territory.

From left to right: Rad Suit, Cryo Suit, Pyro Suit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e4585824600a09f863273294957719f2d94ec3ab.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 9 New Gun Attachments[/b][/h3]
We’re adding 3 new compensators, 3 new silencers, and 3 new vertical grips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/28ebe13bdc34dc21ecc1620dec1f34496adee176.jpg[/img]

Each type of attachment has 4 levels for you to choose from. The existing standard attachments are now “level 2”. We’re also hoping to add even more attachments some day. Keep in mind that we had to adjust the stats of existing attachments to fit with the new number of attachments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/abfc0554df67ce8adb54df3d3f2e35ec5f20ff27.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 2 existing weapons can now have attachments[/b][/h3]
The Shotgun RF-9 and the Assault Rifle TAR-1A can now have a muzzle. So feel free to choose between a silencer or a compensator the next time you’re gearing up.

[h3][b]📒 Name and Stat Changes to two melee weapons[/b][/h3]
Raiding has mostly been secluded to mines and rockets, but we’re hoping to open that up more with the repurposing of battle hammers into “siege hammers.”  

The Siege Hammer IGX-1(battle hammer) will give 100% damage to building parts, while the Siege Hammer IGXX-100 will give 200% damage to building parts.

Battle Hammer → SIEGE HAMMER IGX-1
Great Battle Hammer → SIEGE HAMMER IGXX-100
(Names are still subject to change)

[h3][b]📒 Changes to Existing Recipes[/b][/h3]
As we try to make raiding more approachable, we also want to make rockets cheaper.

We’ve changed the recipe from
5 Fine Metal, 5 Fine Wires, 1 Superior Blasting Agent
to
2 Fine Metal, 2 Fine Wires, 1 Superior Blasting Agent

[h3][b]📒 Turret Improvements[/b][/h3]
We can’t make raiding easier without considering base defense.
We’ve also changed turrets so that as you upgrade a turret, each level has faster bullets and higher accuracy with the exception of the shotgun turret because it’s made for close encounters like being hidden inside one’s base.

[h3][b]📒 Teleporting Improvements[/b][/h3]
When leaving the hyena den or bunker, players were plopped onto the beach. 

While we changed the location for better convenience, we also realized that players may spawn next to a not-so friendly mob, or another player might catch them off guard. 

That’s why we instituted a 10 second window of invincibility when teleporting anywhere.

We’ve also adjusted teleport destinations when leaving the bunker. 

You’ll now arrive somewhere near the main road(where the bunker entrances are) as opposed to being dropped on the beach. We’re hoping this should shorten commute times by a significant amount.

[h3][b]📒 Changes to Item Drops[/b][/h3]
The following containers/mobs now have a chance to contain the following.

Hyena Secure Crate:
2 superior Blasting Agents OR 4 Fine Blasting Agents

Hyena Transport Box: 
2 Superior Blasting Agents

Hyena Heavy Buster: 
6 Superior Blasting Agents

Hyena Heavy Assaulter: 
2 superior Blasting Agents OR 4 Fine Blasting Agents

[h3][b]📒 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
We’ve also made several bug fixes.  You can see them all in our update note once it’s up.
 But here are a couple of the bigger fixes.

⚪ Items weren’t going into the forge. Now they do.
⚪ Shotgun damage was sometimes showing as ‘0’. It should display accurately now.
⚪ There were occasions of players losing building core privileges when their core somehow overlapped with another core. We added some code to prevent this from happening.

Remember that this isn’t everything. 
You can always read the update note to know about every single thing we’ve changed in this patch.

I’ll see you on Friday with the Dev Note.
-Director K

Greetings from Orbis!

It’s almost the weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/aa28ac331c4388e6a14d890af4ddf0789e040290.gif[/img]

For all of you survivors out there, this week’s dev note is introducing some things that are in the pipeline. 

As with all things development, some plans change and other plans get canceled. 

So keep in mind that everything is a work-in-progress and will likely change in some way or another before it gets out the door.

Up till now, I’ve mostly shared finished products in these dev notes, but I’m hoping to reveal more of our process moving forward. 

I hope you enjoy this glimpse into what goes into developing Dysterra!

[h3][b]📒 Decor![/b][/h3]
We’re working on decor to help you survivors turn your house into a home. We’re still figuring out how things’ll fit together, but feel free to spitball any ideas you have on our Discord feedback channel. We plan to regularly develop decor for inside and outside of your base.

(Concept Image)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3332c04e7f18a7ef10f6e3ead71f2fc8ce7e4d4b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 New Orbis baddie on the horizon[/b][/h3]
Also, a new Orbis mob is being developed for what will likely be the Orbis version of the Hyena Den. 
The robot below is going to be the boss.

(Concept art)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9b6e6d3f5911edff2ab2c4fc8a2caa6f036edd5e.jpg[/img]

(Modeling mockups)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ed781850e6afaeac553492eb02b2f3d8a22b7f30.jpg[/img]

(Final Concept with Effects)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/eced32089656693cf61ad4456600ecbdb2fe0ed6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Titanium Armor?[/b][/h3]
We’re also looking into putting out some titanium armor.

This is a rough draft of what it COULD look like.

On the left is a basic Tier 4 titanium concept that our art team developed into two different Tier 5 drafts on the right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/80640b357c52e183769d2d32518a7eea75012da5.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]📒 Refining the cyclops’ walking animation[/b][/h3]
We also did some work on the cyclops’ walk to make it feel more natural. 

It’s nothing big, but I think it sheds light onto what our team does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9cf8f431db95aa2b0e0571c899e6bba8f09a4946.gif[/img]

This was my first foray into sharing our process. 

It’s a bit short and a bit rough, but that’s a lot of what development is. 

So much is happening behind the scenes with conceiving ideas, creating concept images, modeling, testing, and sometimes scrapping ideas.

 By sharing our process, I hope you can catch a glimpse into the complexity of 
game development and our creative process.

Enjoy your weekend!
- Director K

notes.title: 📢 Notification of Known Issues as of February 23rd, 2023
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!
This is Team Dysterra.

Some of the known issues have been resolved and improved through the last update on February 15th 

and new issues to be resolved in the next update have been added. 

For more detailed update information, be sure to check out the

 [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1527890/view/3669907614209716132]🔗Update Details!🔗[/url][/b]

[h2]📢Notification of Known Issues for February 23rd, 2023[/h2]

Known issue notifications are to disclose the thoughts of the Dev team regarding errors that occur while installing or playing the game, in-game bugs, or status(progress). 

They will be announced as often as possible according to the progress of reports from players.

[h2]📌 Recently resolved or reflected 📌[/h2]

✅ Mutant Guardian NPCs not spawning at the last stage of Chemochamber

✅ Survivor could interact with Talon retcher with no loot

✅ The Terrasite transmitter is not providing the correct stack amount of item

✅ Characters being stuck at various locations in the underground zone

✅ Unable to purchase limited items from Terrasite transmitter.

[h2]🚧 Issues to be fixed in the next update 🚧[/h2]

[quote][u]❗ The time of application of these fixes may be delayed depending on the priority, 
  but they will all be applied as soon as possible. [/u][/quote]

🔧 Players do not get affected by status effects when riding a vehicle

🔧  Healing consumables are not being displayed on Terrasite transmitter shop

🔧 Non-existing item(noname) is being displayed when repairing items on Repair bench

🔧 Abnormal hit sound effect on Geolab's sliding door

🔧 Constant energy consumption after using Air Glide skill 

🔧 The issue of not being able to build foundations in some places after removing trees

🔧 The issue of Juggernaut and Grima being stuck in certain areas

🔧 Fixed the issue of players not being able to hear the sound of the vehicle while riding on them

🔧 Fixed an issue of wheels not moving while riding on the vehicle 

🔧 Minimized frame drop while playing the game.

🔧 Problem of character creation notation error in the lobby server list.

🔧 Gamepad support

🔧 Expansion of areas where you can build housing
　　🎤Dev comments🎤
    💬 Currently, surrounding areas of major bases and facilities restrict players 
         from building housing to prevent monopolization and abuse.
         However, since we received many complaints about the inconvenience these 
         restrictions cause, we are considering reducing the restricted area 
         and will be reflecting the reduction in our next update!

[h2]🔍 Content being fixed or being prepared[/h2]

🧪 Abnormal movement/behavior of some animal NPCs
🎤Dev Comments🎤
    💬We are constantly checking the movement/attack patterns of NPCs.
        We will quickly identify what is causing the issue and fix it as soon as possible

🧪 Improving loading speed.
🎤Dev Comments🎤
　　💬We are continuously working on optimization and other related issues to 
        reduce the time it takes to load servers and run game.

🧪 Difficulty level for field boss Juggernaut
🎤Dev Comments🎤
　　💬 We have been getting reports about Juggernaut being too easy to take down, 
        and bugs that you can take advantage of by using surround walls. 
        Juggernaut will be back with better AI.

🧪 Considering providing a skill reset
🎤Dev Comments🎤
    💬 We have been getting complaints about not being able to reset your skills, and we are thinking
        about adding a skill reset method. For instance, you would have to reset your skills 
        by acquiring certain items through crafting or Facility raids. 

🧪 Fixed an issue where the hotkey worked when using the search function on a workbench, etc.

🧪 Issues with installations being installed improperly
　　🎤Dev comments🎤
    💬We are considering improvements for issues such as not being able to place items
        like the Workbench close to the walls, and not being able to automatically align 
        these benches in the direction where the character is looking at. 

🧪 Changing existing settings for Single Player mode
🎤Dev comments🎤
    💬We are considering a modification function for survivors who must have been frustrated 
        because it was impossible to change the settings in the middle of Single Player mode.
        You can change the Single Player mode settings by modifying the contents of the file 
        located in the folder below.
　　- Folder location: >\Dysterra\Dysterra\WorldSettings\SinglePlay.json

🧪 Planned improvements to the long crafting time of forges
　　🎤Dev comments🎤
　　💬The existing balance was set to encourage the forges to operate automatically while
　　the player explores the world and loots major bases and facilities,
　　but we are considering introducing the ‘Forge Upgrade System’ as quickly as possible
　　to incorporate opinions from players.
　　We will be back soon with better and hopefully more intuitive forges.

[h3][b]🚨 Issues that need to be reported 🚨[/b][/h3]

❗ These are the issues that are yet unknown with the exact type of occurrence, or something we need more reports on🙇‍♂️ [url=https://kakaogames.oqupie.com/portals/1489][b]🔗Links to Customer Center[/b][/url][/quote]

- If you have a recorded video regarding the issue, please submit it through the customer center.

- If you have a recorded video regarding the issue, please submit it through the customer center.

👁‍🗨 The issue of NPC AI when using Satellite Station debuff (EMP Shockwave)

- If you have a recorded video regarding the issue, please submit it through the customer center.

👁‍🗨 The issue of structures being left unrepaired when using a Buildingcore repair function

- Please submit a detailed explanation of the issue through the customer center.

👁‍🗨 The issue of quick slot and protocol settings are initialized when reconnecting to the server

- Please submit a detailed explanation of the issue through the customer center.

👁‍🗨 The issue that a wall, door, etc. could be installed on the opposite side of a closed door or window

- If you have a recorded video regarding the issue, please submit it through the customer center.

👁‍🗨 Mutant Guardians respawn at the same location, If they are killed outside of the core room

- If you have a recorded video regarding the issue, please submit it through the customer center.

👁‍🗨 Electric barrier remains active until the Mutant Guardian's dead body gets looted and vanished.

- If you have a recorded video regarding the issue, please submit it through the customer center.

✔ Client crashing issues
