notes.title: (Patch Note) Quality of Life Improvements - Update Preview (02.22.2023)
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

For all of you amazing survivors out there, we have an exciting patch for you this week. This week’s patch will make everyone’s life easier with instant shots, larger player inventories, (mostly) cheaper repair recipes, increased durability for ALL weapons and armor, larger ammo stacks, and more.

[h3][b]📒 All Status-Effect Shots Are Instant[/b][/h3]
Shots are a big part of Dysterra. Whether it’s a shot to your enemy’s head or an anti-radiation shot. We made status-effect related shots take effect instantly so you won’t have to wait for your shot to take effect. No more crossing your fingers hoping for your radiation shot to take effect before you lose that last bar of health!

[h3][b]📒 Removal of all Snipers[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a7e6a9ecfb01dc87be86a7ca967a98fe1aa2660d.jpg[/img]

Snipers were a novel and fun addition to the game when we first implemented them, but over time, they became more of a nuisance than a fun mob you can loot. After long and hard deliberation, we’re taking ASKR snipers as you know them out of the game for the foreseeable future. We’re in the process of developing something else that will add some action to your farming ventures. But in the meantime, you’ll only have to worry about bears and the occasional cyclops when you’re wandering the wilderness.

[h3][b]📒 New Terrashop Recipes[/b][/h3]
Some of you may remember Christmas Trees and the introduction of potted firs as a decorative item. We’re adding a potted cactus in this week’s patch along with a light stand that you can easily turn on and off. Be careful around the cactus, though! You’ll get pricked if you bump into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8476144869dbaca08aade42b0b08ac564c4b226f.jpg[/img]

You can use your terrapoints to purchase their recipes in the game’s lobby. We’re planning to add more decor recipes in the near future as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a3498afc25d522bb51a89e5c968ad7f678956e0e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Forge Refinement Modifications[/b][/h3]
Forging items was always a straightforward process: put in a basic item, receive a higher level item. We have some new items that don’t fit so easily into that mould, so we’re adding some randomization to what you get when refining terrasite.

Terrasite Lumps now have a chance to be refined into terrasite, fine terrasite, or a superior terrasite lump (refinable into superior terrasite).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6473e4dce174483f8fd4c960c99f89075113fe0f.jpg[/img]

You’ll see the possible results when you drop your material into the forge. Please keep in mind that each refined item has a different chance of dropping.

[h3][b]📒 Easier Inventory Management[/b][/h3]
We’ve taken several steps to alleviate the struggles of inventory management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8bd24b10a2650eb56665a59c87d29d8c3b9c64d3.jpg[/img]

1. We’ve increased inventory sizes for all players from 30 to 36.
2. The inventory upgrade skill now has 5 levels: 2/4/6/9/12
3. The maximum inventory possible is 48 slots. (up from 40).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a02b1d5052992d710288e6ab4228a02a0801f062.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 Simplified Repair Recipes[/b][/h3]
We were trying to make repair recipes reflect the original recipes for items, but we realized it would be easier for players if recipes were more straightforward. 

Repair recipes are now simply divided into 3 types: weapons, fiber-based armor, and metal-based armor. Each type has the same recipe for all items of the same tier.

For example: 
Tier 2 weapons: 1 microparts
Tier 2 fiber-based armor: 1 silicon fabric
Tier 2 metal-based armor: 1 fine metal

[h3][b]📒 Repairing in the field requires energy[/b][/h3]
On the other hand, we want to encourage players to use a repair bench, and not solely repair items while in the field. We’ve added an energy cost to field repairs of items respective of the items tier, so bring some extra batteries if you think you’ll need to repair your equipment in the middle of a mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0f278e0940b31daa55db5cf114a5e615123be05e.jpg[/img]

For those of you who don’t know: You can right click items while they’re in your inventory to repair them. It’s the same cost as using your repair bench, but you’ll also spend energy in the process. This isn’t a big deal if you’re using lower tier weapons, but if you’re using a higher tier weapon, you’ll have to think tactically before doing a repair.

[h3][b]📒 Increased durability across the board[/b][/h3]
While we were modifying the recipes, we also decided to increase the durability for all weapons and armor by 50%. If the durability of something was 300, it’s now 450. If it was 200, it’s now 300. This should make your life a bit easier!

[h3][b]📒 Larger Ammo Stacks[/b][/h3]
As part of the battle against inventory management, we’re also increasing the stack sizes for all types of ammo.
Light Ammo: 300 -> 500
Energy Ammo: 300 -> 500
Shotgun Ammo: 100 -> 180
Sniper Ammo: 50 -> 100
Rocket Cartridges: 3 -> 5

[h3][b]📒 Meteochamber Modifications[/b][/h3]
Some players were abusing the Meteochamber. We’ve taken steps to make NPC spawn camping in the Meteochamber less productive.

[h3][b]📒 Changes to Raiding Weapons[/b][/h3]
Land mines have been the primary base attack weapon for quite some time, but we want the rocket launcher to be a useful base-attack weapon as well. We’ve made some changes to make it more useful in a raid:

1. We increased building damage for the Rocket Launcher UWR-102 from 100% to 200% building damage. (The Energy Rocket Launcher is primarily an anti-personnel weapon, so it’s still 50% building damage.)

2. It’s possible to craft rocket launchers without conquering a facility. You can get core tetrads through random drops in the Hyena Den when defeating bosses of each area. It’ll require a few run-throughs and a bit of luck, but you’ll gain access to high level items that once were only obtainable through facilities.

3. If you noticed the change to repair recipes above, it also applies to rocket launchers. So you no longer need ultra-rare items to repair your rocket launchers. A tier-5 weapon repair will cost you: 1 superior metal, 1 superior microparts, & 1 superior terrasite. It’ll also cost you 60 energy if you’re repairing it in the field.

4. If you run out of rockets, we’ve also increased the building damage of blast mines. So they’re still as useful as ever.

That’s it for this week’s patch note.

We’re trying hard to listen to our survivors and always change the game in a positive direction. Constructive feedback is always welcome, so be sure to leave a comment on our Discord server if you have an opinion about what else needs improving.

See you all on Discord!
- Director K

notes.title: [Game Note] Who are the Hyenas?
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

I’d like to share more about the stories behind the factions of Orbis and Ararat Island. 
I briefly explained Orbis and the Hyenas a few Dev Notes back, but now I'd like to delve deeper 
into how the Hyenas came about, and how they came to be a major force on the island.

As usual, let us know through Discord if you want more information about anything specific. 
We’re always listening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0c6b6e9f66f1b51b63099c05faaff76837988474.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 The Origin of the Hyenas[/b][/h3]
The Orbis space station, once a symbol of hope to humanity, gradually shifted its focus away 
from its inhabitants. 

Eventually, the government contracted the Helbine Corporation to replace a 
significant portion of the workforce with robots, resulting in widespread unemployment 
and the emergence of anti-government rebel factions. 

Among these was a group of ex-military and police officers who had lost their jobs to the robots 
and turned to smuggling and contract killing. 

Initially acting as vigilantes and suppliers to the Orbis black market, this group, 
known as the Hyenas, grew in size and power to become a major organized crime syndicate.

After a major rebellion on the space station, the Hyenas absorbed other outlaw groups and 
expanded their influence, but when the government began cracking down on crime, 
they fled to the planet's surface. 

There, they fought alongside Vanessa Holden and the Pioneers against the Orbis government. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a3c3e2a2a3dca51a4139e0679359287686565de8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 A New Start on the Surface[/b][/h3]
After occupying a supply base in the Delta region, they attempted to take down the Vulkan, 
but were nearly annihilated. 

Fortunately, their captain overloaded the plant's electronic converter, 
causing a massive explosion that burned the entire region and left their captain, 
Ethan Ruiz Reyes, missing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7b0068b9f3dba97a15ebe7f0724cf54dc021d063.jpg[/img]

Jeanne Belleville, who regarded Ethan as a father figure, assumed control of the Hyenas  and blamed the Pioneers for his loss, vowing to eliminate them. 

You’ll find many of their corpses scattered throughout the Bunker. 

Only a few Pioneers are still alive, including Vanessa Holden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fa39253d607dab60ef0199d0bde86b2c76d8b1c4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]📒 What They Want[/b][/h3]
The Hyenas have commandeered numerous Orbis bases and equipped them with portals to connect to their mountain supply base. 

Their expertise in weaponry and tactics is not to be underestimated, and Jeanne is easily provoked, 
willing to kill anyone who gets in her way. 

The Hyenas' ultimate objective is to establish their own independent government with themselves at the helm, with little concern for the safety of Earth or Orbis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/282b026b18b4ff1d8a0d4a3bba5f0be89a462d7b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 📢 Notification of Known Issues as of February 16th, 2023
notes.content:
Greetings, survivors!
This is Team Dysterra.

Some of the known issues have been resolved and improved through the last update on February 15th 

and new issues to be resolved in the next update have been added. 

For more detailed update information, be sure to check out the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1527890/view/3669906790349906782]🔗Update Details!🔗[/url][/b]

[h2]📢Notification of Known Issues for February 15th, 2023[/h2]

Known issue notifications are to disclose the thoughts of the Dev team regarding errors that occur while installing or playing the game, in-game bugs, or status(progress). 

They will be announced as often as possible according to the progress of reports from players.

[h2]📌 Recently resolved or reflected 📌[/h2]

✅ Mutant Guardian NPCs not spawning at the last stage of Chemochamber

✅ “*” sign displaying when entering a single-byte number in custom server names

✅ Triangle ceiling/floor dismantling when dismantling other building parts

✅ Characters being stuck at various locations in the underground zone

[h2]🚧 Issues to be fixed in the next update 🚧[/h2]

[quote][u]❗ The time of application of these fixes may be delayed depending on the priority, 
  but they will all be applied as soon as possible. [/u][/quote]
🔧 Receiving items as stacked and being unable to divide by using shift key 
    when purchasing multiple items from the Terrasite trasmitter.

🔧 Abnormal hit sound effect on Geolab's sliding door

🔧 Constant energy consumption after using Air Glide skill 

🔧 Electric barrier remains active until the Mutant Guardian's dead body gets looted and vanished.

🔧 Unable to purchase limited items from Terrasite transmitter.

🔧 Fixed an issue of wheels not moving while riding on the vehicle 

🔧 Minimized frame drop while playing the game.

🔧 Problem of character creation notation error in the lobby server list.

🔧 Gamepad support

🔧 Expansion of areas where you can build housing
　　🎤Dev comments🎤
    💬 Currently, surrounding areas of major bases and facilities restrict players 
         from building housing to prevent monopolization and abuse.
         However, since we received many complaints about the inconvenience these 
         restrictions cause, we are considering reducing the restricted area 
         and will be reflecting the reduction in our next update!

[h2]🔍 Content being fixed or being prepared[/h2]

🧪 Abnormal movement/behavior of some animal NPCs
🎤Dev Comments🎤
    💬We are constantly checking the movement/attack patterns of NPCs.
        We will quickly identify what is causing the issue and fix it as soon as possible

🧪 Improving loading speed.
🎤Dev Comments🎤
　　💬We are continuously working on optimization and other related issues to 
        reduce the time it takes to load servers and run game.

🧪 Difficulty level for field boss Juggernaut
🎤Dev Comments🎤
　　💬 We have been getting reports about Juggernaut being too easy to take down, 
        and bugs that you can take advantage of by using surround walls. 
        Juggernaut will be back with better AI.

🧪 Considering providing a skill reset
🎤Dev Comments🎤
    💬 We have been getting complaints about not being able to reset your skills, and we are thinking
        about adding a skill reset method. For instance, you would have to reset your skills 
        by acquiring certain items through crafting or Facility raids. 

🧪 Fixed an issue where the character could not fully aim down below

🧪 Fixed an issue where the hotkey worked when using the search function on a workbench, etc.

🧪 Issues with installations being installed improperly
　　🎤Dev comments🎤
    💬We are considering improvements for issues such as not being able to place items
        like the Workbench close to the walls, and not being able to automatically align 
        these benches in the direction where the character is looking at. 

🧪 Changing existing settings for Single Player mode
🎤Dev comments🎤
    💬We are considering a modification function for survivors who must have been frustrated 
        because it was impossible to change the settings in the middle of Single Player mode.
        You can change the Single Player mode settings by modifying the contents of the file 
        located in the folder below.
　　- Folder location: >\Dysterra\Dysterra\WorldSettings\SinglePlay.json

🧪 Planned improvements to the long crafting time of forges
　　🎤Dev comments🎤
　　💬The existing balance was set to encourage the forges to operate automatically while
　　the player explores the world and loots major bases and facilities,
　　but we are considering introducing the ‘Forge Upgrade System’ as quickly as possible

　　We will be back soon with better and hopefully more intuitive forges.

notes.title: [Patch Note] Tutorial Improvement and New Items - Update Preview [02.15.2023]
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

Things have finally settled down in our offices following the push to get Season 2 ready on time. 
We’re still going to release consistent patches, and we’re definitely going to sprinkle in new content whenever we can. 

This week we have mostly quality of life changes, but also some new items that can be recycled into very useful crafting materials.

[h2]📒 Quests wait until you’re done fighting.[/h2]

    I know most of you have tried the tutorial (known in-game as the mission guide). 

There were occasions when Vanessa would start talking about your next mission while you were in the middle of a fight. Nobody wants to be distracted when there’s a gun pointed at their head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/56131914ab2e40e33457630e441b2cebd5d59675.jpg[/img]

That’s why we’ve added a new condition to any base-building related quests:
A new quest will not be introduced while NPCs are targeting you. 

The game now lets you finish what you’re doing before Vanessa starts telling you what’s next on your agenda. Let us know if there are any instances where it needs further adjustment.

[h2]📒 Changed some drops[/h2]
    In this patch, we’ll be adding a couple new useful items:

[b][h3]◾ Metal Specimen[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6c41aca0e100130f4c98cde9249b65eb8b128efc.gif[/img]

[b][h3]◾ Titanium Specimen[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9b8f071a360a2840f8e09ab0652420dc6285fb38.gif[/img]

[b][h3]◾ Lithium Specimen[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4efeeb54c2d224b9a3c724ec8c8964993b4521ad.gif[/img]

While Ararat’s facilities are currently battlegrounds, they were originally for research. We’re hoping to include more world building in small ways like this for the foreseeable future. You’ll be able to find them in the Bunker, as well as when defeating a juggernaut(instead of the RF-9 shotgun it used to drop).

These items can be broken down at a recycler into very high level and useful materials.

[h2]📒 Newly Purchasable Items![/h2]
    Work smart, not hard! Instead of farming for items all day, just buy what you need at a terrasite transmitter. You can find them next to most Hyena portals(marked on your map), or you can install one in your home. All you need to do is transmit some terrasite up to Orbis for some terrapoints, and then use those terrapoints to buy whatever’s on sale at the moment.

[b][h3]Newly added items include:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Medical Shot Lv. 1 
[*] Anti-Radiation Shot Lv. 1
[*] Cooling Shot
[*] Heating Shot
[*] Light Ammo
[*] Energy Ammo
[*] Shotgun Shell
[*] Sniper Ammo
[*] Frag Grenade
[/list]
    With the need for mutant mushrooms to make anti-radiation shots, this should be a nice way to stock up when you’re in a rush. But remember that you can only purchase a limited amount of each item, and items may rotate in and out of stock, so it’s good to buy things before you need them.

[h2]📒 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b][h3]Buildings[/h3][/b]
✅ Base parts weren’t snapping together. [i]Fixed it.[/i]

[b][h3]Enemies[/h3][/b]
✅ Enemies were popping through walls. [i]They shouldn’t anymore.[/i]
✅ Animals weren’t making sounds while walking. [i]You should hear bears sneaking up on you now.[/i]
✅ Animals and enemies weren’t moving their feet correctly when turning, or they seemed to be walking on ice. [i]We put our foot down and stopped the problem.[/i]

[b][h3]Inventory[/h3][/b]
✅ Some people lost their protocols while trying to drag their protocol to the repair bench while their inventory was full. [i]That won’t happen any more.[/i]

[b][h3]Other fixes[/h3][/b]
✅ Some containers where floating up in the air. [i]We bolted them down so they’ll stay in place.[/i]

[b][h3]UI[/h3][/b]
✅ We fixed several small UI issues across the board.


Okay. That’s a wrap for this week.
I’ll see you on the servers!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Our first Season 2 patch - Update Preview [02.07.2023]
notes.content:
Adjusted title due to the update on the patch schedule - 02.07.2023
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to Dysterra!

We hope everyone had a fantastic time during the free weekend of Dysterra! It's been a true joy to welcome so many new players to the game, and we're grateful for their contributions in the forums. With their fresh perspectives and insightful feedback, we're able to continue improving the game and deliver an even better gaming experience. Thank you to all of our players, old and new, for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1054c0ecbab269a0295da95f3af1122705c31208.jpg[/img]

As developers, our goal is to provide the best gaming experience possible in Dysterra. We’re continuously gathering feedback, analyzing gameplay data, and experimenting with new features and improvements. We’re dedicated to fixing bugs, balancing gameplay, and adding new content.

We appreciate your patience and your feedback as we work to make Dysterra better. Although some technical issues may take longer to resolve, please let us know if an issue is taking too long. Your feedback is a large part of our development process, and player feedback feedback lets us know what we’re doing right(or wrong).

With that said, this week’s patch is mostly aimed at fixing some common issues addressing drop rates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/296692c683f8997f6b59ba2e36cf038c6aa561bf.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 More Mutant Mushrooms[/h2]
Exciting news regarding radiation shots!
We're adding nearly 100 new mutant mushroom spawning locations to help players craft more radiation shots when they need them. Raiding Orbis bases should be much easier now.


[h2]📒 Changes to Item Drop Rates[/h2]
We're constantly adding new and exciting items to the game to keep things fresh and interesting for our players. But the influx of new items in our Season 2 update comes with the need to maintain balance in our drop tables. In order to ensure players can consistently obtain the items they're seeking when farming, we're taking the necessary steps to rebalance several of our container drop tables.

We understand that obtaining specific items can be an important part of the gaming experience, and we want to make sure that players are able to do so in a fair and consistent manner. By rebalancing the drop tables, we aim to strike a balance between excitement and accessibility, providing players with a more enjoyable and rewarding experience overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fffa3f7171881d19f9ea22c4a60728eeb5ea2fdd.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 Stronger Lv.1 Batteries[/h2]
Batteries are now harder to craft with the added requirement of Lithium, meaning they are harder to get when you need them. To compensate for this, we’ve decided to enhance the power of Lv.1 batteries, increasing their energy points from 20 to 25.


[h2]📒 Optimizations[/h2]
In response to single-player feedback, we're making adjustments to the number of resource nodes in single-player mode to better suit the solo experience. This update aims to provide a more optimized and enjoyable experience for players who prefer to journey through the game without other players attacking them.


[h2]📒 AI Optimization[/h2]
To enhance overall gameplay, we’ve made some improvements to AI pathfinding. These updates ensure that AI characters can navigate the game world more effectively and efficiently, allowing them to reach their desired destinations with greater accuracy.


[h2]📒 Bug Fixes[/h2]
◾ The recycler was spitting out the wrong items for a couple of materials. We’ve fixed it.

◾ We’ve patched up the Bunker to make sure people don’t get stuck in places they shouldn’t.

◾ A few facilities had an issue where the final boss wasn’t spawning. We had a chat with the NPCs, and they’ll be showing up for work from now on.

◾ A couple players weren’t able to rejoin their teams after leaving them. You should be able to play in full teams of 4 with no issue now.

◾ There was an issue with building restrictions for bases with multiple users where players would suddenly not be able to interact with a part of their base. That issue should now be a thing of the past.

That’s a wrap for this week.
Be sure to buy the game while it’s still on sale if you enjoyed it!

-Director K

notes.title: Patch Note: What’s in Season 2? - Update Preview [02.01.2023]
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!!

We’re so close to the update !! We’re in full crunch at our offices and are doing our best to make sure everything is as perfect as possible. There’s a lot to unpack in this update, so I’ll fit as much in as possible.

A quick rundown of what’s in store: 2 brand new underground areas to explore (one PvP, and one PvE solo area), new map functionality, 22 new recovery items, 3 new guns, 2 new melee weapons, 4 new sets of armor, a new ammo type, new Hyena NPCs, new mutant NPCs, a turret buff, level 4 base parts, streaming mode, debuffs to base protection, and big changes to how global rankings are calculated.

We’re still in early access, but I really think this Season 2 update will bring us a lot closer to where we want the game to be. I’d love to hear your feedback so be sure to head over to our discord and mention one of the devs (@Dev_Armond, etc.) and let us know what needs fixin’!

[h3]📒Two New Areas to Explore[/h3]

[h3]◾ The Bunker[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a473139e050a10906fd6a826296718be72b8146a.jpg[/img]

The first underground area is a free-for-all space where you will very likely run into other players. If you go deep enough, you’ll run into new mutants that may just end your exploration if you’re not careful. There are entrances all around the map, so you’ll never have to look far to find a way in. Once you’re in, however, you can’t turn back around and run away. You’ll need to find the exit if you want to keep all of your stuff, so be careful.

[h3]◾ The Hyena Den[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/84b59b7a0711501c53deab455e34e87c3306c209.jpg[/img]

The second underground area is a private instance where you won’t run into anyone else. You can test your mettle against new Hyena bosses, and improve your gear when you’re done with all the new loot you picked up. Like the Bunker, you’ll have to go through it and find the exit if you want to live to tell the tale of your bravery.

[h3]📒 Tutorial Updates[/h3]
The tutorial(known in-game as the Mission Guide) is usually the fastest way to understand the basics of any game. We've made several small improvements to make the tutorial more effective at assisting new players. The largest one is an item frequency map overlay that will show where an item is likely to be found. If you don’t know where you find something, this should help point you in the right direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e57191537043e93148ca0565668a8020952d1146.jpg[/img]

It’s also available in the journal. If you’re farming for a specific item or two, you can find the item in your journal, and check the “Display on world map” button. You’ll then be able to see the item’s drop locations on your map.

Note: Items are randomly distributed into their respective container(s), so you’ll have to display the item’s corresponding container(s) on your map when you’re looking for it. And in case you’re wondering, you can display multiple container distributions on your map simultaneously.

[h3]📒 UI Upgrades - Skill Level Progress[/h3]
You can now see your skill level progress more easily. We’ve added a progress bar to your hot key menu to make it more convenient to check your progress to unlocking that next skill point.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c566dcee47c07849db76a28ae8cc5d74227dcae6.jpg[/img]

[h3]📒 Increased Crafting Times[/h3]
Crafting differences before were small, but we’ve increased the crafting times for weapons and armor to reflect their corresponding tier levels.

Level 1 : 30 seconds
Level 2 : 1 minute
Level 3 : 4 minutes
Level 4 : 6 minutes
Level 5 : 10 minutes

[h3]📒 22 New Recovery Items[/h3]
We’ve added 22 new items to help you recover from all types of status effects. Some notable items are:

◾Orbis Battery: You can reduce system overload cooldown time at the cost of a small amount of HP.
◾Pocket Whiskey: You’ll heal bleeding and fractures, but lose some HP.
◾Battery Pack Lv.3: double the charge of a Lv.2 Battery
◾Vitamin Drink: Heals health
◾Trauma Pack: Heals health, bleeding, and fractures

[h3]📒 3 New Guns[/h3]

[h3]◾ EL-1 Pistol (Bellatrix)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bd3216874787c4c4a75318c1445407568812b525.jpg[/img]

A stronger tier-3 pistol. It may look like it packs a weaker punch than the tier-2 energy pistol, but its larger magazine and the ability to burst fire 3 shots at a time will make your enemies think twice about chasing after you.

[h3]◾ P-38 Shotgun (Tirador)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/48e6997b4500368ab426cbdcee7ebfda1af031e8.jpg[/img]

A cheaper double-barreled shotgun for players that need a shotgun quick. You only have two shots before you need to reload, so it’s best for picking off enemies one by one, or as a backup weapon when you’re in a jam.

[h3]◾ TAR-1 Assault Rifle (Thundershower)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f40c2c38dbf9788aeda562170c7af0bfb1c64c94.jpg[/img]

This tier-3 rifle combines the power of a regular assault rifle with the firing speed of a submachine gun. It has fewer rounds than a basic tier-2 submachine gun, but each bullet gives more damage.

[h3]📒 2 New Melee Weapons[/h3]

[h3]◾ Battle Hammer[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f635e65f0c102f60bdb909392036e52e95020a97.jpg[/img]

The Battle Hammer is a craftable, and repairable!, weapon that is stronger than a cyclops claw. It may swing slowly, but each hit will give your opponent the fracture status effect. The more hits you land, the more slowly your opponent will move, allowing you to get more hits in!

[h3]◾ Great Battle Hammer[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/daaafbd0eaf95d50670ede0ae0a6f49c941a33cd.jpg[/img]

A stronger version of the basic battle hammer, this hammer gives the fracture effect, slowing your opponent’s escape. You could also use it on powerful enemies to slow their approach and use that extra time to reload or heal.

[h3]📒 New Ammo Type[/h3]
Sniper Ammo. Ammo strategies in the game needed some complexity, so we’ve added a separate ammo for snipers.

[h3]📒 4 New Sets of Armor (4 pieces each)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/69bcd590cf39709c42cc6e6786f5493ca2835894.jpg[/img]
(From left to right: Nanite, Mirage, Eisen, Aegis)

We’ve added four new sets of tier-4 armor. Each 4-piece set has its own strengths and weaknesses, so choose carefully when you’re dressing for your next outing.

[h3]📒 New Hyena NPC: Hyena Heavy Assaulter[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/471fd10d2a19e2adc72b6f24c1a582452f3a237a.jpg[/img]

We’ve also added a new Hyena spot event. In a small number of bases, you’ll run across the Hyena Heavy Assaulter. We hope he’ll add more variety to the PvE landscape of Dysterra.

[h3]📒 Stronger Turrets = Better Offline Defense[/h3]
We’ve strengthened turret HP across the board to improve offline base defense. Some turrets now have over double their initial HP, so don’t be afraid to add a few more to your base before you log off!

[h3]📒 New Building Ingredients[/h3]
We wanted to add some depth to the building process. Before, you could build everything with basic farmable resources, but now you’ll need screws to hold things together. You can’t craft them, so you’ll have to go find them in lower tier buildings if you want to add something to your base.

[h3]📒 Level 4 Housing Upgrade[/h3]
We’ve added a level 4 upgrade option to most base building components. We’re hoping the level 4 design let’s people know that you have a lot of valuable goodies inside your base. I think it’ll be more fun to let you see for yourself in-game what a level four base looks like!

[h3]📒 Streaming Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7ff00e17ec8d926cc58752fedbef426545dddd18.jpg[/img]

To make playing Dysterra as stress-free as possible for all of our amazing streamers, we’ve added a “Streaming Mode” to the options menu.

Currently, activating it will do three things: replace all player nicknames with false nicknames, hide server names in the lobby server menu, and also hide the location of your core.

[h3]📒 Base Protection Changes![/h3]
Base protection is a great way for new or casual players to get used to the game without fear of losing progress due to offline raiding. The feature seemed a bit OP, so we made it so that you can’t do anything productive while your base protection is active.

That means you can’t craft, recycle, repair, open a chest, or even open a door. You can turn base units like electric floors on and off, and you can charge your core with any terrasite on your character.
But don’t worry! You won’t deactivate it if you click on something by accident. If you try to do something, you’ll get a pop up notification asking if you’d like to disable base protection.

[h3]📒 Cooldown times reflect usage[/h3]
In our last patch, cooldown times for base protection were locked at 6 hours. We don’t want people waiting 6 hours if they press the button by accident. That’s why we also planned a dynamic cooldown time with a minimum cooldown of 2 hours. So if you have an initial protection time of 14 hours, and you turn it off after 7 hours(50% of total protection time), you’ll only have to wait 3 hours to turn it back on again(50% of total cooldown time).

[h3]📒 PvE / PvP Global Rankings[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/337eba8e22a86520223bcb23a555f6b6e6d1a792.jpg[/img]

During the course of a season, a player might join several different server types. We want a player’s global ranking to reflect their overall skill in the game, but we also don’t want to discourage players from trying out PvE or Hardcore if they feel like it.

That’s why we’ve added weights to the points.
PvE will be scored in the global rankings exactly the same way as it is now.
PvP will have a x1.5 weight on any points earned.
Hardcore will have a x2.3 weight on any points earned.

These numbers are a starting point. We might fiddle with the exact weights down the line if it seems necessary, but for the most part they should stay similar to where they are now.

That was a lot!! But there’s even more that I didn’t mention, so be sure to hop on the servers and see what’s new and how much has changed in the game.

Good luck out there!
- Director K

[h2]📢Notification of Known Issues for January 27th, 2023📢[/h2]
[u]Known issue notifications are to disclose the thoughts of the Dev team regarding errors that occur while installing or playing the game, in-game bugs, or status(progress). They will be announced as often as possible according to the progress of reports from players.[/u]

✅ Fixed an issue where “*” was displayed when entering a single-byte number in a custom server name
✅ Fixed an issue that triangle ceiling/floor dismantles along when dismantling other building parts
✅ Fixed an issue that Vehicle's weapon decal is displays as wooden material decal
✅ Fixed issue that Hyena base does not have its marker displayed at the world map.

notes.title: [Dev Note] Getting Ready for Season 2
notes.content:
It’s almost time for Season 2!!!!

We know you’re curious about what a new Season will mean for you, your rankings, and for the player base as a whole. This week’s dev note will hopefully dispel any questions or concerns you have about what’s going to happen next week when we update the servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5d17d5a3611c318d2a9bd80c62fb672341eb5f2e.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 When?[/h2]
If all things go smoothly, we’re planning to update the servers on February 1st. If nothing goes to plan, and everything goes sideways, we’ll update on February 2nd at the latest.

[h2]📒 Server Updates[/h2]
[list]
    [*] All servers will be wiped during maintenance. Any progress you have will disappear during the wipe.
    [*] Following maintenance, each region will have two server options: a PvP server & a PvE server
    [*] Select region(s) may also have a hardcore server.
[/list]
[h2]📒 My Ranking (and Achievements)[/h2]
[list]
    [*] All global and server rankings and related scores will be reset during server maintenance.
    [*] For ranking purposes, any points earned before the scheduled maintenance on February 1st will be reflected in Season 1 rankings. Season 2 will begin immediately after we complete maintenance and the servers reopen.
    [*] Season 1 points and rankings will in no way affect Season 2 points or rankings.
    [*] Rankings from previous global seasons will eventually be visible from a drop down menu in your player profile sometime following the February 1st update but not right away. Server specific rankings will be lost forever, so be sure to take a screenshot if you want to compare your progress across seasons.
[/list]
[h2]📒 Skins & Terrapoints[/h2]
[list]
    [*] You’ll keep all of your current TP(terrapoints) as well as any skins you’ve acquired through lobby chests or Twitch drops.
[/list]
[h2]📒 Steam Achievements[/h2]
[list]
    [*] We’ll be updating our current steam achievement requirements, but never fear! You’ll keep all current steam achievements regardless of any changes to their requirements. 
[/list]
[h2]📒 What kind of content can I expect in the update?[/h2]
You’ll have to wait until next Tuesday’s patch/update note to find out. But I can assure you that we have lots of new items, new NPCs, plenty of underground space to explore, and hopefully an influx of new players to keep you on your toes.

notes.title: [Dev Note] Season 2 starting soon!
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

Woah!! It’s been almost 2 months since we released into early access. It was a rough start with all of the hackers, cheaters, and server issues, but we’ve ironed all of that out now, and are looking to start fresh with Season 2: Forgotten Ruins!!!

Season 2 will be bringing with it quite a few changes. You’ll be getting two new underground areas to explore, new Hyena NPCs, and even new mutant NPCs. We’re also doing our first total rankings reset, as well as including a lot of smaller improvements that we can dig into later.

[h2]The Bunker[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fa39253d607dab60ef0199d0bde86b2c76d8b1c4.jpg[/img]
The first underground area is a free-for-all space where you will very likely run into other players. If you go deep enough, you’ll run into new mutants that may just end your exploration if you’re not careful. There are entrances all around the map, so you’ll never have to look far to find a way in. Once you’re in, however, you can’t turn back around and run away. You’ll need to find the exit if you want to keep all of your stuff, so be careful.

[h2]The Hyena Den[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ace383516e08e2e5016464460407b6d36f0ec36b.jpg[/img]
The second underground area is a private instance where you won’t run into anyone else. You can test your mettle against new Hyena bosses, and improve your gear when you’re done with all the new loot you picked up. Like the Bunker, you’ll have to go through it and find the exit if you want to live to tell the tale of your bravery.

[h2]Release Date?[/h2]
We’re aiming for February 1st or 2nd(Wednesday or Thursday) as the release date, so keep your eyes peeled for the official release notice on our Discord news channel.

[h2]What about existing servers?[/h2]
We’re still working out the nitty gritty about how we’ll be applying the update to worlds that are still in-progress. We’ll post the specifics about our plans regarding updating servers next week. But I can tell you now that we’re planning to open PvP, PvE, and hardcore servers for each region, so you won’t have to wait to test out the new content.

[h2]What about my ranking?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/337eba8e22a86520223bcb23a555f6b6e6d1a792.jpg[/img]
We’re figuring out a way to keep rankings from past seasons visible. I’ll let you know once it’s we’ve officially decided on how we’ll do that.


That was a lot to cover, but I wanted to keep it short and simple.
You can @mention the devs in our discord channel (ex: @Dev_Armond) if there’s something you don’t understand about the update. This is our first time doing a major update, so we’re welcome to constructive feedback.

See you next week!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Offline Base Protection - Update Preview [01.19.2023]
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

How have you all been? It’s been a chilly week here in South Korea. The patches this week and next will be small since we’re getting closer to our big February update, but you’ll still like the quality of life improvements we’re adding to the game this week.

This time around we’re adding off-line base protection, as well as some improvements to in-game chat.

[h2]📒 New Base Protection Feature[/h2]
Dysterra was built around the concept of raiding. Breaking down the walls to someone else’s base is thrilling, and often profitable. We’ve realized that new players, as well as casual players, struggle with being raided while they’re offline and having to start over from scratch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/152d2fd60eb5961b3824d6326a9b57e382e5fb19.png[/img]

That’s why this week we’re adding a “[b]Base Protection[/b]” ability to your building core. Activating it will render your base invincible for a limited time depending on the complexity of your build. For example, if you have a dozen furnaces surrounded by level three walls and foundations with turrets and landmines outside, you might only have the ability to protect your base for [b]as short as 3 hours[/b]. On the other hand, if you follow the tutorial, and have nothing but a building core inside your brand new base, it will be invincible for [b]as long as 24 hours[/b].

You’ll be able to tell something is protected when it is shimmering with the pattern in the video below.

[previewyoutube=eqO3oaYDloI;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to make sure this feature isn’t overpowered, so we’ve added some conditions that I hope will be good enough for most survivors. Let us know on Discord if it needs rebalancing.

The catch:
1. Anything powered by a repeater, or that can damage other players may be damaged while your base is protected. (i.e. Mines, turrets, electric floors, and fences can be damaged.)
2. The time remaining for the protection effect will be displayed to other players if they examine part of your build.
3. There’s a cool time of 6 hours(IRL time), regardless of how long your base is protected.
4. Your cooldown time begins if you deactivate it, and you can’t reactivate it until the 6 hours have passed.


[h2]📒 Chat Features[/h2]
We’ve added two new features to chat.

The first is a list of recent private chat usernames. Communication is a key part of teamwork, and we hope this makes it easier to keep in touch with your friends… and enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ac2608a38c43e4fa85fa019cc7507b4b8c07ea56.png[/img]

We’re still polishing it, but we decided to put it in now and continue updating it as we go. You can see previous private chat partners by pressing the UP or DOWN arrow on your keyboard. Then you can use your mouse to click the person you’d like to chat with.

The second is the ability to block and unblock, other survivors. Some people are just unpleasant. So if you don’t want to hear what someone is trying to say, you can block them and never have to worry about them unless you run into them on the server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7a35f0de1044133ce298fc527b148c5f69b40517.png[/img]

You can block someone by clicking their name in the chat window, or by opening the Survivors(L) menu, and manually blocking them by finding their username and clicking the X next to it. You may also unblock someone here if you feel like forgiving them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/af9a1b8864ff0af948499edab74dfeff33b27bdb.png[/img]


That’ll wrap up this week’s patch note. Take care!
- Director K

notes.title: [Game Note] The World of Dysterra, Pt. 2
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

Things are starting to pick up again here in the office, and we’re revving up to release our first major update. We’re planning to release it the first week of February (fingers crossed). There will be a lot to unpack, but I’d rather wait until we’ve ironed everything out before telling you all about what’s inside the update. What I can tell you right now is that we have two underground areas for you to explore. One is an underground training base used by the Hyenas, which will include all-new soldier NPCs. The other will be a mysterious underground area with multiple layers. Here’s an image of the latter to pique your curiosity. I’ll fill you in more next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d7a30a5638d5a2552678202f15777bfe7b8044d2.jpg[/img]
Last week, I started sharing the backstory of the world of Dysterra.
We covered some basics about the world, but this week I’d like to dig deeper into the history of Ararat Island, and why the facilities are built there.

After hundreds of years in outer space, Orbis started running out of terrasite, its primary energy source. While increasing solar capacity would delay the need for more terrasite, the fastest solution to the problem was to mine terrasite down on the surface where conditions have mostly improved to make it livable between occasional volcanic eruptions.

The Orbis government placed five drills on the island to extract terrasite quickly and efficiently. Orbis also constructed research facilities on top of four drills to use the mined terrasite to study ways to effectively use it to counter the effects of terrafire on the local and global climate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a269fb2313ddcc3be2b169c5761d0f4886edb6ed.jpg[/img]
The [b]Geolab[/b] research facility was built to find ways to stabilize the ground for construction building stability, while also finding out how to create artificial earthquakes in order to bring terrasite and other minerals to the surface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0a17d7334a774c7fd2678e88fa8492a00f32f3b6.jpg[/img]
The [b]Meteocenter[/b] facility was built to investigate ways of controlling the weather to assist with farming and the recolonization of new areas. It currently only affects air temperature but it could one day also control precipitation. Since beans are mostly temperature dependant, they’re the only crop to have been successfully grown on Earth following the Great Terrafire. That’s why there are so many cans of baked beans lying around the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0fb1f0d98d37bfee57ffe94628d2f3f4af95bc75.jpg[/img]
The [b]Satellite Station[/b] was built to facilitate effective communication between the Orbis government and what was happening down on the surface. The EMP towers were built to allow communication with the space station during occasional electric storms in the ionosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ced3f6f78e532762c27c5b9fa92d093885f6a297.jpg[/img]
The [b]Chemochamber[/b] was an experimental facility used to find ways to enhance physical ability using gamma rays emitted from activated terrasite. Testing started on local bear and elk, and moved on to DNA testing producing chimeras and other creatures you’ll find in Dysterra. At the center of the facility is an electric pylon that was once used to pacify the “creations” of the facility, but it seems that a few creatures have learned to absorb the electricity emitted from the pylons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/074f6ec04b4fbe986950b865d448ad5c7ae5e4cc.jpg[/img]
As for the [b]Delta Plant[/b] and the large “crystal” above it, the delta plant was made to focus on deep drilling in order to extract as much terrasite as possible. The large “crystal” floating above it is an apparatus that uses terrasite to beam gamma rays (which are invisible to the naked eye) to Orbis in order to power the station. Something to note: the small terrasite transmitters located in Hyena bases and crafted at workbenches work by transmitting their terrasite to the Delta Plant’s Orbital Gamma Ray Emitter(O.G.R.E.). Any energy received by the OGRE is then sent directly to Orbis when its orbit passes above the facility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4dd908d41a7d1cdccec4d90d0bbd429cd3490012.jpg[/img]
Lastly, the Wall! One of our survivors asked me on Discord about the giant wall spanning the island. It was originally constructed to keep the Satellite Station secure by separating it from the rest of the island. Due to the importance of the Delta Plant to the future of Orbis, an additional boundary was also built to seclude the Delta Plant. 


I hope this week’s dev note quenched your curiosity about the facilities. We’re excited about the February update, and we’re working hard to make sure you all will like it. My dev note next week will be the story of the events leading to the fall of Orbis control on the island, and the rise of the Hyena forces’ power.

Have a good one!
- Director K

notes.title: [Game Note] The World of Dysterra, Pt. 1
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

The world of Dysterra can seem a little confusing at times, and I’m sure you all have questions about the world.

This week, I’ll answer some basic questions that have likely come to mind while playing the game.
I’ll assume that you’ve watched the opening story video, but for those of you who haven’t, you can open up Dysterra and watch it before you read the rest of the dev note.

[h3]Buuuuut… if you’re in a rush, here’s a heavily condensed version:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1f2cda88dac18d3d1fe090ea24d614cc5a6d7f4f.jpg[/img]

[b]Humanity discovered a new power source underground, and called it terrasite.
The more terrasite that humanity mined, the more Earth’s core became unstable.
Eventually, Earth was plagued with continuous volcanic eruptions, and so a large portion of humanity fled the planet to live permanently on a satellite, called Orbis, in outer space.
Orbis eventually started to run out of terrasite(its energy source), so you and others have been sent down to find more. You’re expected to mine as much as possible before returning; That’s why Orbis won’t send an escape rocket until the island’s volcano is about to burst.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3a8818c2f3e4b17c2ab893bdcd89c1b382b9e78a.jpg[/img]

If you want to hear the story in detail, you’ll have to open the game and watch the intro.
So now on to what I deem are the questions that aren’t answered in the opening story scene.

[h1]Why Ararat Island?[/h1]
Ararat is just one of many islands on Earth. Just as Noah’s ark landed at Mount Ararat following the great flood, Orbis named this island “Ararat” to signify its first time returning to Earth following the great catastrophe that caused humanity to abandon the planet for the space station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f8ee17cc3e5b9b1e503a74044515e031ff438419.jpg[/img]

What’s special about this island is that there has been recent seismic and volcanic activity, bringing large amounts of terrasite to the surface through earthquakes, as well as through recently formed lava flows in the Delta Region. The sheer amount of easily accessible terrasite makes it a prime location for mining.

[h1]Orbis vs. Hyena[/h1]
While playing Dysterra, you’ve probably wondered about the relationship between Orbis and the Hyenas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e9a113fa723bafe41ff2a443ace2176c81ff98fd.jpg[/img]

A lot has happened in the few hundred years that humanity has been confined to outer space.
As the government of Orbis slowly replaced human jobs with robots, more and more people lost a way to support themselves.
Without their livelihood, they turned to crime. The Hyenas were once a small, back-alley group of smugglers based on Orbis, but they eventually became a full-on organized crime group positioned against the government of Orbis.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e4ce9b067c5c3d083c9b476ced89e111403672c6.jpg[/img]

The branch of the Hyenas that’s based on Earth is spread across a multitude of islands, and uses dropships to transport troops and supplies between their bases.
They’ve currently occupied most of the Orbis structures on Ararat already, but the Orbis robots have been able to maintain control over the main facilities and the many installations they have around the island by using radiation to make the areas inhospitable to humans.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fbb210cf960db82a08e75fad6257c7d45ff4353d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ask Me Your Questions[/h1]
I’ll be sharing the story of Dysterra over the next several weeks, and I have a good idea of what I think is important for survivors to know. However, I’ve been building and designing the world of Dysterra for so long that a lot of things seem like common knowledge to me. I’d like to hear your questions about the world of Dysterra. 

Please send any story-related questions you’d like answered in my next dev note to Dev_Armond or Dev_Beckenstein on our Discord server. I won’t be able to answer everything, but I’ll pick the more common questions and answer those.

Stay warm out there! (Or stay cool if you’re not in the northern hemisphere!)

- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Happy New Year! - Update Preview [01.11.2023]
notes.content:
Hello Survivors
Team Dysterra here

We have updated the patch note with newest 2 new weapons included with this upcoming update on Wednesday. Please check the updated announcements!.


[hr][/hr]

Hello Survivors
Team Dysterra here 

We have encountered with unexpected problem while preparing the maintenance planned for today, Inevitably, we have to adjust the pre-announced maintenance time. We would like to ask for your understanding. We will fix this issue as soon as possible to provide the update.

Adjusted maintenance time: 11th January 2023 (Wed)

[hr][/hr]

Happy New Year, Survivors!!

I hope you’re all feeling refreshed and ready to start 2023! A good portion of our team used the end of December to get some much-needed R&R, so our patch this week is a little smaller than usual.

This week’s patch includes the end of the Christmas Skin event, some new permanent items to replace the temporary Christmas ones, two new weapons, and a few other small changes we’ve made to make Dysterra more enjoyable.

[h2]🎄Christmas is over.😥[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/05aa25baf7c63029f05fbf0e5a3c39bdf0e1c3e9.jpg[/img]
It’s the new year, and that means taking down Christmas trees and putting away the decorations until next year. I know you’ll all be sad to lose those decorations around your base, but don’t worry! The trees will still be where you put them, just without their decorations. Your storage boxes will also still have their Christmas skins, but you won’t be able to apply the Christmas skin to any new box.

[h2]📒 2 New Weapons![/h2]
We’ve also got two new weapons for you all this week! One gun, and one melee knife.

[h3]Nadelfein[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/cfbdaa292499b5b8f51b2c37ea68ac5de3421b50.jpg[/img]

The Nadelfein is a blue-tier(tier 3) bolt-action sniper rifle that uses physical ammo.
Being a bolt-action rifle, the time between shots is longer than other guns, so aim well before your enemy jumps out of range.


[h3]Cold Steel[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/977c211204e5cff0a29a1cd167515142cec435d1.jpg[/img]

Cold Steel is a blue-tier (tier 3) combat knife. It’s not quite as strong as other similar melee weapons, but its light weight allows for a faster rate of attack. It can also be thrown at an enemy if they start running away.


[h2]📒 Goodbye “Pudding”, Hello “Cleansing Shot”[/h2]
The reactions to the Christmas consumables were positive, so we’ve decided to make permanent items that have the same abilities.

Starting from this patch, we’ll be introducing 2 new craftable items and 1 new item drop.

[h3]Cleansing Shot[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c81beed5b5e926102d028b97b37d865233f5c472.png[/img]
The “Cleansing Shot” is a craftable item that will partially heal radiation, bleeding, and fracture status effects.

[h3]System Cooldown Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7666e64908918a777d99fd27b923dd51ffbd5320.png[/img]
The “System Cooldown Pack” is a craftable item that will reduce the time required to cool down from a failed hacking attempt.

[h3]Prime Bear Meat / Prime Bear Steak[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f0e0d93345e6f8d95ed47a09d6141f8926b89971.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b2dcfb9d29b398f096de0e8585c784721428e4dc.png[/img]
“Prime Bear Meat” has a chance to drop when gathering bear meat. It needs to be cooked first, but it’s very filling.

[h2]🌎 Making the world more believable[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7077856a4f3a120858b11a50f39357616b34706f.jpg[/img]
As we start to implement more stories into our game, we want the world of Dysterra to make more sense and be more believable. We’ve replaced Orbis robots with Hyena troops in specific places around the map and added a few Hyena guard posts around the map as well. For those of you that want to know more about the world of Dysterra, I’ll be sharing parts of the backstory of Ararat Island and Orbis in the (very) near future.

[h2]🔧 Other Adjustments[/h2]
Some other things we fixed this time around include fixing emotes so your view doesn’t clip through your survivor’s body when you pan around while emoting.

We’ve heard player comments about the difficulty of finding a team to help tackle the harder facilities. As a result, we’ve lengthened a portion of NPC respawn times at the Chemochamber and the Meteocenter. We’ve also reduced the number of NPC spawns at the Meteocenter while at the same time reducing the total time required to “occupy” each sector. Lastly, we’ve lowered the total HP of Bombbugs at the Satellite Station.

One last thing to take into consideration is that we’ve changed the default world length to 336 days(14 days IRL), and we’ve also changed it so that worlds will last for at least 240 days (10 days IRL). This means that you can shorten or extend a server’s life, but you can only shorten it to a certain degree. We did this to give more casual players a chance to enjoy the game over the course of a week, but to also still allow players to have control over the world's lifespan.

That concludes this week’s patch note. I know it’s not as big as usual, but I hope you’ll understand that our team needed some rest after working so hard following our launch in late November. We’re all back in the office now and ready to get back to work, so I’ll see you all again next week!

-Director K

I think you’ll like this week’s update. We’ve got a brand new emote system for you to try out, as well as 2 new weapons, 3 new attachments, and some UI changes. As always, let us know what you think on the Discord server!

[h2]📒 Emote Yourself![/h2]
Communication with other players is part of what makes a game fun. Typing in the chat window can be a pain during intense situations, and there’s always a chance that your teammates won’t see it.

[previewyoutube=DKuqSQ2elMw;full][/previewyoutube]

With emotes you can communicate more easily with other survivors by holding the F4 button, hovering over the action you want to perform, and then releasing the F4 button. We’ve programmed it so you’re unable to use an emote while you’re jumping, gliding, swimming, crouching, or aiming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a797bbb9826f1adc6245cedf2f97dcb9f4e1094f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Currently you can choose one of eight expressions:[/h3]
- Hello
- You’re done
- Bang
- Clap
- Surrender
- Shhh
- Go
- Hate (No thanks)

[h2]📒 2 New Weapons[/h2]
[h3]SUBMACHINE GUN MMP-500X ECLAIR[/h3]
This tier-3 (Blue Tier) gun inflicts the bleeding status effect in addition to regular damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c16480640138d8c58be683b930699f551f10e858.png[/img]

[h3]TOMAHAWK[/h3]
This throwable weapon can also be used to hack your enemies into pieces. It’s slightly weaker than the BF Machete, but the fact that it gives enemies the “bleeding” status effect more than makes up the difference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1075f0c61712a30b05ae1430335a856cd3e79703.png[/img]

[h2]📒 Other Improvements To Weapons[/h2]
- 3 new gun attachments: an advanced silencer, an advanced compensator, and an advanced vertical grip
- Louder guns are more likely to catch the attention of NPCs.
- Melee weapons are more powerful across the board.
- The BF Machete, as well as both types of cyclops claws, now give the “bleeding” status effect.

[h2]📒 Terrafire Countdown UI Improvement[/h2]
We heard some survivors complaining about the terrafire countdown being annoying and covering the main part of the screen for far too long. We’ve changed it so that now the countdown is more discrete until there’s only 1 day left (1 hour of real world time).

[h3][u]More than 1 day left (1 hour IRL)[/u][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a4c9c8b95140090fd0bcefdc0493e0946cf34160.png[/img]
[h3][u]Less than 1 day left (1 hour IRL)[/u][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/58244a3467fa5bacece1f9700463cf4bcd2ed9c2.png[/img]

[h2]📒 “Skip All” Button[/h2]
We know there are quite a few pop-ups when you load into the game for the first time each day. For people that are in a hurry, and want to get into the servers as fast as possible, we’ve added an “X” in the upper right corner that you can click to skip all of the achievement and point notifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/acf01ec7378aa55f1ce6423cf6ba01d301d98643.png[/img]

That’s it for this week’s patch. I’ll see you all next year with more great updates to Dysterra.

Stay warm!
- Director K

notes.title: 2023 DYSTERRA Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Director K here again.

It's already been a month since Dysterra began early access on November 24.

We’ve been so hard at work fixing bugs and programming errors, watching how you play the game, listening to your opinions, and preparing solutions to issues that it’s hard to believe so much time has already passed.

You’ve all been so generous with your advice and feedback, and we hope to start repaying that generosity by sharing clear goals for where development of Dysterra is headed.

So without further ado, here’s our roadmap for the short-term and the long-term.

[b][h1]📅 THE SHORT TERM 📅[/h1][/b]
The more survivors we have, the more fun that Dysterra becomes. We’re planning several ways for all kinds of survivors to play together.

[b][h3]🔧 Bug fixes, optimization, and balancing[/h3][/b]
Fixing bugs, optimizing performance, and balancing the game are the most important things for our game’s success in the short term. 

We’ve been improving various server and client issues, while at the same time optimizing as many things as we can, but there’s still more that we can fine-tune and improve.
We’ll keep working on these factors to provide a stable and enjoyable experience for everyone.

As for the radiation status effect, it was first designed as a device to require players to acquire minimal armor before attacking bases and facilities. Actual player data, however, hasn’t reflected what we originally expected, so we are making adjustments through patches and updates to improve that part of gameplay.

[b][h3]🔧 Convenience Features[/h3][/b]
Over the next two months, there will be a lot of quality-of-life improvements to the user experience as well as to items. This includes quality-of-life features for teams such as the ability to use emotes, chat enhancements, and ping system improvements.

[b][h3]🔧 New Weapons and Items[/h3][/b]
As you’re all probably expecting: A variety of weapons and items will also be introduced every month.

Most of the new weapons we’re adding will be medium/high tier weapons, and basically, the more used and the higher the tier, the more difficult it will be to obtain and maintain.
These measures are intended to prevent one-sided combat caused by equipment gaps and we’ll be adjusting weapon balance through continuous game-play data analysis and player trends.


[b][h1]📅 THE MID TERM TO LONG TERM 📅[/h1][/b]
Gameplay elements will be expanded in every way.

We will especially continue to add a multitude of enemies and locales throughout the world for players to find and challenge themselves with. We’ll be adding a brand-new area to the map, as well as broadening the number and variety of resources and items. Everything new will complement existing elements and add depth to the game.

[b][h3]🧪 New Content[/h3][/b]
New game content also serves as a vehicle for storytelling, allowing us to present a deeper understanding of what's going on in(and above!) the world of Dysterra. This includes the introduction of new figures.

For the time being, the above content will continue to be added to the current map of Ararat Island. At some point, a new map will be added and new content will be provided.

[b][h3]🧪 Game-Changing Weapons and Supplemental Items[/h3][/b]
Weapons and auxiliary items will be expanded from the existing set to add various forms and abilities to the game. We will also be adding weapons and items that will fundamentally change PvP combat. (More on that in a later dev note.)

[b][h3]🧪 Base Functions & Use[/h3][/b]
Player bases function as a place for producing items and protecting one’s valuables. We will also be providing ways to decorate and personalize your base while also making it a place to mingle with friends. New items will be provided in the lobby’s Terra Shop that will allow survivors to construct unique and aesthetic bases.

[b][h3]🧪 Clans & Vehicles[/h3][/b]
The clan function is a long-term connection between survivors and we consider it very important to the game. We will provide the ability to connect with fellow clan members in real time across multiple servers.

Finally, regarding vehicles, we’re looking into designing new vehicles with attack capabilities in addition to our current 4-wheeled vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/88a2a5b7989548327a452d30c6e049a86b7c7fe5.png[/img]


Of course, this won’t be everything.
Through the help and feedback of our survivors, Dysterra will continue to evolve and transform into the best survival game available on the market.
Thanks for all of the love you’ve shown our game so far. We look forward to seeing you on Ararat Island!


Thank you.
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] New Type of Cyclops, Sliding doors, and more!
notes.content:
Happy holidays from Orbis!

For all of you survivors cooped inside while it’s snowing outside, I’ve got another great update for you. This time around, we’ve got new cyclops wandering around the main part of the map, a completed set of hazmat equipment, improvements to turrets, new sliding doorwalls, and some balance changes that most of you will like.

Before we get into the nitty gritty, I’d like to quickly cover what no-raid servers are.

[h2]📒 No Raid Servers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5396c0bbda0c85dc3be8a2761a349aafcf062707.jpg[/img]
As many of you have probably already noticed, we’ve added a “No Raid” test server to our game’s server list. It’s exactly the same as a PvP server, except that you can’t damage peoples’ bases. Many players have expressed their frustration over losing all of their progress when they return to the game only to learn that their base has been raided, and they’ve lost everything.

We’re testing out the concept, so if you feel that you’re a more casual player, then jump into one of our No Raid test servers and try it out. If more people enjoy them, we plan on expanding them to more regions.

[h2]📒 Field Cyclops[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8112503af555cd7f37cd293106a6bc932c16e58.png[/img]
The space between hyena and orbis bases has been rather void of danger. But we want Ararat Island to feel like a dangerous place… So keep your eyes open for some cyclops wandering around in the Danger Level 3 portion of the map.

[h2]📒 New Hazmat Equipment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/54960207ad1364e32dc17865cb56d6a3684c7571.jpg[/img]
For those of you that really don’t like walking through radiation, we’ve completed the hazmat set for you. You’ll get great protection from the radiation, but that’s it. Be careful and pack some extra medical shots before you go on your next farming trip.


[h2]📒 Turret Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0bd356621ae8e0d6b3a6df13ba00f4f056aa61a5.jpg[/img]
Players haven’t been using turrets as much as we’d like to see. The main complaints were that they were easy to destroy, and had poor aim.

We’ve rebalanced all of our turrets’ damage and HP to hopefully take a step towards making turrets a more pivotal part of base defense. Be sure to test out your neighbor’s turrets after we update the servers!

[h2]📒 Sliding Doors/walls[/h2]

[previewyoutube=D0GP39Y5FLg;full][/previewyoutube]
So far there’s only been two kinds of doors for your base: a normal door, and a garage door. In this patch, we’re adding a sliding door to the game. You can craft it, and place it like you would any wall. They’re a structural support, so you can build floors/ceilings on top of them.

[h2]⚖️ Game Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]🔧 Furnaces[/h3]
A few players have been using furnace farms to game the rankings system. We also want players to spend their time in-game exploring the world, and interacting with NPCs… not waiting in their base for their furnaces to refine materials.

To balance gameplay, we’ve increased the energy upkeep cost of furnaces to reduce the existence of furnace farms. Please remember that you can adjust your furnace’s processing speed to reduce the amount of energy it consumes.

[h3]🔧 Grenades and Landmines[/h3]
These were originally intended to be used against NPCs and players, and not for infiltrating bases. We’ve made grenades give varying damage depending on the enemy’s proximity to the explosion. We’ve also increased the max damage for grenades, while also making it so that all landmines give 0 (zero) damage to buildings.

[h3]🔧 Energy DMR & DMR SW-1[/h3]
We’ve noticed that few people are using the energy DMR or the DMR SW-1, so we’ve increased their DPS. At the same time, we increased the size of the energy DMR’s magazine to include more shots between reloads.

[h3]🔧 Assault Rifle DVG14 & Energy Assault Rifle EC MK-III[/h3]
We’ve also noticed that the Tier 4(purple) assault rifles only had a minor advantage over Tier 3(blue) guns, so we’ve improved their DPS as well as increased their magazine size.


That’s it for this week’s patch. Have a good one!
- Director K

notes.title: [Patch Note] Holiday Chests, Radiation Balancing, and more
notes.content:
Holiday greetings from Orbis!

We’ve got some more Christmas themed skins for you this week, as well as quite a few quality of life improvements. Keep on reading to learn more about how to use the Christmas chest skins, sorting options for the chest viewer, balancing changes to radiation (you’ll like these!), and bigger stack sizes to medical shots.

[h2]📒 More Christmas Cheer[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7d4a3c744ab51e50e3c02a21e2d613e62a9c9dc0.png[/img]
In addition to Christmas trees and holiday snacks, you now have the option to store your hard earned items in a holiday-themed chest. You can apply the christmas skin when crafting your chests, or you can right-click a chest when it’s in your inventory and use the “equip skins” option.

[h2]📒 Nearby Chest Viewer - Sorting[/h2]
Our nearby chest viewer has really helped alleviate the stress of rummaging through chest after chest to find(or not find!) what you’re looking for. We’re updating the viewer to allow users to sort their chests in alphabetical order(and reverse alphabetical order), as well as in order of chest tier (ascending or descending).

Don’t forget that you can click and drag items between chests!

[h2]📒 Radiation Balancing[/h2]
Constantly having to use anti-radiation shots breaks up the flow of the game, so we’re hoping this patch will make areas with radiation a bit more enjoyable.

We’ve lowered the amount of radiation exposure in many areas to reflect their difficulty. (For those that weren’t aware, different areas have different strengths of radiation.)

At the same time, we’ve added “radiation resistance.”
Before, your radiation level would go to zero after using an anti-radiation shot, and then immediately start going up again. Now, radiation resistance is basically a negative radiation value that allows you to not take any radiation damage for a short while.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7f4fda4801faaae11269d5215c356421522390a4.jpg[/img]
If your radiation level is 25, and you use a level 1 anti-radiation shot(-100), you’ll have a “radiation resistance” value of 75.
Once it reaches zero, you’ll start taking damage again, so be careful.

[h2]📒 Larger Stack Sizes for Medical Shots[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b6a44d62c67b4164a8a83d71ad2ce4e75566015a.jpg[/img]
Level 3 medical shots are so powerful that we originally thought it best to keep their max stack size low. But that ended up just making players use lower level medical shots that allowed larger stack sizes.

We’ve doubled the stack sizes for level 2 medical shots(from 10 to 20), and more than tripled the stacks for level 3 shots(from 3 to 10).

[h2]📒 A change to building rules[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c1e2a53983256a56a35847ce5a6cf377b404b369.png[/img]
From this patch, anything you build that is not inside your building core’s range will be accessible by anyone after 10 minutes. So remember to place a building core nearby if you don’t want other players demolishing whatever it is you’re making.


For all of you who’ve been asking for a roadmap, I’ll be posting it soon.

See you on the servers!
- Director K

notes.title: [Dev Note] Our Christmas Update!
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

I’m happy to announce Dysterra’s first seasonal update! We’re aiming for a release sometime mid-next week. Let us know what you think in the Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ef185485f8b216009ec45454e3bef7e2611d6388.jpg[/img]

[h2]Craft useful wintertime snacks![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c31fd28234f4cb9327859f82c0320a01b9a60ac4.jpg[/img]

The menu for this holiday season is:
[b]Holiday Cookies
Christmas Turkey
Holiday Pudding[/b]

You can craft them with Holiday Fiber Meal Kits and Holiday Protein Meal Kits that you can now find around the map. I don’t want to spoil the fun, so you can have fun finding where they are.

One of the above foods will fill you up more than any other food in the game, another will alleviate fracture, bleeding, and radiation status effects all at the same time, and one of the above foods will reduce your system overload cooling time after a hacking failure.

We hope you enjoy our first seasonal update, and we’re looking forward to making bigger additions to the game in the future.

notes.title: [Patch Note] Hardcore Mode, A.I. Improvements, and more
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

I hope you all have been enjoying the changes we made in our last patch! Many of the major bugs have been ironed out over the past two weeks, and now we’re focused on optimizing gameplay systems and improving overall player experience. We’re still watching the channels in our Discord Server, so you’re welcome to leave feedback whenever you feel like sharing.

This week we have updates to enemy AI, facility skills, ranking points, balancing, and we’re finally opening the hardcore servers you’ve all been asking for.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1527890/view/3622613286456288369]🔗Link to Dec 7th Update Details🔗[/url][/b]

[h2]AI Improvements for NPCs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2ea95c4ac7a0249dbd56c4c7b860230a2d84f74a.jpg[/img]
We’re working hard on the AI in Dysterra, and we’ll be making incremental updates as we go. This week we made the AI more realistic by updating how mobs detect their surroundings. They’re more sensitive to nearby sounds, so they’re now more likely to hear someone walking nearby, or react to gunshots from a greater distance.

They’re also a lot more persistent. So now they shouldn't randomly turn around and return to their original spot. They’ll keep running after you as long as they can see you.

We’re hoping these changes will increase the overall tension in the game.

[h2]Facility Skills : World Span Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/abf84f7f501d9fe523d2a5f32ae1a848f42b3247.png[/img]
Unlike other games that wipe their servers every x days, Dysterra let’s survivors control when (or if) a wipe happens. By using the controllers you get when conquering a facility, you’ll be able to lengthen or shorten the lifespan of your server. 

We looked at the difficulty of each facility, and adjusted the values according to how many people conquered each facility, and how much each controller was used to increase or decrease the number of days left till wipe. You can press ‘K’ during gameplay to access the facility menu and learn more.

[b]Please note[/b]: each server has a maximum lifespan, and the server life cannot be increased past that value.

We are also aware that survivors are interested in a variety of server lifespans, and we’re planning to comment on that at a later date.

[h2]Ranking point changes when escaping the world[/h2]
[previewyoutube=LRnvzuE7LCA;full][/previewyoutube]
When a server is ready to wipe (see facility skills section above), players can get on a rocket to escape and earn extra points to improve their global ranking.

Originally you would only receive a set amount of points for getting on the rocket, but now you’ll get a different amount depending on how long you survived in the world. The longer you survived, the more points you’ll get!

[h2]New Hardcore Servers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0585a0bdf97bf8c7409632d7df24d22acadf9600.jpg[/img]
The hardcore servers you’ve all been waiting for are finally coming!! PvP in Dysterra has never been this thrilling! Be prepared to drop EVERYTHING when you die.

Hardcore servers aren’t for the faint of heart: 
- No safety slots! You drop all of your items when you die.
- You start with only the bare essential items.

Everything else is exactly the same.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
On a side note, we added the “fracture” status effect to a number of enemies. “Fracture” reduces your speed temporarily.

We also increased the attack power for a number of enemies. I think it’ll be more fun if I don’t tell you which ones.

I look forward to seeing you all on the servers!
- Director K
