notes.title: 📢 Notification of Maintenance at Dec 7th 02:30 - 05:30(PST) & Update Details
notes.content:
[h2]📢Maintenance Guide📢[/h2]
We will be proceeding with server maintenance soon. Maintenance will last for 3 hours.
The duration of the maintenance may be shortened or extended.
[h3]PST: Dec 7th 06:00 - 09:00
CET: Dec 7th 15:00 - 18:00
KST: Dec 7th 23:00 - 02:00[/h3]

Please make sure to move your character to a safer place before the maintenance.
Your character will fall asleep at that specific location when the maintenance starts.

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1527890/view/3622613286456339581]📍Link to Update related Dev Note📍[/url][/h3]

[h2]🚧Update Details🚧[/h2]

[h3]🔧Convenience function🔧[/h3]
1) Added ‘comfort’ state near Buildingcore
- ‘comfort’ state : alleviates the decrease in hunger and restores HP
2) Added a sort function when accessing nearby Storage Boxes from the Workbench (sort by name, tier)
 
[h3]🔧 Balance🔧[/h3]
1) Improved NPC AI
- Improved NPCs to continuously track characters in their sight even if they leave their zone
- NPCs now detects farther gunshot sounds than before and looks at the direction of gun fire
- NPCs now looks at the direction of gun fire when they detect gunshot sounds even if they are moving in alert state
- The nearby NPC detection value changes depending on the NPC status (default, alert, attack)
2) Reduced the audible distance of the Turret operation sound
3) Increased the amount of Stones collected from all resources where Stones can be obtained (▲10%)
4) Increased NPC attack damage at Chemochamber, Geolab, Satellite Station, Orbis Base (15  > 25)
5) Added Fracture value to melee attack of Hyena/Orbis Scout and Gunshielder (50)
6) Decreased radiation exposure at Orbis Base (6 > 4 per second) and increased attack damage of Hyena/Orbis Scout and Gunshielder
7) Changed the threat propagation effect and rotation speed according to the NPC status
- Attack status : 20m (Hyena Convoy Scout/Gunshielder 30m)
- High level alert status : 10m
- Alert status: 5m
- Rotation speed: 170 > 220
8) Adjusted stats of Hazmat Shirt
- Radiation Resistance: 20% > 50%
- Durability: 400 > 200
- Physical Resistance:  5% > 0%
- Energy Resistance: 5% > 0%
- Explosive Resistance: 5% > 0%
9) Changed Bleeding damage method
- Before : Bleeding starts at stack 15
- Changed: Bleeding starts from stack 1 and slightly increased damage
* 0 ~ 50 : 5 damage per 15 seconds
* 50 ~ 100 : 5 damages per 10 seconds
* 100 ~ : 5 damages per 5 seconds
10) Added recipe on Recycler
- Superior Sensor : Fine Sensor x 2, Fine Chip x 1
- Superior Lens : Fine Lens x 2, Fine Metal x 1
- Fine Lens : Lens x 3, Fine Metal x 2
- Resistor : Metal x 2
- Cluster Land Mine : Fine Metal x 1, Fine Sensor x 1, Fine Chip x 1
- Land Mine : Fine Metal x 1
11) Increased HP of Integrated Utility Controller (150 > 1,000)
12) Fixed energy consumption of Triangle Electric Floor and Electric Fence
- Triangle Electric Floor: 10 > 5 per minute
- Electric Fence: 10 > 15 per minute
 
[h3]🔧Facility🔧[/h3]
1) Fixed increase/decrease of the Terrafire occurrence date when using the Phase Controller
[Chemochamber]
- Air Purification : 12 days > 5 days
- Dust Storm : - 3 days > - 5 days
[Satellite Station]
- Energy Amplification : +16 days > +7 days
- EMP Shockwave : -6 days > -7 days
[Meteo Center]
- Thermal Equilibration : +15 days > +8 days
- Thermal Cooling : -5 days > -8 days
[Geolab]
- Ground Stabilization : +14 days > +10 days
- Seismic Waves : -4 days > -10 days
[Delta Plant]
- Terrasite Decreaser : +17 days > +15 days
- Terrasite Increaser : -7 days > -15 days
 
[h3]🔧Ranking🔧[/h3]
1) Scores are calculated based on survival time when escape is successful after boarding an escape rocket
2) Added and modified the ranking points related to gathering and Secure Crates
 
[h3]🔧Fixed Bugs🔧[/h3]
1) Fixed an issue where the Superior Terrasite Deposit in some areas were respawning abnormally
2) Fixed an issue where the number of overlaps in the character death record was displayed abnormally
3) Modified so that when the vehicle enters water, the engine turns off and HP decreases
4) Fixed an issue where the energy consumption per minute (100) was lower than the actual (40) per minute when converting Fine Terrasite in Forges

We'll come back with a more stabilized and better gameplay environment after the maintenance.

Thank you, survivors!

　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬As of right now, you will experience less hunger, and be able to heal yourself near the core.

🔧 Improved NPC AI
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬In our upcoming update, we will be updating NPCs so that they will now track down survivors even when they are outside of their initial existing location. Also, they will now be more alert to the sound of gunshots, and are now able to hear gunshots from far away.

🔧 Operating sound of turrets will be reduced.

🔧 The amount of looted stone will be increased in general.

🔧 Fixed the problem of building parts connected to repeater and base becoming irretrievable.

🔧 Lowered radiation exposure in Orbis area and increased radioactive resistance of Hazmat shirts.
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Reflecting on user feedback, we have decided to balance radiation exposure and resistance.

🔧 Modified balance of the variation that Phase controller has on Terrafire eruption date.
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Reflecting on user feedback, we have decided to modify the balance of the variation that Phascontroller has on the eruption date. After the update, accelerating and postponing eruption will have similar rate.

🔧 Fixed problems with vehicles moving in water.

🔧 Problem of character creation notation error in lobby server list.

🔧 Fixed problem of items changing order when accessing nearby storage from the workbench, and added sorting function.

🔧 Regeneration time problem of some Superior Terrasite Deposit

🔧 Scheduled modification to prevent vehicles from entering the Facilities

🔧 Planning to improve Gamepad support

　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Currently, major buildings (major bases and facilities) are restricted from being built to
　　prevent monopolization and abuse by some users. However, since we are aware of the
　　inconvenience caused to survivors, we are considering reducing the restricted area,
　　and will reflect some in the next update.

🔧 Fixed an issue where some words could not be used as nicknames or on chats

[h3][b]🔍 Content being fixed or being prepared 🔍[/b][/h3]
🧪 Improving loading speed.
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are continuously working on optimization and related issues to reduce the time necessary to load servers and run game. 

🧪 Difficulty level problem for field boss juggernaut
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are working on the problem that it was too easy to target by advantaging some terrain,
　　and Juggernaut will be back to survivors with an improvement.

🧪 Considering providing a skill reset method
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We sympathize with the need for skill reset, and we are thinking about how we would
　　apply it on Dysterra. For example, we are reviewing a way to reset skills by acquiring items
　　through crafting or Facility raids.

🧪 Hardcore PVP server in preparation
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are preparing a Hardcore PVP server for experts who want to fight tough without
　　the help of secure slots and armor protection. It will be reflected in some regions and
　　operated in the form of a test.

🧪 Scheduled to strengthen Strider and Strider EX's hacking security function
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We deeply sympathize with the survivors' opinions about the lack of security capabilities of
　　crafted vehicles(Strider, Strider EX), and we plan to upgrade more powerful security features
　　compared to the general world spawn vehicle (Dynamo).

🧪 Scheduled to modify the UI of storage box use around the character to be more intuitive

🧪 Fixed an issue where the character could not aim below fully

🧪 Fixed an issue where the hotkey worked when using the search function on a workbench, etc.

🧪 Issues with installations being installed improperly
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are considering improvements for issues such as not being able to place items
　　like a workbench very close to the walls or automatically aligning depending on the direction
　　the character is standing.

🧪 Changing existing settings for Single Player mode
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are considering a modification function for survivors who must have been frustrated
　　because it was impossible to change the settings in the middle of Single Player mode.
　　You can change the Single Player mode settings by modifying the contents of the file located
　　in the folder below.
　　- Folder location: >\Dysterra\Dysterra\WorldSettings\SinglePlay.json

🧪 Planned improvements to the long crafting time of forges
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬The existing balance was set to encourage the forges to operate automatically while
　　the player explores the world and loots major bases and facilities,

notes.title: [Dev Note] First balance patch (Energy consumption, Radiation and more)
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

We’ve been listening.

I’d like to say thank you to all of the amazing survivors that have taken time out of their days to give feedback and help us improve Dysterra. We sincerely appreciate your efforts and are doing our best to fix any issues as quickly as we can.

We’ve also been implementing anti-cheat solutions on an almost daily basis to prevent hackers from ruining everyone’s fun.

Here’s what we’re adding/changing/removing in this patch:

[h2]1. Energy Consumption[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/97ed9e03431f0f208d8024d88b9319c786a11296.png[/img]
Improvements to energy consumption in bases.
- Increased maximum power reserves of all levels of building core.
- Increased the amount of energy received when converting terrasite in the building core.

[h2]2. Offline Base Protection[/h2]
- Increased the maximum purchasable amount for base defense items in terrasite transmitter stores.
- Adjusted prices for base defense items in terrasite transmitter stores.

[h2]3. Radiation[/h2]
Improvements to radiation management.
- Reduced the cost of anti-radiation level 2 shots.
- Increased how much anti-radiation level 2 shots reduce radiation levels
- Increased radiation resistance of the hazmat shirt armor.
- We are planning more radiation related buffs in the near future. 

[h2]4. Respawning[/h2]
- Drastically reduced respawn cooldown time for all types of beds.

[h2]5. Fine Terrasite Farming[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2d63baebfdabf7ccf8008f05ae29483f3fd06cd6.jpg[/img]
- Improved the probability of collecting fine terrasite when mining from fine terrasite nodes and 
superior terrasite nodes.

[h2]6. Garage Doors[/h2]
A large number of survivors commented about how their vehicles were being stolen.
- We added a cheaper, more accessible garage door for bases.
- The existing garage door is now the level 2 upgrade of the new cheaper garage door.

[h2]7. Hacking Probabilities[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4f8cb20f94c88430bb191750427ae3aa08028002.png[/img]
- Due to a multitude of complaints of vehicle theft on the island, we’ve severely lowered the success rate of vehicle hacking.
- We’ve also raised the success probability for some secure crates (hackable crates).

[h2]8. Recipe Error[/h2]
Fixed the “fine fiber boots” recipe.
- The recipe for crafting fine fiber boots was different when crafting with a workbench vs. without a workbench. We’ve lowered the cost of the workbench recipe so that both recipes are the same.

[h2]9. Daily Missions[/h2]
- We removed missions related to building due to their impracticality.

[h2]10. Building[/h2]
- We made the process of installing/placing Floors(ceilings) a bit more easy and intuitive.

[h2]A note to survivors regarding non-repairable items:[/h2]
Some survivors have asked about why some items are not repairable. These items in the game can be obtained quickly through spot events. To discourage abuse of these drops, these items are non-repairable. Please keep this in mind while playing the game.


We’re sure you’ll like these changes. But feel free to let us know your opinions on the Discord servers!

Stay alive out there,
- Director K

- All Hyena NPCs, Orbis Scout Robot, All Cyclops NPCs, Stomper Guard

[h3]🔧 Housing related information🔧 [/h3]
1. Changed the maximum amount of power in Buildingcore (Increased by 4 times)
2. Changed the energy conversion rate of resources

- Terrasite 150 → 500
- Fine Terrasite 1500 → 5,000
- Superior Terrasite 15000 → 50,000
- Fiber 45 > 100
- Stone 45 > 100

- Sticky Lamp, Repeater, Turret- L Lv.1, Turret- E Lv.1, Turret- S Lv.1, Electric Floor Lv.1, Bounding Mine, Storage Box (Medium), Bed, Grill, Repair Bench Lv.1

- Garage Door Lv.1 Recipe: Metal x 30, Terrasite x 30, Resistor x 5"
  ㄴ Durability : 7,000
- Garage Door Lv.2 Recipe: Fine Metal x 10, Fine Resistor x 3, Fine Terrasite x 5
  ㄴ Durability 13,000
5. Adjusted cooldown on Beds and Sleeping Bags
- Sleeping Bag 600s → 300s
- Bed LV1 300s → 120s
- Bed LV2 150s → 60s
6. Adjusted durability of housing installations
- Terrasite Transmitter HP: 500 → 3,000
- Electric Floor LV1: 100 → 1000
- Triangle Electric Floor Lv.1: 100 → 1,000
- Electric Floor Lv.2: 100 → 2,000
- Triangle Electric Floor Lv.2: 100 → 2,000
- Storage (Small): 600 → 1,000
- Storage (Medium): 1000 → 2,000
- Storage (Large): 1000 → 3,000
7. Removed inefficient daily missions related to construction

[h3]🔧 Changed Crafting Material🔧 [/h3]
1. Fixed Workbench material errors for Fine Fiber Boots
- Fiber x 30, Terrasite x 30 → Fiber x 10, Terrasite x 10
2. Changed material of Fine Sensor (Fine Metal x 2 → Lens x 2, Sensor x 1)
3. Increased Blast Mine materials and changed tier
- Tier: 2T → 3T
- Recipe: Fine Metal x 2, Sensor x 2, Fine Chip x1 → Fine Metal x 10, Fine Sensor x 10, Fine Chip x 10

1. Fixed an issue with the Orbis Metal Separator spawning in Hyena Base
2. Fixed an issue that the mission is not completed when boarding the vehicle
3. Modified to expose only Ranking survival time

We'll come back with a more stabilized and better gameplay environment after the maintenance. 

Thank you, survivors!

　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We plan to allow Single-player mode and Custom servers to be available for those who
　　wish them to be open during maintenance. However, please understand that the service
　　may be unavailable if the maintenance content includes Single-player mode and
　　Custom server related content.

🔧 Fixed an issue where NPCs did not respond when attacking nearby NPCs

🔧 Scheduled modification to prevent vehicles from entering the Facilities

🔧 Fixed an issue where the result is not reflected when the daily mission is progressed in advance
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We plan to reduce the inconvenience of recreating installations that have already been
　　installed for daily missions.

🔧  Planning to improve the Buildingcore resource-to-energy conversion rate
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We plan to adjust the energy conversion rate for resources to make it easier to maintain
　　the Buildingcore energy.

🔧 Improved Floor installation method when constructing housing
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬There were some users who had difficulty installing the Floors, so we plan to make
　　housing installation more convenient.

🔧 Planning to improve Gamepad support

🔧 Expansion of the area available for housing construction is in progress
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Currently, major buildings (major bases and facilities) are restricted from being built to
　　prevent monopolization and abuse by some users. However, since we are aware of the
　　inconvenience caused to survivors, we are considering reducing the restricted area,
　　and will reflect some in the next update.

🔧 Adjusting the cooldown time of beds and sleeping bags
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Since the cooldown time of beds and sleeping bags are directly related to the balance of
　　combat and attacking major facilities, a rather conservative balance was applied.
　　We plan to adjust the reuse time through the opinions of survivors and game data analysis
　　during the early access, and these balance adjustments will continue.

🔧 Fixed an issue where some words could not be used as nicknames or on chats

🔧 Scheduled to be improved so that daily missions can be performed while riding in a vehicle

🔧 Hunger reduction mitigation system to be introduced in residences(housing)
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬In situations where survivors are away due to various reasons, we are making improvements
　　so that hunger status effects lessen in player bases with a building core installed and powered.
　　We think seeing the death screen after a long phone call with a close friend should occur
　　less often this way!

[h3][b]🔍 Content being fixed or being prepared 🔍[/b][/h3]
🧪 Considering providing a skill reset method
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We sympathize with the need for skill reset, and we are thinking about how we would
　　apply it on Dysterra. For example, we are reviewing a way to reset skills by acquiring items
　　through crafting or Facility raids.

🧪 Fixing an issue where building parts connected to Repeater or housing are not properly demolished

🧪 Hardcore PVP server in preparation
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are preparing a Hardcore PVP server for experts who want to fight tough without
　　the help of secure slots and armor protection. It will be reflected in some regions and
　　operated in the form of a test.

🧪 Fixing an issue where survival time information is displayed abnormally in ranking information(leaderboard).

🧪 Scheduled to strengthen Strider and Strider EX's hacking security function
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We deeply sympathize with the survivors' opinions about the lack of security capabilities of
　　crafted vehicles(Strider, Strider EX), and we plan to upgrade more powerful security features
　　compared to the general world spawn vehicle (Dynamo).

🧪 Scheduled to modify the UI of storage box use around the character to be more intuitive

🧪 Fixed an issue where the character could not aim below fully

🧪 Shots(Syringe) and armor balance improvements related to the radiation area
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are adjusting the performance of shots(syringes) and armors in consideration of
　　the difficulty of the Orbis base and facilities.

🧪 Fixed an issue where the hotkey worked when using the search function on a workbench, etc.

🧪 Issues with installations being installed improperly
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are considering improvements for issues such as not being able to place items
　　like a workbench very close to the walls or automatically aligning depending on the direction
　　the character is standing.

🧪 Changing existing settings for Single Player mode
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are considering a modification function for survivors who must have been frustrated
　　because it was impossible to change the settings in the middle of Single Player mode.
　　You can change the Single Player mode settings by modifying the contents of the file located
　　in the folder below.
　　- Folder location: >\Dysterra\Dysterra\WorldSettings\SinglePlay.json

🧪 Planned improvements to the long crafting time of forges
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬The existing balance was set to encourage the forges to operate automatically while
　　the player explores the world and loots major bases and facilities,
　　but we are considering introducing the ‘Forge Upgrade System’ as quickly as possible
　　to incorporate opinions from players.
　　We will be back soon with better and hopefully more intuitive forges.

[u]Known issue notifications are to disclose the thoughts of the Dev team regarding errors that occur while installing or playing the game, in-game bugs, or status(progress).

[h3][b]🚧 Issues to be fixed in the next update 🚧[/b][/h3] 
[quote]❗ [u] The time of application of these fixes may be delayed due to the priority of the update preparation process, but they will all be applied as soon as possible.[/u][/quote]
🔧  Planning to improve the Buildingcore resource-to-energy conversion rate
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We plan to adjust the energy conversion rate for resources to make it easier to maintain
　　the Buildingcore energy.

🔧 Improved Floor installation method when constructing housing
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬There were some users who had difficulty installing the Floors, so we plan to make
　　housing installation more convenient.

🔧 Planning to improve Gamepad support

🔧 Expansion of the area available for housing construction is in progress
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Currently, major buildings (major bases and facilities) are restricted from being built to
　　prevent monopolization and abuse by some users. However, since we are aware of the
　　inconvenience caused to survivors, we are considering reducing the restricted area,
　　and will reflect some in the next update.

🔧 Adjusting the cooldown time of beds and sleeping bags
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬Since the cooldown time of beds and sleeping bags are directly related to the balance of
　　combat and attacking major facilities, a rather conservative balance was applied.
　　We plan to adjust the reuse time through the opinions of survivors and game data analysis
　　during the early access, and these balance adjustments will continue.

🔧 Fixed an issue where some words could not be used as nicknames or on chats

🔧 Scheduled to be improved so that daily missions can be performed while riding in a vehicle

🔧 Hunger reduction mitigation system to be introduced in residences(housing)
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬In situations where survivors are away due to various reasons, we are making improvements
　　so that hunger status effects lessen in player bases with a building core installed and powered.
　　We think seeing the death screen after a long phone call with a close friend should occur
　　less often this way!

[h3][b]🔍 Content being fixed or being prepared 🔍[/b][/h3]
🧪 Scheduled to strengthen Strider and Strider EX's hacking security function
　　[b]🎤Dev Comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We deeply sympathize with the survivors' opinions about the lack of security capabilities of
　　crafted vehicles(Strider, Strider EX), and we plan to upgrade more powerful security features
　　compared to the general world spawn vehicle (Dynamo).

🧪 The issue where the result is not reflected when the daily mission is progressed in advance
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We plan to reduce the inconvenience of recreating installations that have already been
　　installed for daily missions.

🧪 Scheduled to modify the UI of storage box use around the character to be more intuitive

🧪 Fixed an issue where the character could not aim below fully

🧪 Shots(Syringe) and armor balance improvements related to the radiation area
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are adjusting the performance of shots(syringes) and armors in consideration of
　　the difficulty of the Orbis base and facilities.

🧪 Fixed an issue where the hotkey worked when using the search function on a workbench, etc.

🧪 Issues with installations being installed improperly
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are considering improvements for issues such as not being able to place items
　　like a workbench very close to the walls or automatically aligning depending on the direction
　　the character is standing.

🧪 Changing existing settings for Single Player mode
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬We are considering a modification function for survivors who must have been frustrated
　　because it was impossible to change the settings in the middle of Single Player mode.
　　You can change the Single Player mode settings by modifying the contents of the file located
　　in the folder below.
　　- Folder location: >\Dysterra\Dysterra\WorldSettings\SinglePlay.json

🧪 Planned improvements to the long crafting time of forges
　　[b]🎤Dev comments🎤[/b]
　　💬The existing balance was set to encourage the forges to operate automatically while
　　the player explores the world and loots major bases and facilities,

　　We will be back soon with better and hopefully more intuitive forges.

notes.title: [Dev Note] Only One Day Left!
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

I can’t believe it!!! It’s finally here!!!!!!
In only a few hours, Dysterra will be released into Early Access.

Thank you all for your support and help during the long development process. We would have never come this far without you.

It’s taken years of hard work to get here, and we hope you love what we’ve made so far. Of course this is Early Access, so we’ll be adding new elements and improvements to the game on a regular basis.

This week we’ve added steam achievements, some more story elements, a new single-player ending, and more details and functionality to journal entries. We’ve also made damage types (energy/physical) a more integral part of the game.

[h2]📒 In-Game Achievements[/h2]
We’ve linked steam achievements to your in-game profile so now you can show off your highest-tier achievements to your friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/81369357e72d43893303a1271078871dc0817049.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 Damage Types[/h2]
Up until now, the choice between using physical ammo or energy ammo was simply a matter of preference, but now it’s an important part of gameplay progression.

We’ve implemented damage types to enemies, so you’ll need to consider which gun to take with you on your next outing. If you’re going up against some biological enemies like Hyena troops or just going out to hunt for meat, then physical ammo is what you want. But if you’re going to be taking down dozens of Orbis robots, you’ll want to bring along an energy-type weapon.
[previewyoutube=6CaxYH80acA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]📒 Story & LORE![/h2]
Now that we have the gameplay figured out. We’re working hard on adding depth to Dysterra’s in preparation for our official release down the road. 

Over your next few playthroughs, you’ll notice a few new details being spoken by Vanessa and NPCs during specific events throughout the world, so keep your ears peeled over the coming weeks and months as we develop and implement little details to add depth to the world of Dysterra.

[h2]📒 3 Separate Endings! (in Single-Player mode)[/h2]
There are now three separate endings in single player mode. I don’t want to spoil the fun of finding them.

But for all of you out there that love a good hint, here’s a picture:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8cdb2970d71560d274104a5cb332466626cb7289.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 More Detailed Journal Entries[/h2]

The journal is an essential element to any survival game, and we wanted to make our journal a place where you can find the information you need, when you need it. We’ve changed the UI quite a bit, so now you get more information at a glance.

You can even click a button in the journal entry to immediately move to the crafting screen where you can start making the item you were looking at.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5dbda154359419e50f0c86805b6312642fbc074f.jpg[/img]

You can even turn the tutorial (mission guide) on and off by checking/unchecking the box on the top left of the journal screen.

notes.title: [Dev Note] New Skill tree menu, (Skin) Random box, Inventory management and more
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

Early access is almost here!!!! I hope you’re all as excited as I am! It’s been a long road from when we first set pen to paper to start drawing concept art and character designs for Dysterra. I’m so happy to see all of you amazing(and magnificent!) people waiting on the edges of your seats for our launch into Early Access. Thank you for encouraging our team and helping us make Dysterra into what has become.

We’ve got a new set of upgrades for the skill tree, a random box(of skins!) you can earn, an inventory management system, and a new attack for the cyclops.

[h2]📒 Skill Tree Upgrade[/h2]
We’ve added a third tab to the skill menu: COMBAT

The new combat skill tree consists of two main tiers: “fast reload” and “specialization.” And each tier has a skill for improving only a specific gun-type: short-range guns, mid-range guns, long-range guns, and rocket launchers. I think “fast reload” is pretty self explanatory. “Specialization” reduces durability lost when firing a gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e59bd2dcba0b33e6013dd4d1b35eb16581d1d840.jpg[/img]

We’re hoping this will give players more choices on how they can choose to play the game. Beginners might spread their skill points between different gun types, while Dysterra veterans might prefer to throw all of their skill points into a single gun type.

The choice is yours!

[h2]📒 Random Box[/h2]
Some of you may remember that we added the “Terra Shop” to our game’s lobby. One of the things we’ve added to the shop is a random box. Each time you open a random box, you’ll unlock 3 new skins that you can use when crafting in-game. Note: You won’t receive any items when you open a random box, but you’ll be able to craft new items with the skins you unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8bf4c3b58d5a2dd1a910fb40660945eec381cba.png[/img]

So how can you purchase these new skins? With Terra Points! We want to reward survivors who play frequently as well as ranked survivors, so there are two ways to get Terra Points (TP):
1. Log in daily.
2. Weekly TP rewards according to your global ranking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5ae155eb645f8d4a3135903e6498c31e481f8bf2.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 Easier Crafting With Remote Chest Access[/h2]
We realized a lot of players were struggling with inventory management. Running back and forth between your crafting bench and your storage chests can get tiring. And we wanted to make it at least a little easier.

We’ve modified the inventory UI so you can see what’s in nearby chests and drag and drop items from one chest directly into another. You can even open up a chest and craft directly from inside it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5385cbe81f32849d122784446a2a202eeb3df52b.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 Cyclops Now Shoot Lasers![/h2]

The cyclops is definitely the most dangerous Orbis robot out in the wild. It initially had a slicing attack for close range, as well as a jumping attack for mid-range… Now we’ve added a laser attack to the cyclops to keep players on their toes no matter where they are.

Good luck staying alive out there!

[previewyoutube=oangWBb8txQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There’ll be one more update before our launch next week, but our partner-streamers are already playing the game. So jump on over to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Dysterra]twitch[/url] to get your Dysterra fix!

notes.title: [Dev Note] New Hyena Designs, a New Item, and More
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

Brrrr! It’s been getting cold out lately. We’re all sweating at the brow here in the Reality MagiQ offices trying to polish everything in our game before we launch into early access later this month.

There’s a lot more to unpack this week. We’ve visually redesigned all of the hyena soldiers, toughened up high end vehicles, added detection drones to the game, and updated the facility skill UI.

[h2]📒 New Hyena Troop Design[/h2]
The Hyena soldiers didn’t feel quite human enough, so we decided to take the visors off their helmets and let them breathe some fresh air while they’re waiting to put a hole in your head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4431fba5be05d200a01dde0bb81112012e10893d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/69ca5fff67b1e9f7501709dd46d2db7028fe5a22.jpg[/img]

While we were at it, we also tried to more clearly differentiate between the 4 different types of Hyena soldiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/325a78892edd0ab3d47c60f53c65affdd7c91f09.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 Stronger High Level Vehicles[/h2]
Have you ever been driving along in the Dysterra wilderness, minding your own business, when BAAMMM!!! You ran over a landmine. And then another one. And @#$%!! ANOTHER ONE!!! This isn’t looking good…

Well worry no longer. The Strider and Strider EX now come with a thicker more mine-resistant undercarriage as well as stronger anti-rocket paneling to keep you from unwittingly dying while you’re out and about. Vehicles are expensive to make, and we want to make sure you get to enjoy your investment.

[previewyoutube=X1PiOnONY1I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]📒 Drones![/h2]
Imagine this: You’re outside a building, ready to loot it, but you want to know how many NPCs are inside. Maybe you’re out of bullets and want to avoid them, or maybe you’re looking to kill them and loot their bodies as quickly as possible.

Well now you can throw a scan drone up in the air, and it’ll tell you where and how far different NPCs are.

But be warned: it won’t tell you the locations of other survivors, so you can’t use it to see if anyone is home before you raid a base.

[previewyoutube=teXtZftYBuc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]📒 Improved Facility Skill UI[/h2]
We’ve also been working on fine-tuning our game’s interface so it’s more intuitive for survivors that are new to the game. This week’s focus was on the facility skill UI.

The layout should feel a lot cleaner and simpler, and first time users of a facility controller should have a much easier time deciding where and how to use their new toy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/00df8fde28f73c61691105abac10009c0ac8e796.jpg[/img]

That’s it for this week’s dev note.
I’ll be back next week with even more updates!

Orbis thanks you for your service!

notes.title: [Dev Note]Improvements to Vehicles, Enemy AI, Hacking, and Terrafire countdown
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis!

For all of you Dysterra-holics out there, here’s the latest Dysterra news for you to read while sipping on a homemade hot chocolate and watching what’s left of the Autumn leaves change color outside your living room window.

This week we have quite a few vehicle updates, changes to hacking success rates, improved enemy AI, and a modification to the Terrafire countdown.
[h2]🏎️ Flip Your Car Upright🏎️[/h2]

We’ve all rode our Strider off a cliff or over a ridge and somehow flipped it on its back… unable to use it ever again. Some survivors have been creative and were able to get their Strider on all four wheels with the use of a friend and some careful maneuvering.

[previewyoutube=Un73-NkARrc;full][/previewyoutube]
Now you can build and drive your vehicles without worrying about eventually flipping it.
When, not if, you eventually flip your Strider again, long-hold “F” to access the ring menu, and you’ll find an option to flip your car back to how it should be.

[h2]👻 NPC Detection of Stealthed Survivors👻[/h2]
We realized the Stealth protocol was a bit OP at times, so we’ve added the ability for enemies to sense stealthed survivors under certain conditions. NPCs will now be able to sense if a stealthed survivor walks, runs, crouches, or lands nearby and will run towards wherever the sound originated.

Additionally, even if the player is not taking any action, NPCs can sense motionless survivors if they are very close to the NPC.

[previewyoutube=6N33LD0T6Yw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]🌋 Improved Terrafire Countdown🚀[/h2]
If you’ve conquered a facility, then you’ll know that you get a phase controller that can be used to add/subtract days from the Terrafire eruption countdown, while also adding a positive/negative effect to an area of the map.

We saw the number of days go up and up and up and up, and decided that it’d be best to put a cap on it. For now, the cap is set to 365 days of in-game time(1 in-game day = 1 real-time hour, so just over 15 days), but that number may be fine-tuned in the near future.

[h2]💻 Improved Hacking Success Rates💻[/h2]
Not everyone has tried hacking yet, but for those that have, we understand that there were far more failures than successes when trying to open a secure crate. We’ve revamped the hacking calculations to make hacking success rates more intuitive and player-friendly.

Before: Hacking success was calculated purely by each survivor’s own personal success rate.

Now: Each type of security crate has its own hacking success rate, with lower level Tiers being easier, and high level Tiers being more difficult. This success rate can be modified by leveling up hacking skills.

[h2]🏎️ New distinct design for the Strider EX🎨[/h2]
Rather than using color to distinguish the Strider EX from the Strider, we’ve instead chosen to redesign the EX so it has its own visually distinct shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ab86332343547218d0bcc1e7a7651f1875344b7c.jpg[/img]

[h2]🏎️ Store Items in Your Strider🧳[/h2]
Every car should have a trunk (or a boot if you’re from East of the Atlantic).

Now you can store items in your Strider or Strider EX by holding “F” to access the ring menu, and accessing “Vehicle Management.” Currently, the Strider has 10 slots while the EX has 20 slots for you to store your hard earned loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/cc033a9a28af77fb8e18df2419ab63f77a1c827f.jpg[/img]

[h2]🧑🏽‍🤝‍🧑🏾Discord Changes💜[/h2]
We’ve revamped our discord server to prepare for Dysterra’s release into Early Access on November 23th, 2022(PST).

As some of you may have noticed, we’ve updated our discord server with a cleaner, hopefully more intuitive layout. Check out the recent post on our discord to learn more about what we’ve done.

Also!
From here on out, our developers will be joining in on the suggestions, feedback, and bug report channels.
Please don’t hesitate to leave your ideas or questions in the feedback or bug report channels.


I’ll be back next week with even more updates!
Orbis thanks you for your service!

notes.title: [Dev Note] Reinforce Equipment Durability, Mech suit, TerraShop, Skins, New Guns
notes.content:
Greetings from Orbis! Director K here with another developer update for you.

I know you’ve all been waiting in anticipation for another chance to play Dysterra. And our team has enjoyed seeing the creative memes you’ve been posting in the Discord channels.

Over the past month, our developer team at Reality MagiQ has been hard at work making improvements and adding even more features to the game.

[h2]📒 Reinforce your equipment! ⚒️[/h2]
Durability low? Not any more!
Introducing Level 2 repair benches! They come with all of the same features as
the Level 1 repair benches, but with the ability to increase your items’ total durability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/bccbcacd40ca68e4d38f73b1fcd9e8aa9e08cc79.jpg[/img]
We heard players’ complaints about needing to bring several guns on a facility raid,
and now that should be a thing of the past.
For example: Instead of packing two guns with their default durability, you can upgrade one gun
so it will last longer while you’re exploring the map or taking down a facility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1f3cb032d824cfbfbd62db49ef4c7fecf6c6511d.jpg[/img]

[h2]📒 Rideable mech suits! 🦾[/h2]
Our team was thinking… 4-wheeled vehicles are great and all, but what if it was possible
to stomp around in a juggernaut suit and blast enemies with a volley of rockets?

Well now it’s possible. Players will now be able to control Proto-Juggernaut suits while fighting
the Delta Plant bosses. They’re currently only accessible inside the fighting arena, and you can’t
take them through the portal (balancing reasons and all). So be sure to try them out the next time
you drop by the Delta Plant in the Delta region.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ca0fde07c598542c1e7ca4e95afc8be7d332762b.png[/img]

[h2]📒 Skin Systems 🧵[/h2]
We’ve added new skins for you to enjoy. They can be collected by watching Dysterra streams on Twitch, or by completing missions in game. There’ll be a good mix of skins ready,
so be sure to grab them!

[h2]📒 The Terra Shop 🏪[/h2]
For all of you survivors wanting to look sharp while you’re running through the Geolab, or doing donuts around your friend’s base in your new vehicle, we’ve added a Terra Shop to the game’s lobby screen. This is where you can buy all the latest outfits and get new skins for your guns.

You can buy things from the Terra Shop with terrapoints.
But what’s a terrapoint you ask?

Terrapoints can be earned daily by logging in, and they’ll also be paid out weekly to players according to their ranking tier. You can think of it as a wage paid out to the survivors that work the hardest to mine Terrasite for Orbis. Once you’ve earned enough terrapoints, you’ll be able to spend them to get all kinds of weapon or armor skins.

[h2]📒 New Gun Type 🔫[/h2]
And finally, we’ve added two new guns to the game to give you more choice in your style of gameplay:

[h3]DMR SW-1 Venator[/h3]
A rare-tier(blue), light ammo designated marksman rifle(DMR) with better armor penetration than standard DMRs, giving you that extra edge when you’re fighting for your life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/989ae95f9766e92bbc1a6f5e056a65aff35966cb.jpg[/img]
[h3]DMR ASW-82 Stalker[/h3]
An epic-tier(purple), light ammo designated marksman rifle(DMR) that has a smart-ammo ability. Shooting a target marks it, and each successive shot will bend and twist through the air towards
its marker.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8fde3e478b1b11139accae4efc051a2d9b7de2d0.jpg[/img]
The catch?
The marker is reset when you cancel it, or line-of-sight to the opponent is lost.
Opponents using the stealth ability cannot be targeted. Shots taken using the smart-ammo
ability cause less damage than shots taken normally.

I’ll be back next week with even more updates!
Orbis thanks you for your service!

notes.title: [Dev Note] Phase Controller Usability, Orbis NPC Buffs & Advanced Hyena Dropship
notes.content:
Hi Survivors,
This is Director. K.

First of all, we sincerely thank all of your valuable comments after participating in the test.
The various opinions you send are carefully read by all concerned in order to provide better Dysterra.

Today, as a Dev Note for the first time since the 4th Beta Test started, we have prepared information
on improvements on the usability of the Facility Phase Controller, differentiating Orbis NPCs by grade, 
and High-Tier Hyena Dropship.

[h2]📒 Facility Phase Controller Usability Improvements  📡[/h2]
The effect of the Facility Phase Controller previously only affected the houses and survivors,
but in this test, the usability has been improved so that various effects are also applied to NPCs.

Depending on the Facility Phase Controller effect, you can lower the difficulty of capturing NPCs
to favor your allies or increase the difficulty of obstructing the enemy’s hunting.

[h3]1. Chemochamber[/h3]
 1) Air Purification: A ‘Sleep’ effect is applied to living NPCs, stopping their actions.
　The damage of the first hit is doubled when attacking the target who is affected by the ‘Sleep’ effect.
[previewyoutube=DxG6Hc7QY1Y;full][/previewyoutube]
 2) Dust Storm: ‘Enrage’ effect is applied to living NPCs. When the ‘Enrage’ effect is applied,
　attack power, speed, and HP increase, increasing the difficulty.
[previewyoutube=RJUG5ttbGKM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]2. Geolab[/h3]
 1) Seismic Waves: A ‘Impact’ effect is applied to living and mechanical NPCs, reducing movement speed.
[previewyoutube=JiaXM7ZnpOU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]3. Meteo Center[/h3]
1) Thermal Equilibration: A ‘Sleep’ effect is applied to living NPCs, stopping their actions.
　The damage of the first hit is doubled when attacking the target who is affected by the ‘Sleep’ effect.
[previewyoutube=DxG6Hc7QY1Y;full][/previewyoutube]
2) Thermal Shock: ‘Frostbite’ effect is applied to living NPCs, taking damage per second and reducing movement speed.
[previewyoutube=FuXL2pqzpDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]4. Satellite Station[/h3]
 1) EMP Shockwave: ‘Lockdown’ effect is applied to mechanical NPCs.
[previewyoutube=dhI4ctkiY9g;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]※ Living NPC: Animals, Creatures, Hyena / Mechanical NPC: Orbis Robot series[/b]

However, the status effect is not reflected in all NPCs.
Major boss NPCs (Juggernaut, Grima, Giant, Vulkan) and important NPCs (Mutant Guardian, Bombbug, Minion, ASKR Sniper, etc.) are not affected, so be careful.

[h2]📒 Orbis NPC Upgrade 🤖[/h2]
Orbis NPCs, which afflict and cause difficulties for survivors, are now more clearly differentiated by grade. Now you can classify grades more easily and quickly judge how to respond!

[h3]Differentiation of appearance by grade[/h3]
Previously, you could classify Orbis NPCs only by the weapon they wore.
But now, different appearances are reflected depending on the grade.
Therefore, the grades are more clearly differentiated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40849019/e52d91963a13d031584b900283522452a6c77103.jpg[/img]
[h3]Improved combat methods by grade[/h3]
Orbis NPC’s combat method by grade has been improved, and the difficulty of attacking becomes more difficult depending on the grade.

[h2]📒 High-Tier Hyena Dropship Reveal 🛸[/h2]
Do you remember the Hyena Scout event among the High-Tier regional events that were briefly introduced in the last Dev notes?
High-Tier Hyena Dropship appearance is as below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40849019/3e4570ccc5fe417ceeab6b3bf058e758c7f9e38e.jpg[/img]
More powerful Hyena NPCs will be on board than the regular Hyena Dropships, but the rewards will be great because of their difficulty, wouldn’t it?
High risk, high return! Challenge the High-Tier Hyena Dropship.

[h2]📒 New weapon AWS-82 🔫[/h2]
The Energy DMR AWS-82 will be added through an update during the 4th Beta Test.

Hitting an enemy with the AWS-82 will mark the target, and the bullet will automatically hit the target even if the enemy moves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40849019/989ae95f9766e92bbc1a6f5e056a65aff35966cb.jpg[/img]
However, bullet tracking is canceled if the target is out of sight, hiding in cover, and using stealth.

Use the guided bullet function to easily subdue your enemies!

[h2]📒 Buildingcore and Superior/Fine Terrasite Balance ⚖️ [/h2]
We will briefly explain the planning direction in relation to the Buildingcore and Fine Terrasite balance that you left comments on the Official community during the previous Pre-Service period.

[h3]Buildingcore Balance[/h3]
First, the energy consumption issue that was excessively reflected in some building parts and installations during the Pre-Service period was improved in this 4th Beta Test.
However, energy efficiency is designed to decrease if an excessively large housing is being operated, and this is a plan considering the attack and defense balance of the housing.

[h3]Superior/Fine Terrasite Deposit Balance[/h3]
The balance has been adjusted for the Superior/Fine Terrasite Deposits in order to revalue the Terrasite and to adjust the balance of the Terrasite Transmitter price.

The quantity and distribution locations of the collected Terrasites have changed, and Fine Terrasites that have been obtained with a certain probability have been excluded.
※ Tip! Fine Terrasites can be obtained from Terrasite containers and capsules deployed at Hyena/Orbis/Rocket Bases, and can also be obtained from Field Bosses and Facilities.

Also, please note that the Superior Terrasite Deposits only spawn in Juggernaut Spot Events and in the new Delta region to adjust the difficulty of acquisition.

During this 4th Beta Test, we will continue to improve based on the data obtained by checking the opinions of survivors in various fields as well as Buildingcore and Fine Terrasite Deposit balance.

If you leave various opinions about Dysterra on Official community channels such as Discord
and Steam Forum, we will deliver them through our future Dev Notes.

notes.title: [Dev Note] New Region and Facility, Map Improvements, and Secure Crates
notes.content:
Hi Survivors,
This is Director. K.

Next week, our 4th Beta Test build will finally be released.
It really makes our hearts pound and nervous as we are approaching the big event.
We should calm our minds as we introduce the Dev Notes to you, Survivors.

Now, what we have prepared for you today are New Region and Facility, Map Improvements, and Security Hacking system.

[h2]📋 New Region and Facility🌋[/h2]

New Areas and Facility have previously been disclosed through the Dev Notes or our roadmap, but this time we will introduce them in more detail.

[h3]New Region, Delta[/h3]

The Delta region is located in the northwest, which we previously blocked access to.
Environmentally, it is very barren compared to the existing regions and there are many dangers, so it seems like it would be better to avoid access in the early game if you are a beginner.

Lava flows around this place, so your character’s body temperature will constantly rise as you stay in the area.
Direct contact with lava can result in instant death, so be careful while moving near it.

In the Delta region, the ‘Cyclops Tracker’ will appear at all times, impeding access to the Facility.
[previewyoutube=TeaELXvwjp0;full][/previewyoutube]
However, it is the only place where you can get the Superior Terrasite except for the Juggernaut run!
The challenge will be worth it, right?

[h3]5th Facility, Delta Plant[/h3]

The Delta Plant is a Facility that produces the Superior Terrasite by injecting catalyst materials underground.

It is located in the northwest of the Delta region, and the portal key to enter the Facility can be obtained by engaging the ‘Cyclops Tracker’ in the Delta region.

The inside of the Facility is guarded by ‘Vulkan’, the most difficult boss of Dysterra, so be extra careful.
[previewyoutube=A9qCCkV_c-4;full][/previewyoutube]
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　▲ Dysterra's most difficult boss, Vulcan

The Facility’s unique phase controller features ‘Enhanced Crystallization’ and ‘Crystalline Degradation’, allowing you to gain an edge over other survivors in the ranking competition if successful.

[h2]📋 Map Improvements 🌐[/h2]

The Eternal companion for World exploration, the World Map and Minimap will be improved.

[h3]World Map[/h3]

It is now modified to display official names in significant areas of the World.
Now, in addition to the coordinates, it will be possible to communicate more easily by using significant area names, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9e9e86e1457a248674acbe38883ad40f107ffea4.png[/img]

In addition, information such as altitude, vegetation, buildings, and roads is reflected to be expressed in more detail, and as various information is added, a filter function is also provided.

[h3]Minimap[/h3]

The minimap is improved to show the same level of information as the World Map, and the filter settings in the World Map are reflected in the same way.
[previewyoutube=rgjvzbcK-IY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]📋 Secure Crate 👨‍💻[/h2]

The Secure Crate has been added that allows you to obtain better rewards than the regular crates.

Depending on the security level of the Secure Crate, you can find low grades in Ruined Building areas and high grades in Hyena and Orbis Buildings.

Unlike other crates, the Secure Crate is highlighted with a hologram, and the required level of Security Hacking skill varies depending on the security level.
[previewyoutube=6TsdrWLqtjw;full][/previewyoutube]
There is a catch. Security Hacking can fail with probability! Of course, in case of failure, it is possible to give it another shot after a certain period of time.
Maybe try reducing the burden by investing in your Security Hacking skills.

When the Security Hacking skill level increases, you can enjoy effects such as cost time reduction, and energy cost reduction, in addition to increasing the success rate.

How was this week’s Dev Note contents? We hope you like the news!

Please leave your impressions or opinions on the Weekly Dev Notes on Official community channels such as Discord, Steam Forum, etc.
Of course, contents that are not related to the Dev Notes are always welcome as well.

Any comments or inquiries you have left will be delivered through the Dev Notes at a later date.

Then, we will see you next week with various information through the Dev Notes.

notes.title: [Dev note] Armor Protection function, Sleeping Bag feature, and Recycler
notes.content:
Hi Survivors,
This is Director. K.

In these days of spurring development, a crazy week has passed and it is already time to deliver this week’s Dev note.

This week, we prepared information about the addition of Armor Protection, improvement of the Sleeping Bag feature, and the Recycler.

[h2]📋 Added Armor Protection function 🦺[/h2]
Have you ever felt frustrated by losing advanced armor after being killed by an NPC or enemy attack?
Finally, as a way to reduce the burden in case of death, an Armor Protection function will be added.

[previewyoutube=p8Q6csuuCOA;full][/previewyoutube]
　　　　　　　▲ Armor still worn after death, such as items stored in Secure Slots

Now, even if you die, the armor you are wearing will not drop.

[h2]📋 Added Storage feature to Sleeping Bag 🛏[/h2]
A Sleeping Bag is a must for survivors who do not yet have housing or are exploring areas far from their housing.

[h3]Sleeping Bag color variations[/h3]
Do you all recall fearing the fact that the enemy would find your only green Sleeping Bag in terrain other than the bushes? I’m sure you guys have all been there at least once.
Now, the color of the Sleeping Bag changes depending on the terrain it is installed on.

[previewyoutube=jYDryfwGSgU;full][/previewyoutube]
　　　　　　　　　　▲ Color of Sleeping Bag changing according to terrain

Besides the green Sleeping Bag, white, black, and even brown Sleeping Bags! I can hear the sound of survivability rising all the way here.

[h3]Sleeping Bag Storage features[/h3]
In order to protect valuable items, it was necessary to create a dedicated Storage Box or housing.
Now, Sleeping Bags can store up to 10 items in total.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4eaf4c6d9748ccfe9358ecfa6468e3918adaf064.jpg[/img]
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　▲ Sleeping Bag Storage UI

These stored items in the Sleeping Bag cannot be taken by other survivors even if they find the Sleeping Bag.
However, if the Sleeping Bag is destroyed from an enemy attack, the stored items will also disappear. So you need to be extra careful with its usage, right?

[h2]📋 Recycler ♻[/h2]

On August 4th, we briefly introduced the Recycler from our future roadmap, and the details have been finalized.

The Recycler can recycle crafted items and it can be installed in housing.
When recycling, you can acquire the materials used to craft the item in a specific ratio.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/23a647fe880a69a99e007f63ba8d0405b1b2a764.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/018a39b2d0eae6be83f5dce3d6bde86d90af1524.jpg[/img]

For example, crafted items such as high-tier weapons that are difficult to repair or Fine Wires that are no longer used can be recycled as resources.
However, please note that raw materials such as Terrasites and Electrical Wires; bullets; food; items that cannot be obtained through crafting cannot be recycled.


How was this week’s Dev note contents? We hope you like the news!

Please leave your impressions or opinions on the news on Discord or Steam Forum.
Your diverse opinions are a great help in making Dysterra more fun!

Then, we will see you next week with more information through the Dev notes.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev note] Future roadmap including the 4th Beta Test
notes.content:
Hi Survivors,

This is Director. K,

A while ago, we announced the 4th Beta Test news through a notice.
Today, we would like to introduce the future roadmap of Dysterra including the 4th Beta Test.

[h3]📋 Facility 🏟[/h3]
Facilities are one of the most important contents in Dysterra.
It was designed and developed to allow survivors to use the facility to directly choose the fate of the planet.
 
It was planned for a long time, but there were various variables in the actual service process, and we were able to determine the direction of improvement through the game play pattern analysis.
 
In the future, we plan to raise the difficulty level of the facilities to prevent a small number of survivors from taking over the facility phase controller, and we will also adjust the phase controller balance. In particular, there will be many revisions to the Seismic Wave, which had a lot of opinions from survivors.
 
We will be improving the verdict for NPCs to make better use of the phase controller in PVE servers and singleplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9f53a4c4258188b2f227347001ac76babeb63d5c.jpg[/img]

Also, when the upper right area of the map(Gamma) is opened in the future, a very unique facility different from the existing facilities will be prepared, so please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ccf7a3529b67b48f87211e922132883fa5b4683a.jpg[/img]

[h3]📋 Global ranking system 🏆[/h3]
We're developing a Global ranking system to honor and reward the last survivors of fierce competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ddfed03772df8d2f762fe0092712f3535923055d.jpg[/img]

In particular, as the end of the world (server) through the terrafire eruption will have a significant impact on the Global ranking, we expect that the attack on facilities and phase control will become more intense.

In addition to the Global ranking leaderboard, the profile menu will provide more detailed information such as rankings, scores, achievements, terrasite transfer points, and PVP/PVE stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3df8795fe056c511f502a1ff526da72d0d5d0a85.jpg[/img]

[h3]📋 Weapon 🔫[/h3]
We are planning to improve the battle by enabling more various types of battles by adding new types of weapons.

A representative example is considering the bullets with guidance function, sustained damage, etc., and we plan to increase usability by adjusting the balance of weapons that had low efficiency.


[h3]📋 Building(Housing) 🏡[/h3]
We are preparing a function to improve the defense and management convenience of the housing, and in particular, we will provide a function to repair damaged building parts more easily.

And the housing(Buildingcore) energy consumption system will continue to be balanced so that it cannot be built abnormally large in scale or to operate abnormally many installations.

[h3]📋 Vehicle 🚗[/h3]
As much as the opinions of survivors, our dev team is greedy for implementing various vehicles.

In the short term, we are preparing the appearance change function of the existing DYNAMO vehicle, and a completely different type of vehicle with an attack function is currently under development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ba2d9e0f7993e335e688eb4c900368e5ae8503e6.jpg[/img]

[h3]📋 Recycler ♻[/h3]
I’m sure it was a pain in the neck to throw away the items that were difficult to obtain but no longer needed.

We are preparing a Recycler that allows you to obtain some of the resources used in crafting at a certain rate.

And the Recycler can be conveniently used by installing it in the housing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2a24eaf7ad157314b160285e61f16008e8f6d7e7.jpg[/img]

[h3]📋 Anti-Cheat 👮[/h3]
During the service period, various cheat methods were identified, so we have strengthened security through continuous updates, and various functions were added to enable quicker response to the cheaters.

Through this, it is expected that more Hacktools will be blocked fundamentally and a faster response to new cheats will be possible.

And, of course, we will continue to monitor and take action on reports of survivors!

[h3]📋 Release Date 📆[/h3]
As previously announced, Dysterra 4th Beta Test will be held for 1 week from August 30th,
and most of the contents introduced above are expected to be showcased during the 4th Beta Test period.

And Dysterra is preparing for an Early Access release in the 4th quarter of 2022, and will continue to provide new content and features after the Early Access.

All Dysterra officials are always listening to the various opinions of survivors, and we will do our best to include more opinions in the game.

See you next time with more information! Thank you.

notes.title: [Dev note] Updates on stability test and upcoming schedules
notes.content:
Hi Survivors, 

This is Director. K, 
It’s been a while since I’ve said hello. 👋

I hope you all enjoyed our CBT and the demo.
I would like to thank you all again for the valuable feedback as well. 

For that, Dysterra was able to evolve in many ways. One of the big pillars of the feedback was the server stability and anti-cheat issues, so we still have the ‘playtest’ feature up to make it work better. 


[h1]Stability Test Progress? [/h1]
We have identified and improved the following major performance bottlenecks: 

[h3]📋NPC optimization🤖[/h3]
Since many NPCs can emerge simultaneously within the game world, we have adjusted the number of active NPCs so that the total quantity is appropriate for server performance. AI for NPCs is also under tuning process, they might feel a little slow, but when the overall server issues become better, AI will become better along with it. 

[h3]📋Object collision optimization🚧[/h3]
Depending on user activities in game, crash handling was one of the big bottlenecks within the server. There have been several optimization related to this issue over the past month. 

[h3]📋Buildings Optimization🏢[/h3]
We have found that complexity of the building built by the players put a lot of load within the server. This issue is under process of optimization. 

[h3]📋Anti-cheat👮[/h3]
Since we have first seen cheats being used, a lot of structural loopholes with unauthorized illegal programs have been constantly been filled. Consequently, we are seeing dramatic reduction in number of cheats being used.


It is difficult to disclose all details about the measures we will be taking. Even now, however, we are trying our best to block all unauthorized illegal programs and viewing user activities through various methods. 

Aside from these measures being taken through anti-cheat solution and the client itself, our GMs are constantly viewing user activities through in-game monitoring as well. However, we ask for your understanding that it may take some time as the investigation on cheats needs to be carried out in a precise manner to prevent unnecessary banning on wrong players. 

[h1]What are your future plans for Dysterra? [/h1]
The stability test that is on-going right now will end soon, and the exact date will be announced 3 days before it ends. 
Also, please note that the existing game information (nickname, etc.) will be wiped at the end of the test. 

In addition, apart from the stability test, we are working on various new contents and improvements to the existing system. Let me give you a slight glimpse into what we are preparing. These updates include bigger map, female chracters, and new weapons as we’ve announced earlier. 

[h3]📌Global ranking system🏆[/h3]
Some of you may have already realized that we have been constantly strengthening our ranking system. Everything was a stepping stone for this upcoming global ranking system. Every actions that you take in-game will affect the overall ranking. Most importantly, it is crucial to survive till the last in each world. It is only natural to feel proud about being ranked high, but we are also preparing some rewards that can be obtained depending on the rankings. Additional details about the rewards will be released later on. 

[h3]📌Reinforced item recovery in case of death🧐[/h3]
Safety slots in the inventory already exists, but to reduce the risk of dying in game. We are going to make the system even easier to re-collect your items. 

[h3]📌Added functions to sleeping bags⛺[/h3]
To reduce the burden of having a building (shelter) for yourself, and to encourage more field action, we will be adding new functions to the sleeping bag. Sleeping bags will now have a storage function as well, Items in the sleeping bag will not be lootable, but sleeping bags will still be vulnerbale to attacks and can be destructed by other players. 

[h3]📌Tutorial improved💪[/h3]
We have simplified tutorials related to combat and survival. 

We will be back with more interesting news soon! 
See you guys then!👋 

Thanks : )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b049b72831cbeac09f813831fcee8f5017439973.png[/img]

The delta area, which originally had the first facility built on Earth, was the place where compressed a large number of terrasites and transmitted to Orbis. Currently the area is turned into a vast volcanic field that burns everything nearby due to small scale of terrafire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/7275d5421dd2902f32f1a3252c82c233c4992433.png[/img]

In the past, the facility was burnt down due to the war between Hyenas and Pioneers, and buried terrasites under the ground were activated and triggered a huge explosion of terrafire.

The discovery of terrasite buried underground on the surface is a sign of terrafire, which is why the terrafire count began, isn’t it?

Please look forward to the new story of Delta Area.

It is a NPC that has a strong destructive power as Magma destroyed facilities during skirmishes with Pioneers in the past, turning the nearby area into a volcanic field.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c705b01aeba585f67c681e65286869c1e30dc66f.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Global beta test has started 

[b][h3]📌Global beta test schedule[/h3][/b]
 (PDT) Tue, 3 May 2022. 19:00 ~ Mon, 16 May 2022. 23:00
 (CEST) Wed, 4 May 2022. 04:00 ~ Tue, 17 May 2022. 08:00
 (KST) Wed, 4 May 2022. 11:00 ~ Tue, 17 May 2022. 15:00

If you are having a difficulty in starting the game,
please read and follow the guide down below to join our test. 

[b][h3]📌The test is run through playtest [/h3][/b]
Please join through “Dysterra Playtest” app not “Dysterra” app. When you run it with “Dysterra” app, you won’t be able to join. 

Also, if you have participated in our previous betas, make sure you re-install the game client. A lot has been changed since our last beta, big updates might bring about problems with running the game. 

Steam library - delete “Dysterra Playtest” app
Re-download through Steam library or Steam store page. 

[b][h3]📌Check system requirements [/h3][/b]
Errors may occur, If you do not meet the minimum system requirements. Also, If you are using Windows11 OS, you might run into problems as well. We will make sure we provide you with more stable service when we officially launch. 

[Minmum]
- Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
- OS: Windows 8.1
- Processor: i5-9400 or Ryzen 5 2600
- Memory: 8 GB RAM
- Graphics: GTX 950 or R9 380
- DirectX: Version 11
- Network: Broadband Internet connection
- Storage: 50 GB available space

[Recommended]
- Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
- OS: Windows 10
- Processor: i7-9700 or Ryzen 5 3600x
- Memory: 16 GB RAM
- Graphics: RTX 2070 or RX 5700 XT
- DirectX: Version 12
- Network: Broadband Internet connection
- Storage: 50 GB available space

[b][h3]📌Recommend optimizing your graphics and Resetting your controls prior to playing the game. [/h3][/b]
If you have settings that are already saved from previous betas, it might bring about problems when starting the game. If you do run into problems before starting, reset your options to default prior to starting the game. 

[b][h3]📌Single player mode[/h3][/b]
By playing in single player mode, you will be given a chance to experience various contents such as spot events and facilities. At the same time, you will be able to adjust the game environment such as resource respawn, PvE damage, and NPC quantity for faster and easier growth. 

However, please note that your previous play record will be initialized if you choose to start a New Game in single player mode. Unlike the official server, the single player mode may directly be affected by your personal PC and the system requirements that it has. We will do our best to work on our optimization so that we can provide you with better gaming environment. 

[b][h3]📌The official server has both PVP and PVE server.[/h3][/b]
If you are struggling and stressed out to compete with other players, you can join PVE server, and experience the various contents of Dysterra.
6. If you are new to Dysterra, try out the tutorial.
Once the character is created, you will see the tutorial pop-up before accessing the game.
When you decide to go through the tutorial, you can learn a variety of game systems Dysterra has such as looting, crafting, and survival with mission guides in the beginning.

You skipped over without experiencing the tutorial?

notes.title: Game start and play & Main Q&A
notes.content:
Here’s our answers for enquiries gathered from Steam community and Discord during our 2nd beta test from new testers

[b][h3][Install and Play][/h3][/b]

📍After the game starts, server lists do not show up.
Game installation and play should be run through Dysterra Playtest.

 - Dysterra play test running screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a68790f685249e113bfc5b179c4ebf435dc36c1b.jpg[/img]

📍The game gets stuck and crashes in the loading screen.
When the game crashes in the loading screen, or has problems running the game, please check our minimum system requirements.

If your PC does not cover minimum system requirements, you might have problems running the game.

[b]Minimum system requirement[/b]
 - Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
 - OS: Windows 8.1
 - Processor: i5-9400 or Ryzen 5 2600
 - Memory: 12GB RAM
 - Graphics: GTX 950 or R9 380
 - DirectX: Version 11
 - Storage: 50 GB available space
  ※ Dysterra does not support under the version of Window 8.1, even your PC meets the system requirements.
※ Windows 11 OS environment might cause unexpected problems running the game.

📍Not being able to join the server after the game starts 
If the game crashes in the lobby or after the game starts, please check on ‘allow access’ when Windows Defender Firewall alerts pops up.
Since Windows Defender Firewall blocks a few settings of the game, you might have problems running the game.


📍Runtime error occurs running the game.
When the Runtime error occurs, please install Visual Studio 2019, Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable package.
 'The following component(s) are required to run this program:......' error is often caused by defects of Visual Studio 2019, Microsoft Visual C++ redistributable package, in this case please re-install with the link below to solve the error.

 - Download : [[url=https://aka.ms/vs/16/release/VC_redist.x64.exe]link[/url]]

📍Ways to solve errors (integrity check)
Most errors caused when running the game can be resolved through integrity check or re-installation.

1. On Steam client library menu > right click on the title of the game > click properties
2. On properties menu, click Local files > click Verify integrity of beta files
 ※ it might take some time to do the integrity check, if it does not help solving the error, please delete and reinstall the client.

📍If the game crashes after entering the server
When unexpected errors occur, please reinstall the game and update the graphics card driver to the latest version.
During the game update, game launch or graphics card errors can occur as old version graphics card crashing issues.

📍 How to fix the crash when wearing Warbane Jacket
If the game crashes while wearing Warbane Jacket on a PC with Nvidia graphics card, update the graphics card driver to the latest version in order to solve the problem.

📍 Other errors of installation and gameplay that are not mentioned here, please send us through the customer centre with detailed explanation and screen captures of errors. We would love to support you to sort problems out.

 - Customer centre : [[url=https://kakaogames.oqupie.com/portals/1489]link[/url]] 

[b][h2][플레이][/h2][/b]

📍How do you farm resources? 
- Objects that can be looted in the game will convey a shiny line surrounding it. 
You can loot various material items by collecting, opening, or picking them up with F key (or by pressing on 'F key). 
If it is difficult to distinguish farm-able objects, you can check more clearly by looking through vision ('V' key). Energy will reduce when using the vision. 

[previewyoutube=8TYoKZPE894;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=mBINmHmaXgM;full][/previewyoutube]

📍How do you engage in battle in the beginning? 
Loot your pod, craft (short key 'U') short range weapons or Agon (Pistol ammo needed) to engage in small battles. Crafted weapons can be used by putting them on quickslots. 

[previewyoutube=mlK3Wod75oE;full][/previewyoutube]

By using the ‘left shift’ key, you can chase your target at a faster speed.
[previewyoutube=DD-rvBfvimE;full][/previewyoutube]

📍How do you build base?
Go to construction mode by using 'F2' key and build parts like foundation and walls. 
[previewyoutube=NI_D30Tm2ek;full][/previewyoutube]

Construct foundation first to build other parts as well. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f60eb417a513adf8c8142e911155321be4589184.jpg[/img]

📍How do you upgrade the walls? 
Go to the maintenance ring menu where it is possible to upgrade, retrieve, repair, or demolish buildings. 

- Demolish: Demolish specific part of a building and get resources back partially (cannot demolish buildings built by others) 
Upgrade: Upgrade specific part of a building to an upper tier 
- Retrieve: Retrieve installments (door, storage, bed) back to your inventory. (cannot retrieve Terracores) 
- Repair: Repair specific part of a building
[previewyoutube=8TRzb1gAcj0;full][/previewyoutube]

📍 How do you install crafted items
- Once the crafting completes, the crafted item automatically goes to your quickslot. 
You can use those items in the quickslot by pressing the number assigned to that quickslot. 
If you have full quickslots, please re-arrange them in the inventory. 
[previewyoutube=h9_RiSD7rso;full][/previewyoutube]

📍 I've lost my base! 
Buildings constantly degrade overtime, 
After a specific set of time without installing Terracore in your base to stop the degrading, the base will fall apart and demolish itself. 
Go to crafting menu (short key 'U'), crafter Terracore and switch on anti-degrade mode to 
sustain your buildings.  Energy consumption of a Terracore varies depending on the number of buildings. 
[previewyoutube=xuQULsf_jCw;full][/previewyoutube]

📍 Installments like Plasma workbench, and turrets are not working
If there is no energy left on the Terracore, installments within the building will not work. Convert items into energy in the Terracore for them to work. 
[previewyoutube=m4D-l3qVq_0;full][/previewyoutube]

📍 How do you restore weapons that has no durability left
Weapons can be restored through the Catenane Repair Bench.
Catenane Repair Bench can be crafted on Plasma workbench, which can only be 
installed on the power board. 

📍Refer to following link for other useful tips for beginners 
 - Beginners guide for 2nd Beta [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2657583617]Link[/url]]

We are in need of your valuable feedback to be better. 
We will try our best to come back with better Dysterra. 

Thanks.
