notes.title: Change in Beta test schedule, Key questions from the online conference Q&A sessi
notes.content:
We are here to drop the news about the extended 2nd beta test and some of the key questions from the online conference that was hosted on 11/19 13:00 PM (PST). 

[b][h2][Extended schedule of the 2nd beta] [/h2][/b]

As many of you guys requested, we are extending the schedule of our 2nd beta test. The main goal of the extension is to offer you guys with longer testing opportunity and to test custom servers. 
 
 - (PST) Mon, 15 Nov 2021 18:00 ~ [strike]Mon, 22 Nov 2021 23:00[/strike] → Sun 28 Nov 2021 21:00
 - (CET) Tue, 16 Nov 2021 03:00 ~ [strike]Tue, 23 Nov 2021 08:00[/strike] → Mon 29 Nov 2021 06:00
 - (KST) Tue, 16 Nov 2021 03:00 ~ [strike]Tue, 23 Nov 2021 16:00[/strike] → Mon 29 Nov 2021 14:00

Your feedback always helps us better prepare for our next test. 

[b][h2][Main Qs from the online conference][/h2][/b]

[b][h3]1. Landmark and Terrafire[/h3][/b]

Q. Landmark, and boss raid is way too difficult
A. You have to target those areas with armors and weapons at least over tier 3. Also, it is not meant to be cleared solo, you have to make up a team to clear those areas. However, we are aware that balance among players does exist, so we are planning on adjusting the balance a bit

Q.  Event alarms are way too hard to catch, can you make it more noticeable?
A. If we were to make alarms for boss and spot events as well, there may be too much info on the map. As of right now, all supply pods are being shown on the map, if we were to add more info on top of that. That would cause too much confusion. However, there is an alarm for landmarks for competition purposes. 

Q. Time left for Terrafire eruption stays the same even after the use of landmark skills
A. When the game begins, days left until the eruption is 168 days (In game world), the time either extends or shortens depending on the world’s condition and how players play. However, the date can be shortened too much if players were to use many skills. So, we’ve set a minimum line on the eruption date. It can’t go shorter than that minimum line. 

Q. In the event of the Terrafire eruption- won’t people abuse the escape skyrockets, if the boarding locations stay fixed everytime?
A. Since escape skyrockets are a newly added feature, we fixed the location so that players can be more familiar with it. We’ve expected battles near those areas, however, we’ve put a restriction on battle within the rocket itself. After checking how players use this feature, we will update or take out some of the related features to make it better. 

[b][h3]2. Game balance/Items/Housing[/h3][/b]

Q. It is easy to make weapons and ammunition whereas it is hard to collect required materials to upgrade buildings. Any plan on changing that balance? 
A. The price of ammunition will increase, especially the rocket cartridges. However, the shield level of buildings will increase accordingly. 

Q. First tier buildings are now very easy to loot, but the usage of those low tier items are very low. Can you add features like item conversion and recycle so that we can make use of those items? 
A. We recommend using those items as fuel in Terracores. 
We have thought about putting in 'recycle' for low tier items. 
But we are worried that the experienced users might take advantage of that and target beginners for those low tier items. So we are contemplating about this issue on both ends.

Q.Any plan on adding spot events other than supply pod, snipers, hyena dropship
A. Yes, variety of spot events are planned to be added. Each with differnt goal and purpose. 

Q. There are 3 tiers to buildings, do you have plan on adding more tiers to buildings as well? 
A. Yes, tiers for everything including weapons, armors and buildings will have 5 tiers in total. 

Q. Overall difficulty of the game has decreased way too much due to the added Terrasite exchange transmitter. 
A. The balance of that specific item is set very generously since it is a newly added item. After checking how players use this item, however, we will check and analyze the data and fix its balance

Q. I would love to see a snap to grid when placing some items, with a feature that could be turned off or on.)
A. Thanks for a great idea, we will take that into consideration 

Q. Any plan on adding more weapons? If so, what kind? 
A. Thinking about adding close-distance weapons, and guns with special damage like the Drescher. 

Q. Any plan on adding building parts? 
A. Of course, parts like pillars will be added. We are sorry that we can't add them all at once. 

[b][h3]3. Single play, fame, team/clan [/h3][/b]

Q. How is single player mode going to be changed? 
A.  It will constantly be changed, we can't say for sure what is going to be added and taken out. But we will add the same features that will be added to custom servers as well. 

Q. Plan on adding any other ranking system other than fame? 
A. When we add a clan system, fame ranking for each server will be changed, and integrated fame ranking including all servers will be added as well. 

Q. What is the difference between TEAM and CLAN?
Who should we add to TerraCore ? Team or Clan?
A. Team- smaller and shorter relationship that can be on and off whenever 
Clan- group that is bigger and lasts longer. Applies to all servers. 

Q. Any plan on adding maps? if so when? 
A. Map will be updated when we officially launch our game. 
New map will have a new scenario also. As of right now, though, we are not sure of the exact date yet. 

[b][h3]4. Other issues [/h3][/b]

Q. Im streaming on Twitch, is there a way to prevent stream sniping 
A. We are looking to add blockage system to hide personal information from showing. 

Q. The previous Beta, I went to the Radion Zone (NW of Map), and With Radiation Protection, active, i received 500+ rads, in 1 second after getting out Of the vehicle. When will the NW be made available? It was empty last Beta
A. Veiled Northern area will be open when the game officially launches, and landmarks will be added as well 

Q. Custom server features are very inadequate 
A. We are aware of the issues regarding the custom servers. We have yet to add more features to make them more convenient. We will make it better ASAP. 

Q. Please add inventory alignment feature
A. We will add this for sure in our next test. Also, we will add alignment features on the workbench as well. 

Q. tried a play speed of more than 10 and it broke the server, when the escape timer came up is 1501234 time equal to 150d 12h 34m?
A. The unit is set in seconds. The unit seems way too small, we will fix it with a bigger unit. 

Q. Any plan on adding map-related features where you can share map pings with your teammates? 
A. We are actually in the talks about this issue, and we will most likely add this feature pretty soon. 

Q. I want to play single player mode duirng the maintenance. 
A. These two cannot be run separately currently. 
However, these two will be completely separate when we officially launch Dysterra. 

Q. When will we be able to choose female characters? 
A. Female characters will be available in our official launch. 


Thank you.

notes.title: 2nd beta test update guide part 4 - changed latter part of the game
notes.content:
Changed landmarks that can be dominated by co-oping with other players and newly added Terrasite exchanger and escape route. 

[b][h2]1. Chemochamber[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0c3be8fe300df0b3159f8a46270c393d993a4184.jpg[/img]

Chemochamber that is located on the coordinate “X2587 Y1131”, is a place where they study about effects of Terrasite on living organisms. They especially focus on testing genetic mutations and diseases through animal experiments. 

At the Chemochamber, you can get resources like the Energy core and Super Telephoto Lens, which you can craft 5 tier weapons with. You can also obtain a phase controller that can activate the phase control effect. 
※  Please refer to in-game radiogram (Short key ‘J’) > Item list 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b6d3de8504ffe056fcfc86a84c259574fb7ad7df.png[/img]

[b][Chemical Phase controller effect] [/b]
- Air purification: skill activated area will heal survivors constantly until the effect ends. 
※ Terrafire eruption + 6
[previewyoutube=EsWHh9u0sLM;full][/previewyoutube]

- Dust storm: In the skill activated area, survivors will be exposed to radiation which will take their HP.  
※ Terrafire eruption -12
[previewyoutube=ouvumOVDNiM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][Tips on clearing Chemochamber][/b]
Activate 2 key card consoles and open the main center gate. 
(2 key cards can be obtained by taking out Talone Brute near consoles).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0e99bc88e2e9afa117fb1aa42a7e1d44b583da07.jpg[/img]

- Destroy the energy pylon on the first floor, you will then have access to the second floor entrance. 
(Energy pylons can only be destroyed after taking out all mutant guardians connected to the energy pylons) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/2cd7a9b92ce77ff50be5f8a23d63a49380dec4f0.jpg[/img]

- When the chamber core on the second floor is destroyed, a phase controller can be obtained. 
(Chamber core can only be destroyed after taking out mutant guardians connected to it) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/aae2686d9026a69a811b0ae08f7a82a091327fb1.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]2. Geolab[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6095de619145fdf3ae5a90f6f9a3417fc3c6d783.jpg[/img]

Geolab that is located on the coordinate ‘X1557 Y 1460’ is a laboratory that is created to increase the Terrasite output. Its’ main focus is to promote crystallization of Terrasites scattered underground due to seismic waves. 

At the Geolab, you can obtain Energy core and Super Telephoto Lens, and you can earn a Geodynamic phase controller from here. 
※  Please refer to in-game radiogram (Short key ‘J’) > Item list 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4cef319cf813dd7f3a14695d94b218b80dbc7c89.png[/img]

[b][Geodynamic phase controller effect] [/b]
- Ground stabilization: It decreases the degradation effect on the buildings in the selected area. 
※ Terrafire eruption +8
[previewyoutube=2BDS5RCFF48;full][/previewyoutube]

- Seismic wave: Gives building damage in the selected area
※ Terrafire eruption -16
[previewyoutube=qHTGbKFUR98;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][Geolab clear guide] [/b]
The central gate can be opened by activating 4 escape gates. 
(Activated escape gates will deactivate after certain period of time)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ef8b41708786110f5ac3cf57d798f9d59f934450.jpg[/img]

After entering the central gate, take out the NPCs and obtain a phase controller. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6b1f81ef5e2cf94aeb504e2d28215e2f21d532f0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0d6f42efeaa36d95b1bb43b569e0eee3853a2c2c.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Field boss [/b]
From the three marked areas in the image down below, huge amount of Terrasite can be obtained, but it is inevitable to encounter field boss Juggernaut in those areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/62357419ddab896fc57c693dddea1e385ed3f3f4.png[/img]

After taking out the Juggernaut, “Juggernaut core” can be obtained, which will give you a variety of items needed for winning battles. Not only that huge amount of Terrasite can be earned as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/abd98195c084428f231b0273639d8c84aeab9d96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8c5444f4c4462a44c9c6bc32671c777c771491e5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/460cfd9bd2988d89e278cef27951655ca1b59884.jpg[/img]

[b]4. Terrasite exchanger transmitter[/b]
With the newly added ‘Terrasite exchange transmitter’ you can exchange looted Terrasite with “Terrasite points” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/9a17387f766f6275b936f99cf577f9541f80337b.jpg[/img]

With the Terrasite points, you can earn variety of items needed for you survival in Dysterra. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a70f57f198124d99f328c481d508a2c7b007b540.jpg[/img]

Exchanged item is given through mailbox (Short key ‘P). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0eef9a83f53eff8e74548845256d02b2e3f62bbc.jpg[/img]

[b]5. Escape system[/b]

When the countdown begins for the Terrafire eruption. There will be Escape Rockets in 3 different places. With the escape rocket boarding code, you can get on the rocket and go back to Orbis safely. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/73849b2872bcc136de05a928dec122bad3cf911f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/54cf177d32cbe331352c311e432e2dff5f2efbce.png[/img]

In order to board those rockets, you have to upgrade your machine arm (Short key ‘Y’). 


Rocket boarding code can be obtained with Terrasite points in the Terrasite exchange transmitter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/52c290fdedc11889bb949cbda855edda920cd42f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/61f61680835d918046f968f18e6f7b31e0335e17.jpg[/img]

Utilizing the Teleport device on the 1st floor of Launch Bases will bring you to the rooftop where the Escape Rocket is located.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a20b6bfd9b18002299777ce37eddb81bcff92936.jpg[/img]

I wish everyone a safe escape before the Terrafire erupts! : ) 
[previewyoutube=5iF3gw7fU2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]6. CUSTOM SERVER SYSTEM[/h2][/b]
You can enjoy the game with your friends by creating your own custom server apart from the Official servers.
You can modify the main world settings and create various environments on custom servers.
*Some of the settings required through out the guide may affect your PC security and functions.

- CUSTOM SERVER SYSTEM guide [[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2657692765]LINK[/url]]

Thanks.

notes.title: 2nd beta test update guide part 3 - New weapons
notes.content:
We are here to introduce two new craftable weapons. 
These two weapons use rocket cartridges, and both are powerful as it gets. 

[h2][b]Thumper[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/fba4f96e1ec4f55b008cd2311f99b4b0d762309e.jpg[/img]
[b]-Type: Rocket Launcher
-Ammo: Rocket Catridge
-Damage Type: Explosion
-Damage: 160 
-Piercing: 0%
-Building Damage: 900% [/b]

Thumper is effective in attacking enemies simultaneously in open areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/45ecff81d577e7f0ef1b83adafacd05bca0b4732.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/40d2bf922d6026103d8c4016d72876fe3458354a.png[/img]

You can craft Thumper on the Plasma workbench with required resources: Accelerator (craft), High resistor (loot), Energy core (loot), Terrasite Concentrate (craft/create).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f945335cc8cd475347a2699e1aa754490723b5e2.png[/img]

Thumper is equipped with a quick rate of fire and long range rockets which can effectively be used to defend or raid bases. 

[previewyoutube=d9fSpFOZMQ0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Rokita[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/18b9296bb7eeb76b6a8dc321290f2130c69e2241.jpg[/img]
[b]- Type: Rocket Launcher
- Ammo: Rocket Catridge
- Damage Type: Explosion
- Damage: 220 
- Piercing: 25%
- Building Damage: 900% [/b]

Rokita, with its tremendous building damage, can effectively be used to destroy bases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b0baa5e5186b9e3cf9f0732b6555b66d1246688a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ebc339da1bc1ea7b7e6464e40cdd49c171bf3145.png[/img]

You can craft Rokita on the Plasma workbench with required resources: Accelerator (craft), Pure iron (loot/create), Energy core (loot), Terrasite Concentrate (craft/create).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/45b174ad823823cec89dfdf39e04d58c472fe220.png[/img]

Rokita is very easy to use, you will be able to demolish most bases with it. 

[previewyoutube=H31YhnvM4Po;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, with these two rocket launchers in hand, engage in more powerful and intense battles with other survivors.

Please wishlist and follow Dysterra for more updates and information.
We will come back with better and improved Dysterra next week!

Thanks survivors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0796afe7d42841200826dd08eeb4d46dbdac3aaa.png[/img]

notes.title: 2nd beta test update guide part 2 - Vehicle and new traps
notes.content:
We would like to introduce a new way to use vehicles and traps you will face on our 2nd beta test.

[b][h2][Changed way to use a vehicle][/h2][/b]
Over the world, there will randomly be “DYNAMO with no tires” along the road, unlike the previous world, survivors cannot drive it immediately. Restoration system has been added to drive DYNAMO only with crafted vehicle tires.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5be62f50668d5f746b535d5f1e7124cf7956cca9.jpg[/img]

After equipping “Vehicle Tires”, restored vehicles can be refuelled through maintenance menu(F HOLD) and you can also restore decreased durability from the damage done by other survivors. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a48074491eb8de132dfce28444caf7055b1bad01.jpg[/img]


[b]<Vehicle restoration - Vehicle Tires>[/b]
Can make DYNAMO with no tires re-drivable again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6d8e46935023f6274fd9ae090ce11263b33d6491.png[/img]

[b]<Vehicle Power cell>[/b]
It is a consumable Battery that is used for refuelling vehicles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/16398392ffdcf1bffa96470d21238a6652f05460.png[/img]

[b]<Vehicle restoration - 1st tier resources consumption>[/b]
Vehicles can be fixed using bolt, Sensor, Wire in proportion to decreased durability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/c1e497af7ff5518f1db34ef17a7441d9bedac250.png[/img]

When durability has been completely damaged, DYNAMO turns to “Broken vehicle”, and cannot be driven anymore.
Few resources are obtainable through unusable “Broken vehicle”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5a435b21ca10013ce462ce3c297ac0744284e5b8.jpg[/img]

[b][h2][Guide for new traps][/h2][/b]

1. Two new turrets 
two new turrets are added each using different types of ammo.

[b]<Turret - L>[/b]
Automated defense turret using light ammo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/220c3fa6883f7bd52b5bd8275a4fb73a1e20c615.png[/img]

[b]<Turret - S>[/b]
Automated defense turret using shotgun slug.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5fe96350ca9b253d6de4f5c4677e506ee7e93d74.png[/img]

[b]<Turret - E>[/b]
Automated defense turret using energy ammo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/393cc20aa46a62c297e009e3233498ed26c040bc.png[/img]

Turrets can be installed with different types of ammo. Therefore, turrets are able to react differently to other types of ammo/armor being used by intruders. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/84a50affde915814337a84a29de7a8f9b3c1c2f7.jpg[/img]

2. Two new base traps are added
Originally, there were only traps that are shaped in squares. Now,  
two types of triangle base traps have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/58913a1482150dd009aeae9f3bdd7b217c9c2f09.jpg[/img]

[b]<Hologram Floor>[/b]
It is a transparent floor that can be installed up on the ceiling. Please note that it cannot be installed on the ground or foundation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b8ef8abff047031521e2208e21c7345f3eeeaa70.png[/img]

[b]<Electric Floor>[/b]
Electric Floor can be installed right on the ground or foundation.
Depending on its electricity consumption settings, damages vary along with it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0a76fad3bf856946837e044be00ce2b1866dca74.png[/img]

You can trick and get rid of intruders with a combination of these two different types of trap
[previewyoutube=p3FpmnETQfs;full][/previewyoutube]

3. Installments for base management
These updated installments will help survivors to manage their basecamp better. 

[b]<Garage door>[/b]
Garage doors can be installed at the edge of ceiling enabling vehicles to go in and out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/8c5ac983bb07fa82e692c6dd0e11bd4e4967a411.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=UpgmDNBRx18;full][/previewyoutube]

Survivors can not only use this garage door for DYNAMO, but it can also be used for different purposes as well. For example, you can put your storages inside these garage doors. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1d706b93d1d31264a8b169d89b992dd8bfcb2776.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d6fde15af7bfe686c7a2c8f511134d998a0d4463.jpg[/img]

[b]<Integrated Facility Manager>[/b]
It is a device managing the installed machines all at once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/f7521f4dccfa413eadc93e05ff2a4e94b4f7a3e9.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=fXFv78crcCw;full][/previewyoutube]

Crafting, fixing, and power management of all the installed machines inside your base can now be controlled by this device all at once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/18f348438ce8ed28468858e6de74b89d4456fa5d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ced6c207c2379a56fceb75846daa425c92300629.jpg[/img]

[b]<Terrasite Exchange Transmitter>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/a352d76b5517843e775582267b17e2b64dc51c59.png[/img]
The machine that survivors will find the most important. Method of using this ‘Terrasite Exchange Transmitter’ will be explained through another post before the test begins. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3a9215dd62631e700a11deacc485e476774c07b5.jpg[/img]

Please wishlist and follow Dysterra for more updates and information. 
We will come back with better and improved Dysterra next week! 

Thanks survivors
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0796afe7d42841200826dd08eeb4d46dbdac3aaa.png[/img]

notes.title: Frontier test guide
notes.content:
Here’s our guide for the frontier test starting on Oct 6.
The test will be preceded through Dysterra playtest, it will be available for 11 hours per day. 

For more details, please check the information below.

[b][h3][Planned Schedule][/h3][/b]

 - Date: Oct 6 ~ Oct 10 (5 days)

 - Time:  PDT 13:00 ~ 24:00 / CEST 22:00 ~ 09:00(11 hours a day) 

[b][h3][How to join the test][/h3][/b]

When the test is on, you can start the game through the Playtest app registered in Steam Library after completing the installation.

If the Dysterra app is not registered, get to the Dysterra Steam page - click Dysterra Request Access, then Dysterra playtest will be activated.

- Change in world map image
 > Principal regions are distinguished by colours (white coloured - areas are relatively easy / red coloured - difficult)

- Housing - Pillar, Hologram Floor, Control Panel, Triangle Electric Floor are added

- Installation - Sleeping bag,  Auto Retrieval Locker are added

- 3rd tier weapons can be crafted on the field

- New item - Pistol ammo is added

- New weapon Glee(Energy/DMR), Maverick(Energy/SMG), Thumper(Energy/Rocket) are added

[b]4. Landmarks[/b]

- Increased overall difficulty level of landmarks
 > The difficulty has been changed based on changed map formation and teamplay

Also superior items including Tier 4 weapons, recipes and required resources may be subject to change. 

[b]2. Official Server Region guide[/b]

On this test, Virginia PVP server will first be opened.
Depending on the number of active users, additional servers can possibly be opened.

[b]3. Supported language guide[/b]

On this test, supported languages are only English/Korean, and other languages will be updated in the future as well.
On this frontier test, we are all ears to bug reports, and user feedback and suggestions through Steam community, Discord channel and Official community.

notes.title: Crafting, Housing update, and Frontier test
notes.content:
Here’s our updates on crafting and housing

[h2][Crafting update][/h2]

Few changes mentioned below will be updated for better surviving and battle during the early part of the game.

[h3]1. Gun craft difficulty adjusted and pistol ammo added.[/h3]

Difficulty adjustment on overall looting, survivors can now craft 1st and 2nd tier weapons in a shorter period of time.
Moreover, survivors can craft 3rd tier weapons on the field without a workbench that can only be installed in basecamp. However, please note that there will be disadvantages on durability and resource consumption on 2nd and 3rd tier weapons crafted on the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/b108405677f119b6fa4743fc09f57b7745bdd93e.jpg[/img]

Also, pistol ammo can be crafted with low cost which can lead to usage of Agons without any pressure of using many resources. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/32231689f87473701a495158dbe3a5727a1dbf6b.png[/img]

[h3]2.   New item: sleeping bag[/h3]

When a character dies, the sleeping bag works as a respawning point. Unlike bed, it can easily be installed without building a basecamp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/84b8413fbbb5bae229e637d0b0f29e4f9677d622.jpg[/img]

However, it does have a longer cooldown duration compared to the bed. When respawned, cooldown duration will be activated on the sleeping bag itself and any bed located nearby. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/ea5a984413c8483f5904d8a3df8ffe0cdfe4fc68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/3f2d89e9f0f160df64219b242f901dd400ddd30f.png[/img]

[h2][Housing update][/h2]

For more convenient basecamp management, crafting mode and production settings are partially changed.

[h3]1. Housing parts diversification[/h3]

Crafting mode(F2) Housing ring UI will be categorised by same or similar housing parts 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/447e53dd12d12f1b84fd492a3951258e349dcd8a.jpg[/img]

Also with our new pillar parts on housing, survivors can build various types of basecamp with special exterior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5acfc1007f606ddfdfc2e25a2d76cfc79245f8d4.jpg[/img]

[h3]2. Workbench integration[/h3]

To simplify production and management settings, Plasma workbench now takes care of both weapons and armors. With this change, survivors can now manage their bases with more efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/6b98e0171c8f960ab037a4c37ef14712896a06f0.jpg[/img]

[h2][Frontier test][/h2]

Our update mentioned above, and many other unrevealed updates will be opened to survivors through our frontier test that will take place next week.

More detailed schedules and guides will be shared through our Discord and Steam community starting from next week.

Thanks,

notes.title: New weapon ‘Maverick’ updated!
notes.content:
We would like to present a new weapon that is planned to be added in our next test. Maverick has a rapid fire rate and stable recoil. 

[h2][b]Ultimate form of SMG ‘Maverick’[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4ed92fe709634453359957dfb4c0df4abfbfc1aa.jpg[/img]
[b]- Name: Maverick
- Classification: SMG
- Rank: 3rd Tier
- Type: Energy Ammo[/b]

Only hi-cap magazine can be equipped in Maverick. It is relatively easy to use due to stable recoil and fast fire rate. 

Maverick does require more resources to craft compared to Spitter. However, when two guns are compared thoroughly, Maverick definitely shows better power and speed compared to Spitter with vertical grips and other attachables.

notes.content:
Hey survivors,

Dysterra global CBT has just started!  To all the players, soon to join in the world of Dysterra, please find detailed information about our CBT below for your gameplay:

- July 6 at 19:00 PM ~ July 20 at 07:59 AM in PDT
- July 6 at 22:00 PM ~ July 20 at 10:59 AM in EDT
- July 7 at 04:00 AM ~ July 20 at 16:59 PM in CEST
- July 7 at 11:00 AM ~ July 20 at 23:59 PM in KST


[h3][b][Steam - PlayTest][/b][/h3]
Our beta test will be on for 2 weeks in Steam Playtest. Starting from July 6 at 19 PM (PDT), survivors who requested access to Playtest are able to join Dysterra through the ‘Play Now’ button on our Steam store page or from the invitation email sent from Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/dcd4ad78f5590aa9a41fbf993124bad33d89182c.png[/img]

Once you click the ‘Play Now’ button, you can find a new tab ‘Dysterra Playtest’ in your Steam Library to download.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5bfac1c2dd19ca1d758c1a1985b7028845d66314.png[/img]

[h3][b][Gameplay][/b][/h3]
Once you get into the lobby, you can create a nickname and select a server to play from Single Player or Official Server (multiplay server). Only one character can be created on each server. Please be careful to pick your nickname as it isn’t unchangeable once you name one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/decf6e653146568b54ea72c9799247898ed1ed25.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/61d548c3b8bce514238c0b2ce86ff20c5369703d.png[/img]

[b]-Single Player:[/b]
Single Player is a separate server where you can fully enjoy the world of Dysterra yourself.
Before playing in the Official Server, you can control settings just for yourself without any disruptions from other players in Single Player. Also, you can start a new or continue game whenever you want from where you stopped.

Please note that your gameplay in Single Player might be delayed if you have a few more softwares running behind on your PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d6616f773458d4cd58627492c67b8786381ad6c4.png[/img]

[b] -Official Server[/b]
Official Server is the world where you should survive competing against other survivors. You can create a character depending on your current region and also it’s easy to check the server where you have already created a character through the icon on the left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/da308de92f6d0e3100720246e4e7635a45cfcfd1.png[/img]

In case of getting access to servers where you are not currently at, please note that you might have an unfavourable internet connection due to the high ping playing the game. For better gameplay, choose the server regarding the region and ping to your current internet environment and also, we recommend going through basic information on ‘Basic Game Guide’ posted on our Steam community hub to play the game before choosing the server.

<[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2420238499&snr=2_9_100003_]Beginner's Guide Link[/url]>

If you have any additional questions or suggestions, feel free to leave them in our official Discord channel. We would love to back you up with your feedback and guide.

<[url=https://discord.com/invite/6J8raGxYrT]Discord Channel Link[/url]>

notes.title: Preview of New Region, Arphaxad
notes.content:
Hi guys, 

We have a new map update to share!
Following along with Elam and Ashur, we've updated a new area named Arphaxad. Not only dangerous threats to your survival but also abundant resources coexist in this area. You need to fully gear up to overcome intense competition among survivors. 

[b][h2]Update on New Region, Arphaxad 🗺️ [/h2][/b]
[b]- Northeast desert area, Arphaxad, and Hyper-Satellite Station.
- Highest difficulty but highest valuable resources guaranteed![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/68ab64941735e96fe33fd3c3ca3bf701e90bf450.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/52b17883e6d9ca42ab9b88bae91f2245aedccd51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/164f942e09d2cb79092e8c9b4403a0227d829ed9.jpg[/img]

In Arphaxad, you will have to confront various abnormalities and significant durability downfall in both weapons and housings. These are mainly due to high temperature and dust storms caused by the on-going Terrafire. You’ll be able to control your high temperature and raging thirst with rooting a raw Opuntia Leaf and Agave Leaf.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/5463c100e02ea683b6ceaa17360557d3eca34947.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/63d16ba2a1b553f0d67faf57702e0fd19d90869e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1a3d3cdbdf059e82ea3087d98d38546482fd77fd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4887bf4a6cb557c9b5d6c892d9766f3c6270fd0c.jpg[/img]

Arphaxad is indeed a difficult region to survive in. However, this area is filled with plentiful  resources and Terrasites compared to other areas which would be a good challenge for mid to high tier survivors.  

That’s why we believe that Arphaxad will bring a full number of very bitter competition among survivors for wanting to increase their growth and skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/e7f3deb859db6714470b91d71592b6d90085ba0c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/1b26261867fbd8b911208902895014ef1dd02fa5.jpg[/img]

Finally, a new checkpoint within Arphaxad called [b]Hyper-Satellite Station[/b] is a new satellite control facility built for smooth space logistics between the Orbis and Earth. As this facility has various EMP devices to prevent communication failures, you can acquire an [b]Electromagnetic Phase Chip[/b] when you occupy this checkpoint. 

Electromagnetic Phase Chip offers the ability to temporarily stop Terracores owned by other survivors with [b]EMP Shockwave skills[/b] and to charge up all Terracores in your base with [b]energy amplification skills. [/b]

You’ll be able to incapacitate other survivor's defense systems when raiding their bases which means, you also have a power to solidify your defense system at your base whenever your survival is threatened. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4240b0292876a2b4e3861271c02518a95a8661ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/50fe36c11d9ba063338ad0b48c94dd49c258326d.jpg[/img]

We look forward to your feedback on the Arphaxad update. 
Feel free to post your opinions on our Discord channel and Steam community. With the feedback received, we will try our best to provide you with better and improved Dysterra.  
[list]
[*] Discord Channel : https://discord.com/invite/6J8raGxYrT
[/list]
Don’t forget to request access to join our global CBT starting in July. Invite your friends to CBT and survive in Dysterra together as a team!!

notes.title: Team System 🏃🏃🏃🏃🏃
notes.content:
Hey guys, 

Today we’re bringing very exciting news for you. Remember how much you guys wanted to play Dysterra with friends as a team? We finally made it! 💪

[u][b]This system offers a lot of player convenience and lets you share housing with your teammates. [/b][/u]

notes.title: 🛠Game display and character menu revision🛠
notes.content:
Hey guys, hope you guys are doing great! 

We’re very excited to give you an update on what we have been working on regarding game display and character menu. 

Based on various feedback's from our testers, we are in the process of changing some features as listed below. 

[h3][b][Game Display Updates][/b][/h3]
[h3]Optimized head up display [/h3]
Our head up display has been modified focusing more on survival and combat. Now, users can conveniently check out the essentials - character’s status and game progress - in a simple manner. 

[h3]Party system added while unnecessary functions removed [/h3]
The screen configuration has been adjusted to fit various information related to party systems such as party members’ info and their locations. Chat system has also been changed accordingly. 

Inconvenient short-keys have been unified and rearranged, and easy-to-expand switch quick slots have been added. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/823dcf28fa2eb71b11f0dab1d3c656626f254bac.gif[/img]

[h3][b][Basic Layout Revision][/b][/h3]
[h3]Layout divided but more information[/h3]
In-game inventory now focuses more on character status and information about possessed items. Also, the crafting menu can be accessed separately due to its importance and usage frequency. 

[h3]Better and easier user experience[/h3]
Mouse overlay pop-up function has been added to provide convenience in selecting, comparing, and wearing a variety of different items according to user actions. 

In addition, the inventory is divided into three zones when looting items; Some great facets have been added to help you play Dysterra in a better gaming environment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/d8275042375f2b1ddefd2dd5cf5a7bb0744b73d8.gif[/img]

Finally, the information window conveying Landmarks and Diagrams are currently also undergoing some changes in contents and visuals to provide better game play for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/99f15edef90a8c7ee8821729d9cdd7c14aca282b.png[/img]


[b]Your feedback is always valuable to us. If you’d like to share your opinions, feel free to leave them on our Discord channel. [/b]

However, please note that depending on how the development goes, plans might get delayed, we will do our best to communicate as frequently as possible.

notes.title: Development Plan
notes.content:
I have exciting news for you guys - We’re going to talk about what our dev team has been working on to prepare for the next test. 

Our team had a very long and deep talk about how we want to shape up Dysterra based on the feedback, survey, and all data we gathered from alpha testing and we are going to improve more convenience on your gaming experience along with focusing on the survival genre environment.

[h1][Major Improvement][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/4e8a85d8e907299be42324193578d4a662d128fe.png[/img]

[h2]UI Improvement [/h2]
 - The main UI design will be improved.
 - The way to display characters stats and items information will be changed.

[h2]Team Play[/h2]
 - Inviting players to play co-op as a team will be added. 
 - Sharing housing with your teammates will be added which allows them to construct one together.

[h2]New Area [/h2]
 - A Northern area in the map with highest difficulty will be opened along with a new landmark.
 - More materials to gather will be provided in the Northern area.

[h2]Housing System [/h2]
 - The way to upgrade housing structures and defend your own housing will be improved.
 - A new workbench to repair your weapons/armors will be added. 

[h2]NPC Improvement [/h2]
 - More fighting patterns and general improvement on NPCs 
 - New NPCs will be added corresponding with the area’s difficulties. 

[h2]New Weapons  [/h2]
 - High tier weapons will be added.  
 - New secondary weapons will be added.

[h2]New Armors[/h2]
 - More buff or performance will be added depending on which weapons you are holding.
 - New armors will be added. 

[h2]Car Usage [/h2]
 - Cars will need to be fueled to move and more players will be able to get on one car.

[h2]Player Convenience [/h2]
 - Some of your items will be able to retrieve after you die.
[h3][b]※ All points mentioned above may be subject to change depending on the development progress.   [/b][/h3]

We’re going to inform you of our plan with you in detail and if you’d like to share your opinions, feel free to leave them on our Discord channel. 

However, please note that depending on how the  development goes, we might be delayed sharing more details with you but we’ll do our best to come talk to you frequently.

 - Our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/6J8raGxYrT

In order to get more updated information, wishlist and follow Dysterra on the Steam page and it helps for us to get motivated and prepared for the next test! 
 - Our Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1527890/Dysterra/
 - Our Steam Community: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1527890﻿

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39751547/0796afe7d42841200826dd08eeb4d46dbdac3aaa.png[/img]

Thank you, survivors!
